I called a local GE repair service, that the local HD said would be doing any repairs and they said they can't jump in because of GE and HDs repair policies. This is my last appliance purchase from Home Depot and last GE.

Sentence (English): I did a lot of reading of reviews and “kicking the tires” before deciding that this unit is for me.
Comments (English): [ Outshines Bosch in Practicality/Versatility IMO ] || ---------------- || I did a lot of reading of reviews and “kicking the tires” before deciding that this unit is for me. Key criteria: quiet operation (one open living space), sturdy adjustable racks, format of the rack tines.(Can some fold down? Yes). My friend has a Bosch and I hate it due to its limited versatility in terms of how you configure your plate/bowl placement. I consider loading my dishwasher as a lovingly orchestrated work of art(ok, not really but I do find satisfaction in a neatly loaded machine). This KitchenAid has excellent versatility! You can adjust the rack heights, play with the plate/bowl placement, mix plates and cookware freely. The true challenge was when I had 14 people for dinner. This machine neatly loaded everything except my wine glasses. (I like to hand wash them anyway but did not find the machine having a good option.) There is even a user friendly top (3rd rack) that handles pesky cooking utensils, knives, small bowls and glasses, etc. I am SO happy with this machine and appreciate the sturdiness and design. My ONLY criticism is that the controls are very sensitive to touch and I have a bad habit of touching them when I open the door to add items. I find that I often have to hit the “cancel” button to not activate the wash, delay start, etc.- not a big deal. Hopefully, this dishwasher gives me years of service!

Sentence (English): Thinking that the technology of dishwashers hadn't really changed much, we kept resuscitating our 20-year-old dishwasher, but it still died.
Comments (English): [ I ask myself: Why didn't I buy it sooner? ] || ---------------- || Thinking that the technology of dishwashers hadn't really changed much, we kept resuscitating our 20-year-old dishwasher, but it still died. Reluctantly, we looked for a new one. After reading multiple reviews from various sources, and visiting showrooms, we decided to get the Bosch 500 series. It's not the most fancy machine, but has good features and layout that seem like a good upgrade. So far, it has exceeded our expectations and some more. At the same size, it has a much large capacity for dishes. It is easy to load and has great flexibility to accommodate dishes/ bowls of various shapes and sizes. It is so quiet that you almost have to listen for it to know that it is running. And I love the little red light on the floor so you can tell from afar that the machine is running. Even though I still think it is crazy to use a cell phone app to custom program and operate a dishwasher remotely, I can't deny that the programming function is great, and my dishes come out absolutely clean every single time with these efficient smart programs. I have not had to rewash anything to date. The Auto Air function is great to help dry dishes without using extra energy. Because there is no heating elements at the bottom of the machine, I can load plastic items anywhere. I don't have to clean the filter yet, but it is very accessible and visible. Had I known a Bosch dishwasher can make such a difference, I would not have wasted so much time to resuscitate my old GE. The only little pet peeve is that our vintage wine glasses do not fit well on the shelves and the wine glass clips don't work on them. But that is such a minor issue compared to all the improvements it has offered us. I recommend this machine with zero reservation.

Sentence (English): Thinking that the technology of dishwashers hadn't really changed much, we kept resuscitating our 20-year-old dishwasher, but it still died.
Comments (English): [ I ask myself: Why didn't I buy it sooner? ] || ---------------- || Thinking that the technology of dishwashers hadn't really changed much, we kept resuscitating our 20-year-old dishwasher, but it still died. Reluctantly, we looked for a new one. After reading multiple reviews from various sources, and visiting showrooms, we decided to get the Bosch 500 series. It's not the most fancy machine, but has good features and layout that seem like a good upgrade. So far, it has exceeded our expectations and some more. At the same size, it has a much large capacity for dishes. It is easy to load and has great flexibility to accommodate dishes/ bowls of various shapes and sizes. It is so quiet that you almost have to listen for it to know that it is running. And I love the little red light on the floor so you can tell from afar that the machine is running. Even though I still think it is crazy to use a cell phone app to custom program and operate a dishwasher remotely, I can't deny that the programming function is great, and my dishes come out absolutely clean every single time with these efficient smart programs. I have not had to rewash anything to date. The Auto Air function is great to help dry dishes without using extra energy. Because there is no heating elements at the bottom of the machine, I can load plastic items anywhere. I don't have to clean the filter yet, but it is very accessible and visible. Had I known a Bosch dishwasher can make such a difference, I would not have wasted so much time to resuscitate my old GE. The only little pet peeve is that our vintage wine glasses do not fit well on the shelves and the wine glass clips don't work on them. But that is such a minor issue compared to all the improvements it has offered us. I recommend this machine with zero reservation. □□□□□□□□□□

Sentence (English): I wonder why I bought this now because it frees me from washing dishes at a low price.
Comments (English): [ Your quality of life will change ] || ---------------- || I wonder why I bought this now because it frees me from washing dishes at a low price. I am a working mom, and when I put the dishes from the night before and the next morning in the dishwasher and go to work, I can see the dishes that are crisp and clean in the evening. Since I removed the dish drying rack from the sink, I can use the sink more widely and avoid water splashing around while washing dishes. Even though I had already removed the dishes and mop holder from the sink before the installer came, it took almost an hour to remove the existing cabinet and connect the water supply and drainage facilities. I would like to praise the installer who installed it kindly and thoroughly. Anyway, I am really, really satisfied.

Sentence (English): I did a lot of reading of reviews and "kicking the tires" before deciding that this unit is for me.
Comments (English): [ Outshines Bosch in Practicality/Versatility IMO ] || ---------------- || I did a lot of reading of reviews and "kicking the tires" before deciding that this unit is for me. Key criteria: quiet operation (one open living space), sturdy adjustable racks, format of the rack tines.(Can some fold down? Yes). My friend has a Bosch and I hate it due to its limited versatility in terms of how you configure your plate/bowl placement. I consider loading my dishwasher as a lovingly orchestrated work of art(ok, not really but I do find satisfaction in a neatly loaded machine). This KitchenAid has excellent versatility! You can adjust the rack heights, play with the plate/bowl placement, mix plates and cookware freely. The true challenge was when I had 14 people for dinner. This machine neatly loaded everything except my wine glasses. (I like to hand wash them anyway but did not find the machine having a good option.) There is even a user friendly top (3rd rack) that handles pesky cooking utensils, knives, small bowls and glasses, etc. I am SO happy with this machine and appreciate the sturdiness and design. My ONLY criticism is that the controls are very sensitive to touch and I have a bad habit of touching them when I open the door to add items. I find that I often have to hit the "cancel" button to not activate the wash, delay start, etc.- not a big deal. Hopefully, this dishwasher gives me years of service!

Sentence (English): This review was written after receiving a free dishwasher as part of a Coupang Experience Group event.
Comments (English): [ A must-have for the kitchen! ] || ---------------- || This review was written after receiving a free dishwasher as part of a Coupang Experience Group event. I've been married for over ten years without a dishwasher. It's a bit late, but I'm finally getting around to using it, so I wanted to share how great it is. I've been writing this review for the past week, meticulously, meticulously, and thoroughly. Easy Installation: First of all, since it's not a built-in dishwasher, installation is a breeze. Simply drill a hole for the water purifier, plug it in, and you're done. The hole isn't too big, and since our existing water purifier was already there, we plugged it in. As long as you have enough space, installation wasn't difficult. Since you need to use it right after washing dishes, a location close to the dishwasher is ideal. Cleaning Power: This was my first time using a household dishwasher, so I was a bit skeptical about its cleaning performance. I tried it with just a bowl of ramen and rinsed it with water. It was surprisingly clean, spotless, and the dishes sparkled. No matter how much I washed and rinsed it by hand, it was incredibly clean. It's not only clean, but it's also sterilized, so I'm confident I can even use it with my kids' dishes. The washing time is set to the default. I just press the play button without pressing the right button. The default setting is 65 degrees for 65 minutes. During that time, the dishwasher is fully cleaned, sterilized, and dried. It may seem like a long time, but since I just collect the dishes, larvae them, and run the dishwasher right away, I can do other things, take a break, or go out during that time. It's finished, and it's open on its own. It's spacious, and since it's designed for six people, I was worried the washing space inside would be small, but it actually has two levels. The upper level is for cups, and the lower level is for wide, tall dishes. The lower basket adjusts to fit the dishes. It seems like a perfect size for our family of four to use after meals. I'm a bit sensitive to noise, but I didn't really notice it except in the middle of the night. It only makes a loud noise when it's emptying or something. At other times, it's drowned out by the TV, so I don't even notice it. Having a dishwasher has always been so convenient, I wonder why no one told me about it. It was always hard to get home from work, take care of the kids, and clean up afterward, but using a dishwasher feels like I've gained some freedom, and my quality of life has improved a little. ^^ If your kitchen is a little small, the volume can feel a bit large. Having an appliance that I never had before take up one corner of the kitchen can feel a bit cramped, but I've gotten used to it and it feels so comfortable that the volume doesn't matter at all. If you're wondering, "Will this be possible?", I definitely recommend trying it. The time I spent worrying about it was so worth it, and since it's not a built-in unit, it's affordable. I can even take it with me when I move. ^^ They say dishwashers save water, and I think my water usage has decreased significantly. Just tossing a single detergent in and it dries perfectly is a great convenience for lazy people like me. I just take it out one at a time, use it, run it, and repeat. It's not inconvenient, but in my house, the cord is far away, so I have to connect the dishwasher cord separately. Aside from that, it's only a little noisy. I'm completely satisfied with everything except the fact that it's there. Everyone says it's our new kitchen auntie, and I can totally understand why. Sentence (English): I've been married for over ten years without a dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ A must-have for the kitchen! ] || ---------------- || This review was written after receiving a free dishwasher as part of a Coupang Experience Group event. I've been married for over ten years without a dishwasher. It's a bit late, but I'm finally getting around to using it, so I wanted to share how great it is. I've been writing this review for the past week, meticulously, meticulously, and thoroughly. Easy Installation: First of all, since it's not a built-in dishwasher, installation is a breeze. Simply drill a hole for the water purifier, plug it in, and you're done. The hole isn't too big, and since our existing water purifier was already there, we plugged it in. As long as you have enough space, installation wasn't difficult. Since you need to use it right after washing dishes, a location close to the dishwasher is ideal. Cleaning Power: This was my first time using a household dishwasher, so I was a bit skeptical about its cleaning performance. I tried it with just a bowl of ramen and rinsed it with water. It was surprisingly clean, spotless, and the dishes sparkled. No matter how much I washed and rinsed it by hand, it was incredibly clean. It's not only clean, but it's also sterilized, so I'm confident I can even use it with my kids' dishes. The washing time is set to the default. I just press the play button without pressing the right button. The default setting is 65 degrees for 65 minutes. During that time, the dishwasher is fully cleaned, sterilized, and dried. It may seem like a long time, but since I just collect the dishes, larvae them, and run the dishwasher right away, I can do other things, take a break, or go out during that time. It's finished, and it's open on its own. It's spacious, and since it's designed for six people, I was worried the washing space inside would be small, but it actually has two levels. The upper level is for cups, and the lower level is for wide, tall dishes. The lower basket adjusts to fit the dishes. It seems like a perfect size for our family of four to use after meals. I'm a bit sensitive to noise, but I didn't really notice it except in the middle of the night. It only makes a loud noise when it's emptying or something. At other times, it's drowned out by the TV, so I don't even notice it. Having a dishwasher has always been so convenient, I wonder why no one told me about it. It was always hard to get home from work, take care of the kids, and clean up afterward, but using a dishwasher feels like I've gained some freedom, and my quality of life has improved a little. ^^ If your kitchen is a little small, the volume can feel a bit large. Having an appliance that I never had before take up one corner of the kitchen can feel a bit cramped, but I've gotten used to it and it feels so comfortable that the volume doesn't matter at all. If you're wondering, "Will this be possible?", I definitely recommend trying it. The time I spent worrying about it was so worth it, and since it's not a built-in unit, it's affordable. I can even take it with me when I move. ^^ They say dishwashers save water, and I think my water usage has decreased significantly. Just tossing a single detergent in and it dries perfectly is a great convenience for lazy people like me. I just take it out one at a time, use it, run it, and repeat. It's not inconvenient, but in my house, the cord is far away, so I have to connect the dishwasher cord separately. Aside from that, it's only a little noisy. I'm completely satisfied with everything except the fact that it's there. Everyone says it's our new kitchen auntie, and I can totally understand why. It's comfortable and easy to use, just press a button. I truly, truly recommend it. For those of you who are hesitating, stop worrying and just enjoy it. I highly, highly recommend it. It'll make your day truly comfortable. ^^

Comments (English): [ A must-have for the kitchen! ] || ---------------- || This review was written after receiving a free dishwasher as part of a Coupang Experience Group event. I've been married for over ten years without a dishwasher. It's a bit late, but I'm finally getting around to using it, so I wanted to share how great it is. I've been writing this review for the past week, meticulously, meticulously, and thoroughly. Easy Installation: First of all, since it's not a built-in dishwasher, installation is a breeze. Simply drill a hole for the water purifier, plug it in, and you're done. The hole isn't too big, and since our existing water purifier was already there, we plugged it in. As long as you have enough space, installation wasn't difficult. Since you need to use it right after washing dishes, a location close to the dishwasher is ideal. Cleaning Power: This was my first time using a household dishwasher, so I was a bit skeptical about its cleaning performance. I tried it with just a bowl of ramen and rinsed it with water. It was surprisingly clean, spotless, and the dishes sparkled. No matter how much I washed and rinsed it by hand, it was incredibly clean. It's not only clean, but it's also sterilized, so I'm confident I can even use it with my kids' dishes. The washing time is set to the default. I just press the play button without pressing the right button. The default setting is 65 degrees for 65 minutes. During that time, the dishwasher is fully cleaned, sterilized, and dried. It may seem like a long time, but since I just collect the dishes, larvae them, and run the dishwasher right away, I can do other things, take a break, or go out during that time. It's finished, and it's open on its own. It's spacious, and since it's designed for six people, I was worried the washing space inside would be small, but it actually has two levels. The upper level is for cups, and the lower level is for wide, tall dishes. The lower basket adjusts to fit the dishes. It seems like a perfect size for our family of four to use after meals. I'm a bit sensitive to noise, but I didn't really notice it except in the middle of the night. It only makes a loud noise when it's emptying or something. At other times, it's drowned out by the TV, so I don't even notice it. Having a dishwasher has always been so convenient, I wonder why no one told me about it. It was always hard to get home from work, take care of the kids, and clean up afterward, but using a dishwasher feels like I've gained some freedom, and my quality of life has improved a little. ^^ If your kitchen is a little small, the volume can feel a bit large. Having an appliance that I never had before take up one corner of the kitchen can feel a bit cramped, but I've gotten used to it and it feels so comfortable that the volume doesn't matter at all. If you're wondering, "Will this be possible?", I definitely recommend trying it. The time I spent worrying about it was so worth it, and since it's not a built-in unit, it's affordable. I can even take it with me when I move. ^^ They say dishwashers save water, and I think my water usage has decreased significantly. Just tossing a single detergent in and it dries perfectly is a great convenience for lazy people like me. I just take it out one at a time, use it, run it, and repeat. It's not inconvenient, but in my house, the cord is far away, so I have to connect the dishwasher cord separately. Aside from that, it's only a little noisy. I'm completely satisfied with everything except the fact that it's there. Everyone says it's our new kitchen auntie, and I can totally understand why. It's comfortable and easy to use, just press a button. I truly, truly recommend it. For those of you who are hesitating, stop worrying and just enjoy it. I highly, highly recommend it. It'll make your day truly comfortable. ^^

Comments (English): [ A must-have for the kitchen! ] || ---------------- || This review was written after receiving a free dishwasher as part of a Coupang Experience Group event. I've been married for over ten years without a dishwasher. It's a bit late, but I'm finally getting around to using it, so I wanted to share how great it is. I've been writing this review for the past week, meticulously, meticulously, and thoroughly. Easy Installation: First of all, since it's not a built-in dishwasher, installation is a breeze. Simply drill a hole for the water purifier, plug it in, and you're done. The hole isn't too big, and since our existing water purifier was already there, we plugged it in. As long as you have enough space, installation wasn't difficult. Since you need to use it right after washing dishes, a location close to the dishwasher is ideal. Cleaning Power: This was my first time using a household dishwasher, so I was a bit skeptical about its cleaning performance. I tried it with just a bowl of ramen and rinsed it with water. It was surprisingly clean, spotless, and the dishes sparkled. No matter how much I washed and rinsed it by hand, it was incredibly clean. It's not only clean, but it's also sterilized, so I'm confident I can even use it with my kids' dishes. The washing time is set to the default. I just press the play button without pressing the right button. The default setting is 65 degrees for 65 minutes. During that time, the dishwasher is fully cleaned, sterilized, and dried. It may seem like a long time, but since I just collect the dishes, larvae them, and run the dishwasher right away, I can do other things, take a break, or go out during that time. It's finished, and it's open on its own. It's spacious, and since it's designed for six people, I was worried the washing space inside would be small, but it actually has two levels. The upper level is for cups, and the lower level is for wide, tall dishes. The lower basket adjusts to fit the dishes. It seems like a perfect size for our family of four to use after meals. I'm a bit sensitive to noise, but I didn't really notice it except in the middle of the night. It only makes a loud noise when it's emptying or something. At other times, it's drowned out by the TV, so I don't even notice it. Having a dishwasher has always been so convenient, I wonder why no one told me about it. It was always hard to get home from work, take care of the kids, and clean up afterward, but using a dishwasher feels like I've gained some freedom, and my quality of life has improved a little. ^^ If your kitchen is a little small, the volume can feel a bit large. Having an appliance that I never had before take up one corner of the kitchen can feel a bit cramped, but I've gotten used to it and it feels so comfortable that the volume doesn't matter at all. If you're wondering, "Will this be possible?", I definitely recommend trying it. The time I spent worrying about it was so worth it, and since it's not a built-in unit, it's affordable. I can even take it with me when I move. ^^ They say dishwashers save water, and I think my water usage has decreased significantly. Just tossing a single detergent in and it dries perfectly is a great convenience for lazy people like me. I just take it out one at a time, use it, run it, and repeat. It's not inconvenient, but in my house, the cord is far away, so I have to connect the dishwasher cord separately. Aside from that, it's only a little noisy. I'm completely satisfied with everything except the fact that it's there. Everyone says it's our new kitchen auntie, and I can totally understand why. It's comfortable and easy to use, just press a button. I truly, truly recommend it. For those of you who are hesitating, stop worrying and just enjoy it. I highly, highly recommend it. It'll make your day truly comfortable. ^^

Sentence (English): As long as you have enough space, installation wasn't difficult.
Comments (English): [ A must-have for the kitchen! ] || ---------------- || This review was written after receiving a free dishwasher as part of a Coupang Experience Group event. I've been married for over ten years without a dishwasher. It's a bit late, but I'm finally getting around to using it, so I wanted to share how great it is. I've been writing this review for the past week, meticulously, meticulously, and thoroughly. Easy Installation: First of all, since it's not a built-in dishwasher, installation is a breeze. Simply drill a hole for the water purifier, plug it in, and you're done. The hole isn't too big, and since our existing water purifier was already there, we plugged it in. As long as you have enough space, installation wasn't difficult. Since you need to use it right after washing dishes, a location close to the dishwasher is ideal. Cleaning Power: This was my first time using a household dishwasher, so I was a bit skeptical about its cleaning performance. I tried it with just a bowl of ramen and rinsed it with water. It was surprisingly clean, spotless, and the dishes sparkled. No matter how much I washed and rinsed it by hand, it was incredibly clean. It's not only clean, but it's also sterilized, so I'm confident I can even use it with my kids' dishes. The washing time is set to the default. I just press the play button without pressing the right button. The default setting is 65 degrees for 65 minutes. During that time, the dishwasher is fully cleaned, sterilized, and dried. It may seem like a long time, but since I just collect the dishes, larvae them, and run the dishwasher right away, I can do other things, take a break, or go out during that time. It's finished, and it's open on its own. It's spacious, and since it's designed for six people, I was worried the washing space inside would be small, but it actually has two levels. The upper level is for cups, and the lower level is for wide, tall dishes. The lower basket adjusts to fit the dishes. It seems like a perfect size for our family of four to use after meals. I'm a bit sensitive to noise, but I didn't really notice it except in the middle of the night. It only makes a loud noise when it's emptying or something. At other times, it's drowned out by the TV, so I don't even notice it. Having a dishwasher has always been so convenient, I wonder why no one told me about it. It was always hard to get home from work, take care of the kids, and clean up afterward, but using a dishwasher feels like I've gained some freedom, and my quality of life has improved a little. ^^ If your kitchen is a little small, the volume can feel a bit large. Having an appliance that I never had before take up one corner of the kitchen can feel a bit cramped, but I've gotten used to it and it feels so comfortable that the volume doesn't matter at all. If you're wondering, "Will this be possible?", I definitely recommend trying it. The time I spent worrying about it was so worth it, and since it's not a built-in unit, it's affordable. I can even take it with me when I move. ^^ They say dishwashers save water, and I think my water usage has decreased significantly. Just tossing a single detergent in and it dries perfectly is a great convenience for lazy people like me. I just take it out one at a time, use it, run it, and repeat. It's not inconvenient, but in my house, the cord is far away, so I have to connect the dishwasher cord separately. Aside from that, it's only a little noisy. I'm completely satisfied with everything except the fact that it's there. Everyone says it's our new kitchen auntie, and I can totally understand why. It's comfortable and easy to use, just press a button. I truly, truly recommend it. For those of you who are hesitating, stop worrying and just enjoy it. I highly, highly recommend it. It'll make your day truly comfortable. ^^

Sentence (English): Since you need to use it right after washing dishes, a location close to the dishwasher is ideal.
Comments (English): [ A must-have for the kitchen! ] || ---------------- || This review was written after receiving a free dishwasher as part of a Coupang Experience Group event. I've been married for over ten years without a dishwasher. It's a bit late, but I'm finally getting around to using it, so I wanted to share how great it is. I've been writing this review for the past week, meticulously, meticulously, and thoroughly. Easy Installation: First of all, since it's not a built-in dishwasher, installation is a breeze. Cleaning Power: This was my first time using a household dishwasher, so I was a bit skeptical about its cleaning performance. I tried it with just a bowl of ramen and rinsed it with water. It was surprisingly clean, spotless, and the dishes sparkled. No matter how much I washed and rinsed it by hand, it was incredibly clean. It's not only clean, but it's also sterilized, so I'm confident I can even use it with my kids' dishes. The washing time is set to the default. I just press the play button without pressing the right button. The default setting is 65 degrees for 65 minutes. During that time, the dishwasher is fully cleaned, sterilized, and dried. It may seem like a long time, but since I just collect the dishes, larvae them, and run the dishwasher right away, I can do other things, take a break, or go out during that time. It's finished, and it's open on its own. It's spacious, and since it's designed for six people, I was worried the washing space inside would be small, but it actually has two levels. The upper level is for cups, and the lower level is for wide, tall dishes. The lower basket adjusts to fit the dishes. It seems like a perfect size for our family of four to use after meals. I'm a bit sensitive to noise, but I didn't really notice it except in the middle of the night. It only makes a loud noise when it's emptying or something. At other times, it's drowned out by the TV, so I don't even notice it. Having a dishwasher has always been so convenient, I wonder why no one told me about it. It was always hard to get home from work, take care of the kids, and clean up afterward, but using a dishwasher feels like I've gained some freedom, and my quality of life has improved a little. ^^ If your kitchen is a little small, the volume can feel a bit large. If you're wondering, "Will this be possible?", I definitely recommend trying it. The time I spent worrying about it was so worth it, and since it's not a built-in unit, it's affordable. I can even take it with me when I move. ^^ They say dishwashers save water, and I think my water usage has decreased significantly. Just tossing a single detergent in and it dries perfectly is a great convenience for lazy people like me. I just take it out one at a time, use it, run it, and repeat. It's not inconvenient, but in my house, the cord is far away, so I have to connect the dishwasher cord separately. Aside from that, it's only a little noisy. I'm completely satisfied with everything except the fact that it's there. Everyone says it's our new kitchen auntie, and I can totally understand why. It's comfortable and easy to use, just press a button. I truly, truly recommend it. For those of you who are hesitating, stop worrying and just enjoy it. I highly, highly recommend it. It'll make your day truly comfortable. ^^

Sentence (English): I tried it with just a bowl of ramen and rinsed it with water.
Comments (English): [ A must-have for the kitchen! ] || ---------------- || This review was written after receiving a free dishwasher as part of a Coupang Experience Group event. I've been married for over ten years without a dishwasher. It's a bit late, but I'm finally getting around to using it, so I wanted to share how great it is. I've been writing this review for the past week, meticulously, meticulously, and thoroughly. Easy Installation: First of all, since it's not a built-in dishwasher, installation is a breeze. Simply drill a hole for the water purifier, plug it in, and you're done. The hole isn't too big, and since our existing water purifier was already there, we plugged it in. As long as you have enough space, installation wasn't difficult. Since you need to use it right after washing dishes, a location close to the dishwasher is ideal. Cleaning Power: This was my first time using a household dishwasher, so I was a bit skeptical about its cleaning performance. I tried it with just a bowl of ramen and rinsed it with water. It was surprisingly clean, spotless, and the dishes sparkled. No matter how much I washed and rinsed it by hand, it was incredibly clean. It's not only clean, but it's also sterilized, so I'm confident I can even use it with my kids' dishes. The washing time is set to the default. I just press the play button without pressing the right button. The default setting is 65 degrees for 65 minutes. During that time, the dishwasher is fully cleaned, sterilized, and dried. It may seem like a long time, but since I just collect the dishes, larvae them, and run the dishwasher right away, I can do other things, take a break, or go out during that time. It's finished, and it's open on its own. It's spacious, and since it's designed for six people, I was worried the washing space inside would be small, but it actually has two levels. The upper level is for cups, and the lower level is for wide, tall dishes. The lower basket adjusts to fit the dishes. It seems like a perfect size for our family of four to use after meals. I'm a bit sensitive to noise, but I didn't really notice it except in the middle of the night. It only makes a loud noise when it's emptying or something. At other times, it's drowned out by the TV, so I don't even notice it. Having a dishwasher has always been so convenient, I wonder why no one told me about it. It was always hard to get home from work, take care of the kids, and clean up afterward, but using a dishwasher feels like I've gained some freedom, and my quality of life has improved a little. ^^ If your kitchen is a little small, the volume can feel a bit large. Having an appliance that I never had before take up one corner of the kitchen can feel a bit cramped, but I've gotten used to it and it feels so comfortable that the volume doesn't matter at all. If you're wondering, "Will this be possible?", I definitely recommend trying it. The time I spent worrying about it was so worth it, and since it's not a built-in unit, it's affordable. I can even take it with me when I move. ^^ They say dishwashers save water, and I think my water usage has decreased significantly. Just tossing a single detergent in and it dries perfectly is a great convenience for lazy people like me. I just take it out one at a time, use it, run it, and repeat. It's not inconvenient, but in my house, the cord is far away, so I have to connect the dishwasher cord separately. Aside from that, it's only a little noisy. I'm completely satisfied with everything except the fact that it's there. Everyone says it's our new kitchen auntie, and I can totally understand why. It's comfortable and easy to use, just press a button. I truly, truly recommend it. For those of you who are hesitating, stop worrying and just enjoy it. I highly, highly recommend it. It'll make your day truly comfortable. ^^

Sentence (English): No matter how much I washed and rinsed it by hand, it was incredibly clean.
Comments (English): [ A must-have for the kitchen! ] || ---------------- || This review was written after receiving a free dishwasher as part of a Coupang Experience Group event. I've been married for over ten years without a dishwasher. It's a bit late, but I'm finally getting around to using it, so I wanted to share how great it is. I've been writing this review for the past week, meticulously, meticulously, and thoroughly. Easy Installation: First of all, since it's not a built-in dishwasher, installation is a breeze. Simply drill a hole for the water purifier, plug it in, and you're done. The hole isn't too big, and since our existing water purifier was already there, we plugged it in. As long as you have enough space, installation wasn't difficult. Since you need to use it right after washing dishes, a location close to the dishwasher is ideal. Cleaning Power: This was my first time using a household dishwasher, so I was a bit skeptical about its cleaning performance. I tried it with just a bowl of ramen and rinsed it with water. It was surprisingly clean, spotless, and the dishes sparkled. No matter how much I washed and rinsed it by hand, it was incredibly clean. It's not only clean, but it's also sterilized, so I'm confident I can even use it with my kids' dishes. The washing time is set to the default. I just press the play button without pressing the right button. The default setting is 65 degrees for 65 minutes. During that time, the dishwasher is fully cleaned, sterilized, and dried. It may seem like a long time, but since I just collect the dishes, larvae them, and run the dishwasher right away, I can do other things, take a break, or go out during that time. It's finished, and it's open on its own. It's spacious, and since it's designed for six people, I was worried the washing space inside would be small, but it actually has two levels. The upper level is for cups, and the lower level is for wide, tall dishes. The lower basket adjusts to fit the dishes. It seems like a perfect size for our family of four to use after meals. I'm a bit sensitive to noise, but I didn't really notice it except in the middle of the night. It only makes a loud noise when it's emptying or something. At other times, it's drowned out by the TV, so I don't even notice it. Having a dishwasher has always been so convenient, I wonder why no one told me about it. It was always hard to get home from work, take care of the kids, and clean up afterward, but using a dishwasher feels like I've gained some freedom, and my quality of life has improved a little. ^^ If your kitchen is a little small, the volume can feel a bit large. Having an appliance that I never had before take up one corner of the kitchen can feel a bit cramped, but I've gotten used to it and it feels so comfortable that the volume doesn't matter at all. If you're wondering, "Will this be possible?", I definitely recommend trying it. The time I spent worrying about it was so worth it, and since it's not a built-in unit, it's affordable. I can even take it with me when I move. ^^ They say dishwashers save water, and I think my water usage has decreased significantly. Just tossing a single detergent in and it dries perfectly is a great convenience for lazy people like me. I just take it out one at a time, use it, run it, and repeat. It's not inconvenient, but in my house, the cord is far away, so I have to connect the dishwasher cord separately. Aside from that, it's only a little noisy. I'm completely satisfied with everything except the fact that it's there. Everyone says it's our new kitchen auntie, and I can totally understand why. It's comfortable and easy to use, just press a button. I truly, truly recommend it. For those of you who are hesitating, stop worrying and just enjoy it. I highly, highly recommend it. It'll make your day truly comfortable. ^^

I'm completely satisfied with everything except the fact that it's there. Everyone says it's our new kitchen auntie, and I can totally understand why. It'll make your day truly comfortable. ^^

I'm a bit sensitive to noise, but I didn't really notice it except in the middle of the night. It only makes a loud noise when it's emptying or something. I can even take it with me when I move. ^^ They say dishwashers save water, and I think my water usage has decreased significantly. Just tossing a single detergent in and it dries perfectly is a great convenience for lazy people like me. I just take it out one at a time, use it, run it, and repeat. It's not inconvenient, but in my house, the cord is far away, so I have to connect the dishwasher cord separately. Aside from that, it's only a little noisy. I'm completely satisfied with everything except the fact that it's there. Everyone says it's our new kitchen auntie, and I can totally understand why. It's comfortable and easy to use, just press a button. I truly, truly recommend it. For those of you who are hesitating, stop worrying and just enjoy it. I highly, highly recommend it. It'll make your day truly comfortable. ^^

Comments (English): [ A must-have for the kitchen! ] || ---------------- || This review was written after receiving a free dishwasher as part of a Coupang Experience Group event. As long as you have enough space, installation wasn't difficult. Since you need to use it right after washing dishes, a location close to the dishwasher is ideal. It was surprisingly clean, spotless, and the dishes sparkled. No matter how much I washed and rinsed it by hand, it was incredibly clean. It's not only clean, but it's also sterilized, so I'm confident I can even use it with my kids' dishes. The washing time is set to the default. I just press the play button without pressing the right button. The default setting is 65 degrees for 65 minutes. During that time, the dishwasher is fully cleaned, sterilized, and dried. It may seem like a long time, but since I just collect the dishes, larvae them, and run the dishwasher right away, I can do other things, take a break, or go out during that time. It's finished, and it's open on its own. It's spacious, and since it's designed for six people, I was worried the washing space inside would be small, but it actually has two levels. The upper level is for cups, and the lower level is for wide, tall dishes. The lower basket adjusts to fit the dishes. It seems like a perfect size for our family of four to use after meals. I'm a bit sensitive to noise, but I didn't really notice it except in the middle of the night. It only makes a loud noise when it's emptying or something. At other times, it's drowned out by the TV, so I don't even notice it. Having a dishwasher has always been so convenient, I wonder why no one told me about it. It was always hard to get home from work, take care of the kids, and clean up afterward, but using a dishwasher feels like I've gained some freedom, and my quality of life has improved a little. ^^ If your kitchen is a little small, the volume can feel a bit large. If you're wondering, "Will this be possible?", I definitely recommend trying it. The time I spent worrying about it was so worth it, and since it's not a built-in unit, it's affordable. I can even take it with me when I move. ^^ They say dishwashers save water, and I think my water usage has decreased significantly. Just tossing a single detergent in and it dries perfectly is a great convenience for lazy people like me. I just take it out one at a time, use it, run it, and repeat. It's not inconvenient, but in my house, the cord is far away, so I have to connect the dishwasher cord separately. Aside from that, it's only a little noisy. I'm completely satisfied with everything except the fact that it's there. Everyone says it's our new kitchen auntie, and I can totally understand why. It's comfortable and easy to use, just press a button. I truly, truly recommend it. For those of you who are hesitating, stop worrying and just enjoy it. I highly, highly recommend it. It'll make your day truly comfortable. ^^

Sentence (English): It's finished, and it's open on its own.
Comments (English): [ A must-have for the kitchen! ] || ---------------- || This review was written after receiving a free dishwasher as part of a Coupang Experience Group event. I've been married for over ten years without a dishwasher. It's a bit late, but I'm finally getting around to using it, so I wanted to share how great it is. I've been writing this review for the past week, meticulously, meticulously, and thoroughly. Easy Installation: First of all, since it's not a built-in dishwasher, installation is a breeze. Simply drill a hole for the water purifier, plug it in, and you're done. The hole isn't too big, and since our existing water purifier was already there, we plugged it in. As long as you have enough space, installation wasn't difficult. Since you need to use it right after washing dishes, a location close to the dishwasher is ideal. Cleaning Power: This was my first time using a household dishwasher, so I was a bit skeptical about its cleaning performance. I tried it with just a bowl of ramen and rinsed it with water. It was surprisingly clean, spotless, and the dishes sparkled. No matter how much I washed and rinsed it by hand, it was incredibly clean. It's not only clean, but it's also sterilized, so I'm confident I can even use it with my kids' dishes. The washing time is set to the default. I just press the play button without pressing the right button. The default setting is 65 degrees for 65 minutes. During that time, the dishwasher is fully cleaned, sterilized, and dried. It may seem like a long time, but since I just collect the dishes, larvae them, and run the dishwasher right away, I can do other things, take a break, or go out during that time. It's finished, and it's open on its own. It's spacious, and since it's designed for six people, I was worried the washing space inside would be small, but it actually has two levels. The upper level is for cups, and the lower level is for wide, tall dishes. The lower basket adjusts to fit the dishes. It seems like a perfect size for our family of four to use after meals. I'm a bit sensitive to noise, but I didn't really notice it except in the middle of the night. It only makes a loud noise when it's emptying or something. At other times, it's drowned out by the TV, so I don't even notice it. Having a dishwasher has always been so convenient, I wonder why no one told me about it. It was always hard to get home from work, take care of the kids, and clean up afterward, but using a dishwasher feels like I've gained some freedom, and my quality of life has improved a little. ^^ If your kitchen is a little small, the volume can feel a bit large. Having an appliance that I never had before take up one corner of the kitchen can feel a bit cramped, but I've gotten used to it and it feels so comfortable that the volume doesn't matter at all. If you're wondering, "Will this be possible?", I definitely recommend trying it. The time I spent worrying about it was so worth it, and since it's not a built-in unit, it's affordable. I can even take it with me when I move. ^^ They say dishwashers save water, and I think my water usage has decreased significantly. Just tossing a single detergent in and it dries perfectly is a great convenience for lazy people like me. I just take it out one at a time, use it, run it, and repeat. It's not inconvenient, but in my house, the cord is far away, so I have to connect the dishwasher cord separately. Aside from that, it's only a little noisy. I'm completely satisfied with everything except the fact that it's there. Everyone says it's our new kitchen auntie, and I can totally understand why. It's comfortable and easy to use, just press a button. I truly, truly recommend it. For those of you who are hesitating, stop worrying and just enjoy it. I highly, highly recommend it. It'll make your day truly comfortable. ^^

Comments (English): [ A must-have for the kitchen! ] || ---------------- || This review was written after receiving a free dishwasher as part of a Coupang Experience Group event. I've been married for over ten years without a dishwasher. It's a bit late, but I'm finally getting around to using it, so I wanted to share how great it is. I've been writing this review for the past week, meticulously, meticulously, and thoroughly. Easy Installation: First of all, since it's not a built-in dishwasher, installation is a breeze. Simply drill a hole for the water purifier, plug it in, and you're done. The hole isn't too big, and since our existing water purifier was already there, we plugged it in. As long as you have enough space, installation wasn't difficult. Since you need to use it right after washing dishes, a location close to the dishwasher is ideal. Cleaning Power: This was my first time using a household dishwasher, so I was a bit skeptical about its cleaning performance. I tried it with just a bowl of ramen and rinsed it with water. It was surprisingly clean, spotless, and the dishes sparkled. No matter how much I washed and rinsed it by hand, it was incredibly clean. It's not only clean, but it's also sterilized, so I'm confident I can even use it with my kids' dishes. The washing time is set to the default. I just press the play button without pressing the right button. The default setting is 65 degrees for 65 minutes. During that time, the dishwasher is fully cleaned, sterilized, and dried. It may seem like a long time, but since I just collect the dishes, larvae them, and run the dishwasher right away, I can do other things, take a break, or go out during that time. It's finished, and it's open on its own. It's spacious, and since it's designed for six people, I was worried the washing space inside would be small, but it actually has two levels. The upper level is for cups, and the lower level is for wide, tall dishes. The lower basket adjusts to fit the dishes. It seems like a perfect size for our family of four to use after meals. I'm a bit sensitive to noise, but I didn't really notice it except in the middle of the night. It only makes a loud noise when it's emptying or something. At other times, it's drowned out by the TV, so I don't even notice it. Having a dishwasher has always been so convenient, I wonder why no one told me about it. It was always hard to get home from work, take care of the kids, and clean up afterward, but using a dishwasher feels like I've gained some freedom, and my quality of life has improved a little. ^^ If your kitchen is a little small, the volume can feel a bit large. Having an appliance that I never had before take up one corner of the kitchen can feel a bit cramped, but I've gotten used to it and it feels so comfortable that the volume doesn't matter at all. If you're wondering, "Will this be possible?", I definitely recommend trying it. The time I spent worrying about it was so worth it, and since it's not a built-in unit, it's affordable. I can even take it with me when I move. ^^ They say dishwashers save water, and I think my water usage has decreased significantly. Just tossing a single detergent in and it dries perfectly is a great convenience for lazy people like me. I just take it out one at a time, use it, run it, and repeat. It's not inconvenient, but in my house, the cord is far away, so I have to connect the dishwasher cord separately. Aside from that, it's only a little noisy. I'm completely satisfied with everything except the fact that it's there. Everyone says it's our new kitchen auntie, and I can totally understand why. It's comfortable and easy to use, just press a button. I truly, truly recommend it. For those of you who are hesitating, stop worrying and just enjoy it. I highly, highly recommend it. It'll make your day truly comfortable. ^^

I'm completely satisfied with everything except the fact that it's there. Everyone says it's our new kitchen auntie, and I can totally understand why. It's comfortable and easy to use, just press a button. I truly, truly recommend it. For those of you who are hesitating, stop worrying and just enjoy it. I highly, highly recommend it. It'll make your day truly comfortable. ^^

Comments (English): [ A must-have for the kitchen! ] || ---------------- || This review was written after receiving a free dishwasher as part of a Coupang Experience Group event. I've been married for over ten years without a dishwasher. It's a bit late, but I'm finally getting around to using it, so I wanted to share how great it is. I've been writing this review for the past week, meticulously, meticulously, and thoroughly. Easy Installation: First of all, since it's not a built-in dishwasher, installation is a breeze. Simply drill a hole for the water purifier, plug it in, and you're done. The hole isn't too big, and since our existing water purifier was already there, we plugged it in. As long as you have enough space, installation wasn't difficult. Since you need to use it right after washing dishes, a location close to the dishwasher is ideal. Cleaning Power: This was my first time using a household dishwasher, so I was a bit skeptical about its cleaning performance. I tried it with just a bowl of ramen and rinsed it with water. It was surprisingly clean, spotless, and the dishes sparkled. No matter how much I washed and rinsed it by hand, it was incredibly clean. It's not only clean, but it's also sterilized, so I'm confident I can even use it with my kids' dishes. The washing time is set to the default. I just press the play button without pressing the right button. The default setting is 65 degrees for 65 minutes. During that time, the dishwasher is fully cleaned, sterilized, and dried. It may seem like a long time, but since I just collect the dishes, larvae them, and run the dishwasher right away, I can do other things, take a break, or go out during that time. It's finished, and it's open on its own. It's spacious, and since it's designed for six people, I was worried the washing space inside would be small, but it actually has two levels. The upper level is for cups, and the lower level is for wide, tall dishes. The lower basket adjusts to fit the dishes. It seems like a perfect size for our family of four to use after meals. I'm a bit sensitive to noise, but I didn't really notice it except in the middle of the night. It only makes a loud noise when it's emptying or something. At other times, it's drowned out by the TV, so I don't even notice it. Having a dishwasher has always been so convenient, I wonder why no one told me about it. It was always hard to get home from work, take care of the kids, and clean up afterward, but using a dishwasher feels like I've gained some freedom, and my quality of life has improved a little. ^^ If your kitchen is a little small, the volume can feel a bit large. Having an appliance that I never had before take up one corner of the kitchen can feel a bit cramped, but I've gotten used to it and it feels so comfortable that the volume doesn't matter at all. If you're wondering, "Will this be possible?", I definitely recommend trying it. The time I spent worrying about it was so worth it, and since it's not a built-in unit, it's affordable. I can even take it with me when I move. ^^ They say dishwashers save water, and I think my water usage has decreased significantly. Just tossing a single detergent in and it dries perfectly is a great convenience for lazy people like me. I just take it out one at a time, use it, run it, and repeat. It's not inconvenient, but in my house, the cord is far away, so I have to connect the dishwasher cord separately. Aside from that, it's only a little noisy. I'm completely satisfied with everything except the fact that it's there. Everyone says it's our new kitchen auntie, and I can totally understand why. It's comfortable and easy to use, just press a button. I truly, truly recommend it. For those of you who are hesitating, stop worrying and just enjoy it. I highly, highly recommend it. It'll make your day truly comfortable. ^^

Sentence (English): Having an appliance that I never had before take up one corner of the kitchen can feel a bit cramped, but I've gotten used to it and it feels so comfortable that the volume doesn't matter at all.
Comments (English): [ A must-have for the kitchen! ] || ---------------- || This review was written after receiving a free dishwasher as part of a Coupang Experience Group event. I've been married for over ten years without a dishwasher. It's a bit late, but I'm finally getting around to using it, so I wanted to share how great it is. I've been writing this review for the past week, meticulously, meticulously, and thoroughly. Easy Installation: First of all, since it's not a built-in dishwasher, installation is a breeze. Simply drill a hole for the water purifier, plug it in, and you're done. The hole isn't too big, and since our existing water purifier was already there, we plugged it in. As long as you have enough space, installation wasn't difficult. Since you need to use it right after washing dishes, a location close to the dishwasher is ideal. Cleaning Power: This was my first time using a household dishwasher, so I was a bit skeptical about its cleaning performance. I tried it with just a bowl of ramen and rinsed it with water. It was surprisingly clean, spotless, and the dishes sparkled. No matter how much I washed and rinsed it by hand, it was incredibly clean. It's not only clean, but it's also sterilized, so I'm confident I can even use it with my kids' dishes. The washing time is set to the default. I just press the play button without pressing the right button. The default setting is 65 degrees for 65 minutes. During that time, the dishwasher is fully cleaned, sterilized, and dried. It may seem like a long time, but since I just collect the dishes, larvae them, and run the dishwasher right away, I can do other things, take a break, or go out during that time. It's finished, and it's open on its own. It's spacious, and since it's designed for six people, I was worried the washing space inside would be small, but it actually has two levels. The upper level is for cups, and the lower level is for wide, tall dishes. The lower basket adjusts to fit the dishes. It seems like a perfect size for our family of four to use after meals. I'm a bit sensitive to noise, but I didn't really notice it except in the middle of the night. It only makes a loud noise when it's emptying or something. At other times, it's drowned out by the TV, so I don't even notice it. Having a dishwasher has always been so convenient, I wonder why no one told me about it. It was always hard to get home from work, take care of the kids, and clean up afterward, but using a dishwasher feels like I've gained some freedom, and my quality of life has improved a little. ^^ If your kitchen is a little small, the volume can feel a bit large. Having an appliance that I never had before take up one corner of the kitchen can feel a bit cramped, but I've gotten used to it and it feels so comfortable that the volume doesn't matter at all. If you're wondering, "Will this be possible?", I definitely recommend trying it. The time I spent worrying about it was so worth it, and since it's not a built-in unit, it's affordable. I can even take it with me when I move. ^^ They say dishwashers save water, and I think my water usage has decreased significantly. Just tossing a single detergent in and it dries perfectly is a great convenience for lazy people like me. I just take it out one at a time, use it, run it, and repeat. It's not inconvenient, but in my house, the cord is far away, so I have to connect the dishwasher cord separately. Aside from that, it's only a little noisy. I'm completely satisfied with everything except the fact that it's there. Everyone says it's our new kitchen auntie, and I can totally understand why. It's comfortable and easy to use, just press a button. I truly, truly recommend it. For those of you who are hesitating, stop worrying and just enjoy it. I highly, highly recommend it. It'll make your day truly comfortable. ^^

Comments (English): [ A must-have for the kitchen! ] || ---------------- || This review was written after receiving a free dishwasher as part of a Coupang Experience Group event. I've been married for over ten years without a dishwasher. It's a bit late, but I'm finally getting around to using it, so I wanted to share how great it is. I've been writing this review for the past week, meticulously, meticulously, and thoroughly. Easy Installation: First of all, since it's not a built-in dishwasher, installation is a breeze. Simply drill a hole for the water purifier, plug it in, and you're done. The hole isn't too big, and since our existing water purifier was already there, we plugged it in. As long as you have enough space, installation wasn't difficult. Since you need to use it right after washing dishes, a location close to the dishwasher is ideal. Cleaning Power: This was my first time using a household dishwasher, so I was a bit skeptical about its cleaning performance. I tried it with just a bowl of ramen and rinsed it with water. It was surprisingly clean, spotless, and the dishes sparkled. No matter how much I washed and rinsed it by hand, it was incredibly clean. It's not only clean, but it's also sterilized, so I'm confident I can even use it with my kids' dishes. The washing time is set to the default. I just press the play button without pressing the right button. The default setting is 65 degrees for 65 minutes. During that time, the dishwasher is fully cleaned, sterilized, and dried. It may seem like a long time, but since I just collect the dishes, larvae them, and run the dishwasher right away, I can do other things, take a break, or go out during that time. It's finished, and it's open on its own. It's spacious, and since it's designed for six people, I was worried the washing space inside would be small, but it actually has two levels. The upper level is for cups, and the lower level is for wide, tall dishes. The lower basket adjusts to fit the dishes. It seems like a perfect size for our family of four to use after meals. I'm a bit sensitive to noise, but I didn't really notice it except in the middle of the night. It only makes a loud noise when it's emptying or something. At other times, it's drowned out by the TV, so I don't even notice it. Having a dishwasher has always been so convenient, I wonder why no one told me about it. It was always hard to get home from work, take care of the kids, and clean up afterward, but using a dishwasher feels like I've gained some freedom, and my quality of life has improved a little. ^^ If your kitchen is a little small, the volume can feel a bit large. Having an appliance that I never had before take up one corner of the kitchen can feel a bit cramped, but I've gotten used to it and it feels so comfortable that the volume doesn't matter at all. If you're wondering, "Will this be possible?", I definitely recommend trying it. The time I spent worrying about it was so worth it, and since it's not a built-in unit, it's affordable. I can even take it with me when I move. ^^ They say dishwashers save water, and I think my water usage has decreased significantly. Just tossing a single detergent in and it dries perfectly is a great convenience for lazy people like me. I just take it out one at a time, use it, run it, and repeat. It's not inconvenient, but in my house, the cord is far away, so I have to connect the dishwasher cord separately. Aside from that, it's only a little noisy. I'm completely satisfied with everything except the fact that it's there. Everyone says it's our new kitchen auntie, and I can totally understand why. It's comfortable and easy to use, just press a button. I truly, truly recommend it. For those of you who are hesitating, stop worrying and just enjoy it. I highly, highly recommend it. It'll make your day truly comfortable. ^^

Comments (English): [ A must-have for the kitchen! ] || ---------------- || This review was written after receiving a free dishwasher as part of a Coupang Experience Group event. I've been writing this review for the past week, meticulously, meticulously, and thoroughly. Easy Installation: First of all, since it's not a built-in dishwasher, installation is a breeze. It's not only clean, but it's also sterilized, so I'm confident I can even use it with my kids' dishes. The washing time is set to the default. I just press the play button without pressing the right button. The default setting is 65 degrees for 65 minutes. During that time, the dishwasher is fully cleaned, sterilized, and dried. It may seem like a long time, but since I just collect the dishes, larvae them, and run the dishwasher right away, I can do other things, take a break, or go out during that time. The upper level is for cups, and the lower level is for wide, tall dishes. The lower basket adjusts to fit the dishes. It seems like a perfect size for our family of four to use after meals. I'm a bit sensitive to noise, but I didn't really notice it except in the middle of the night. It only makes a loud noise when it's emptying or something. At other times, it's drowned out by the TV, so I don't even notice it. Having a dishwasher has always been so convenient, I wonder why no one told me about it. If you're wondering, "Will this be possible?", I definitely recommend trying it. The time I spent worrying about it was so worth it, and since it's not a built-in unit, it's affordable. I can even take it with me when I move. ^^ They say dishwashers save water, and I think my water usage has decreased significantly. Just tossing a single detergent in and it dries perfectly is a great convenience for lazy people like me. I just take it out one at a time, use it, run it, and repeat. It's not inconvenient, but in my house, the cord is far away, so I have to connect the dishwasher cord separately. Aside from that, it's only a little noisy. I'm completely satisfied with everything except the fact that it's there. Everyone says it's our new kitchen auntie, and I can totally understand why. It's comfortable and easy to use, just press a button. I truly, truly recommend it. For those of you who are hesitating, stop worrying and just enjoy it. I highly, highly recommend it. It'll make your day truly comfortable. ^^

I'm completely satisfied with everything except the fact that it's there. Everyone says it's our new kitchen auntie, and I can totally understand why. It's comfortable and easy to use, just press a button. I truly, truly recommend it. For those of you who are hesitating, stop worrying and just enjoy it. I highly, highly recommend it. It'll make your day truly comfortable. ^^

It's not only clean, but it's also sterilized, so I'm confident I can even use it with my kids' dishes. The washing time is set to the default. I just press the play button without pressing the right button. The default setting is 65 degrees for 65 minutes. During that time, the dishwasher is fully cleaned, sterilized, and dried. I'm a bit sensitive to noise, but I didn't really notice it except in the middle of the night. It only makes a loud noise when it's emptying or something. At other times, it's drowned out by the TV, so I don't even notice it. Having a dishwasher has always been so convenient, I wonder why no one told me about it. If you're wondering, "Will this be possible?", I definitely recommend trying it. The time I spent worrying about it was so worth it, and since it's not a built-in unit, it's affordable. I can even take it with me when I move. ^^ They say dishwashers save water, and I think my water usage has decreased significantly. Just tossing a single detergent in and it dries perfectly is a great convenience for lazy people like me. I just take it out one at a time, use it, run it, and repeat. It's not inconvenient, but in my house, the cord is far away, so I have to connect the dishwasher cord separately. Aside from that, it's only a little noisy. I'm completely satisfied with everything except the fact that it's there. Everyone says it's our new kitchen auntie, and I can totally understand why. It's comfortable and easy to use, just press a button. I truly, truly recommend it. For those of you who are hesitating, stop worrying and just enjoy it. I highly, highly recommend it. It'll make your day truly comfortable. ^^

It's not only clean, but it's also sterilized, so I'm confident I can even use it with my kids' dishes. The washing time is set to the default. I just press the play button without pressing the right button. The default setting is 65 degrees for 65 minutes. During that time, the dishwasher is fully cleaned, sterilized, and dried. It may seem like a long time, but since I just collect the dishes, larvae them, and run the dishwasher right away, I can do other things, take a break, or go out during that time. I'm a bit sensitive to noise, but I didn't really notice it except in the middle of the night. It only makes a loud noise when it's emptying or something. At other times, it's drowned out by the TV, so I don't even notice it. Having a dishwasher has always been so convenient, I wonder why no one told me about it. I can even take it with me when I move. ^^ They say dishwashers save water, and I think my water usage has decreased significantly. Just tossing a single detergent in and it dries perfectly is a great convenience for lazy people like me. I just take it out one at a time, use it, run it, and repeat. It's not inconvenient, but in my house, the cord is far away, so I have to connect the dishwasher cord separately. Aside from that, it's only a little noisy. I'm completely satisfied with everything except the fact that it's there. Everyone says it's our new kitchen auntie, and I can totally understand why. It's comfortable and easy to use, just press a button. I truly, truly recommend it. For those of you who are hesitating, stop worrying and just enjoy it. I highly, highly recommend it. It'll make your day truly comfortable. ^^

Comments (English): [ A must-have for the kitchen! ] || ---------------- || This review was written after receiving a free dishwasher as part of a Coupang Experience Group event. I've been married for over ten years without a dishwasher. It's a bit late, but I'm finally getting around to using it, so I wanted to share how great it is. I've been writing this review for the past week, meticulously, meticulously, and thoroughly. Easy Installation: First of all, since it's not a built-in dishwasher, installation is a breeze. Simply drill a hole for the water purifier, plug it in, and you're done. The hole isn't too big, and since our existing water purifier was already there, we plugged it in. As long as you have enough space, installation wasn't difficult. Since you need to use it right after washing dishes, a location close to the dishwasher is ideal. Cleaning Power: This was my first time using a household dishwasher, so I was a bit skeptical about its cleaning performance. I tried it with just a bowl of ramen and rinsed it with water. It was surprisingly clean, spotless, and the dishes sparkled. No matter how much I washed and rinsed it by hand, it was incredibly clean. It's not only clean, but it's also sterilized, so I'm confident I can even use it with my kids' dishes. The washing time is set to the default. I just press the play button without pressing the right button. The default setting is 65 degrees for 65 minutes. During that time, the dishwasher is fully cleaned, sterilized, and dried. It may seem like a long time, but since I just collect the dishes, larvae them, and run the dishwasher right away, I can do other things, take a break, or go out during that time. It's finished, and it's open on its own. It's spacious, and since it's designed for six people, I was worried the washing space inside would be small, but it actually has two levels. The upper level is for cups, and the lower level is for wide, tall dishes. The lower basket adjusts to fit the dishes. It seems like a perfect size for our family of four to use after meals. I'm a bit sensitive to noise, but I didn't really notice it except in the middle of the night. It only makes a loud noise when it's emptying or something. At other times, it's drowned out by the TV, so I don't even notice it. Having a dishwasher has always been so convenient, I wonder why no one told me about it. It was always hard to get home from work, take care of the kids, and clean up afterward, but using a dishwasher feels like I've gained some freedom, and my quality of life has improved a little. ^^ If your kitchen is a little small, the volume can feel a bit large. Having an appliance that I never had before take up one corner of the kitchen can feel a bit cramped, but I've gotten used to it and it feels so comfortable that the volume doesn't matter at all. If you're wondering, "Will this be possible?", I definitely recommend trying it. The time I spent worrying about it was so worth it, and since it's not a built-in unit, it's affordable. I can even take it with me when I move. ^^ They say dishwashers save water, and I think my water usage has decreased significantly. Just tossing a single detergent in and it dries perfectly is a great convenience for lazy people like me. I just take it out one at a time, use it, run it, and repeat. It's not inconvenient, but in my house, the cord is far away, so I have to connect the dishwasher cord separately. Aside from that, it's only a little noisy. I'm completely satisfied with everything except the fact that it's there. Everyone says it's our new kitchen auntie, and I can totally understand why. It's comfortable and easy to use, just press a button. I truly, truly recommend it. For those of you who are hesitating, stop worrying and just enjoy it. I highly, highly recommend it. It'll make your day truly comfortable. ^^

It's not only clean, but it's also sterilized, so I'm confident I can even use it with my kids' dishes. The washing time is set to the default. It's not inconvenient, but in my house, the cord is far away, so I have to connect the dishwasher cord separately. Aside from that, it's only a little noisy. I'm completely satisfied with everything except the fact that it's there. Everyone says it's our new kitchen auntie, and I can totally understand why. It's comfortable and easy to use, just press a button. I truly, truly recommend it. For those of you who are hesitating, stop worrying and just enjoy it. I highly, highly recommend it. It'll make your day truly comfortable. ^^

Comments (English): [ A must-have for the kitchen! ] || ---------------- || This review was written after receiving a free dishwasher as part of a Coupang Experience Group event. I've been married for over ten years without a dishwasher. It's a bit late, but I'm finally getting around to using it, so I wanted to share how great it is. I've been writing this review for the past week, meticulously, meticulously, and thoroughly. Easy Installation: First of all, since it's not a built-in dishwasher, installation is a breeze. Simply drill a hole for the water purifier, plug it in, and you're done. The hole isn't too big, and since our existing water purifier was already there, we plugged it in. As long as you have enough space, installation wasn't difficult. Since you need to use it right after washing dishes, a location close to the dishwasher is ideal. Cleaning Power: This was my first time using a household dishwasher, so I was a bit skeptical about its cleaning performance. I tried it with just a bowl of ramen and rinsed it with water. It was surprisingly clean, spotless, and the dishes sparkled. No matter how much I washed and rinsed it by hand, it was incredibly clean. It's not only clean, but it's also sterilized, so I'm confident I can even use it with my kids' dishes. The washing time is set to the default. I just press the play button without pressing the right button. The default setting is 65 degrees for 65 minutes. During that time, the dishwasher is fully cleaned, sterilized, and dried. It may seem like a long time, but since I just collect the dishes, larvae them, and run the dishwasher right away, I can do other things, take a break, or go out during that time. It's finished, and it's open on its own. It's spacious, and since it's designed for six people, I was worried the washing space inside would be small, but it actually has two levels. The upper level is for cups, and the lower level is for wide, tall dishes. The lower basket adjusts to fit the dishes. It seems like a perfect size for our family of four to use after meals. I'm a bit sensitive to noise, but I didn't really notice it except in the middle of the night. It only makes a loud noise when it's emptying or something. At other times, it's drowned out by the TV, so I don't even notice it. Having a dishwasher has always been so convenient, I wonder why no one told me about it. It was always hard to get home from work, take care of the kids, and clean up afterward, but using a dishwasher feels like I've gained some freedom, and my quality of life has improved a little. ^^ If your kitchen is a little small, the volume can feel a bit large. Having an appliance that I never had before take up one corner of the kitchen can feel a bit cramped, but I've gotten used to it and it feels so comfortable that the volume doesn't matter at all. If you're wondering, "Will this be possible?", I definitely recommend trying it. The time I spent worrying about it was so worth it, and since it's not a built-in unit, it's affordable. I can even take it with me when I move. ^^ They say dishwashers save water, and I think my water usage has decreased significantly. Just tossing a single detergent in and it dries perfectly is a great convenience for lazy people like me. I just take it out one at a time, use it, run it, and repeat. It's not inconvenient, but in my house, the cord is far away, so I have to connect the dishwasher cord separately. Aside from that, it's only a little noisy. I'm completely satisfied with everything except the fact that it's there. Everyone says it's our new kitchen auntie, and I can totally understand why. It's comfortable and easy to use, just press a button. I truly, truly recommend it. For those of you who are hesitating, stop worrying and just enjoy it. I highly, highly recommend it. It'll make your day truly comfortable. ^^

It's not only clean, but it's also sterilized, so I'm confident I can even use it with my kids' dishes. The washing time is set to the default. I just press the play button without pressing the right button. The default setting is 65 degrees for 65 minutes. During that time, the dishwasher is fully cleaned, sterilized, and dried. I'm a bit sensitive to noise, but I didn't really notice it except in the middle of the night. It only makes a loud noise when it's emptying or something. I can even take it with me when I move. ^^ They say dishwashers save water, and I think my water usage has decreased significantly. Just tossing a single detergent in and it dries perfectly is a great convenience for lazy people like me. I just take it out one at a time, use it, run it, and repeat. It's not inconvenient, but in my house, the cord is far away, so I have to connect the dishwasher cord separately. Aside from that, it's only a little noisy. I'm completely satisfied with everything except the fact that it's there. Everyone says it's our new kitchen auntie, and I can totally understand why. It's comfortable and easy to use, just press a button. I truly, truly recommend it. For those of you who are hesitating, stop worrying and just enjoy it. I highly, highly recommend it. It'll make your day truly comfortable. ^^
