Sentence (English): This review was written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event.
Comments (English): [ Please hire a dishwasher lady! ] || ---------------- || This review was written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event. Product Name: Midea Automatic Door Opening Dishwasher (6-Place). Key Points: - Powerful cleaning across upper, middle, and lower levels with 3-stage washing blades. - Slim size allows for installation in narrow spaces. - Ample storage space with 2-tier baskets. - 10mm cutout area to minimize installation burden. - 3 pastel colors. - Automatic door opening function eliminates worries about moisture and odors. User Review: Hello! I recently installed the Midea Automatic Door Opening Dishwasher (6-Place) at my parents' house. We currently use an SK Magic 6-place dishwasher at our home, and it seems like this is the exact same product, just a different brand. I was so satisfied with the SK Magic product that I wanted to install one for my parents' house as well, but they aren't selling it anymore. However, this Midea Automatic Door Opening Dishwasher is exactly the same, just with a different brand name. So, I installed it for my parents right away. One of the best things about using this dishwasher is that, thanks to its two-tier basket, it can hold more dishes than other 6-place setting models. It is incredibly efficient because you can remove the second-tier basket and run the cycle with large dishes placed on the first tier. Also, since my home is a rented apartment, I couldn't install a built-in dishwasher. However, this Midea 6-place setting dishwasher takes up very little space, and a huge advantage is that if you install it with the side-opening lid like I did, you can place it even in a narrow sink area with just 34.5cm of space. I had the side-opening lid installed and moved the dish drying rack, which was originally attached under the upper cabinet, slightly to the side. I asked the technician, and I was so grateful that he took care of moving the rack for me. There are four different cycles, so you can choose the one that best suits your needs. It is especially convenient that you can add dishes even while the wash cycle is in progress. And the most essential feature of a dishwasher is the automatic door opening function! Once the cycle is finished, the door opens automatically, allowing the dishes to dry on their own. The noise is relatively quiet in the early and middle stages, and about 10 minutes before finishing, it sounds about the same as a washing machine. I am so satisfied that I recommend this Midea dishwasher to anyone who doesn't have one! Overall review. Product recommendation intent.

Sentence (English): This review was written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event.
Comments (English): [ A must-have for the kitchen! ] || ---------------- || This review was written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event. I lived without a dishwasher for over ten years after getting married. Although it feels a bit late, I am leaving this review to let you know just how good it is now that I have finally gotten to use it. I will write a detailed, picky, and comprehensive review based on my experience over the past two weeks. Simple Installation. First of all, since it is not a built-in type, installation is very simple. You just need to drill a hole where the water purifier plugs in, connect it immediately, and plug in the cord—that’s it. The hole isn't very big, and since we had our existing water purifier plugged in there, we just plugged it right in. As long as you have enough space to place it, installation wasn't difficult at all. Since you need to put the dishes in immediately after washing them, having it close by is the most convenient location. Cleaning Power. Since this is my first time using a home dishwasher, I was skeptical about how well it would clean. I tried using it after cooking a bowl of ramen and rinsing it with only water. I wondered if it would clean well, but the dishes came out incredibly clean, without a single stain, and sparkling. It was a level of cleanliness that I couldn't achieve no matter how thoroughly I washed and rinsed them by hand. Not only is it clean, but it also sterilizes everything, so I feel safe washing my children's dishes along with it. Washing Time. The time is set by default. I use it by pressing only the play button, without using the shortcut button. It is set to 65 degrees Celsius by default and for 65 minutes. During that time, it completes washing, sterilization, and drying. The time might feel a bit long, but since you just need to gather the dishes after a meal, pre-wash them, and run the dishwasher immediately, it finishes by the time you do other things, rest, or go out, and it opens on its own. Spacious interior. I was worried that the washing space inside might be small since it is a 6-place setting, but the dishwasher has a two-tiered structure. You place cups on the top tier and wide, tall dishes on the bottom. The bottom basket moves in and out when pressed, so you can adjust it to suit your dish usage. It seems like a very good size for our family of four to use after meals. Noise. I tend to be a bit sensitive to noise. However, unless it is the middle of the night, I didn't really notice it while using it. It only makes a loud sound occasionally when emptying items; at other times, the noise is drowned out by the TV, so I don't really notice it running. Now that I've used a dishwasher, I wonder why no one told me how convenient this is. It was always exhausting having to clean the kitchen after taking care of the kids at work, but using the dishwasher has made me feel like I've gained freedom, and my quality of life has definitely improved a bit. If your kitchen is small, it might feel a bit bulky. It felt a little stifling having a new appliance take up a corner of the kitchen, but as I used it, I got used to it and found it so comfortable that the size doesn't matter at all anymore. I highly recommend this to anyone who is skeptical and wondering, "Can this really clean?" I feel like all the time I spent hesitating wasted, and since it's not a built-in model, it's affordable. Plus, you can take it with you if you move. They say dishwashers save water, and I feel like I've reduced my water usage significantly. You just toss in a packet of detergent, and it dries perfectly, making it an even more convenient product for lazy people like me. I just take out items one by one, use them, and run the cycle repeatedly. There aren't any inconveniences, but the power outlet is far away in my house, so I connect the dishwasher's cord separately. Other than that, the noise is just a tiny bit... I am satisfied with everything except for the fact that it is... well, you get the idea. Everyone says it’s like a new kitchen helper has arrived, and I totally understand why. It puts your hands and mind at ease; just press a button and try using it. I genuinely, truly recommend it. If you are hesitating, put your worries aside and just relax. I recommend it a lot. It will make for a truly comfortable day.

Sentence (English): Although it feels a bit late, I am leaving this review to let you know just how good it is now that I have finally gotten to use it.
Comments (English): [ A must-have for the kitchen! ] || ---------------- || This review was written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event. I lived without a dishwasher for over ten years after getting married. Although it feels a bit late, I am leaving this review to let you know just how good it is now that I have finally gotten to use it. I will write a detailed, picky, and comprehensive review based on my experience over the past two weeks. Simple Installation. First of all, since it is not a built-in type, installation is very simple. You just need to drill a hole where the water purifier plugs in, connect it immediately, and plug in the cord—that’s it. The hole isn't very big, and since we had our existing water purifier plugged in there, we just plugged it right in. As long as you have enough space to place it, installation wasn't difficult at all. Since you need to put the dishes in immediately after washing them, having it close by is the most convenient location. Cleaning Power. Since this is my first time using a home dishwasher, I was skeptical about how well it would clean. I tried using it after cooking a bowl of ramen and rinsing it with only water. I wondered if it would clean well, but the dishes came out incredibly clean, without a single stain, and sparkling. It was a level of cleanliness that I couldn't achieve no matter how thoroughly I washed and rinsed them by hand. Not only is it clean, but it also sterilizes everything, so I feel safe washing my children's dishes along with it. Washing Time. The time is set by default. I use it by pressing only the play button, without using the shortcut button. It is set to 65 degrees Celsius by default and for 65 minutes. During that time, it completes washing, sterilization, and drying. The time might feel a bit long, but since you just need to gather the dishes after a meal, pre-wash them, and run the dishwasher immediately, it finishes by the time you do other things, rest, or go out, and it opens on its own. Spacious interior. I was worried that the washing space inside might be small since it is a 6-place setting, but the dishwasher has a two-tiered structure. You place cups on the top tier and wide, tall dishes on the bottom. The bottom basket moves in and out when pressed, so you can adjust it to suit your dish usage. It seems like a very good size for our family of four to use after meals. Noise. I tend to be a bit sensitive to noise. However, unless it is the middle of the night, I didn't really notice it while using it. It only makes a loud sound occasionally when emptying items; at other times, the noise is drowned out by the TV, so I don't really notice it running. Now that I've used a dishwasher, I wonder why no one told me how convenient this is. It was always exhausting having to clean the kitchen after taking care of the kids at work, but using the dishwasher has made me feel like I've gained freedom, and my quality of life has definitely improved a bit. If your kitchen is small, it might feel a bit bulky. It felt a little stifling having a new appliance take up a corner of the kitchen, but as I used it, I got used to it and found it so comfortable that the size doesn't matter at all anymore. I highly recommend this to anyone who is skeptical and wondering, "Can this really clean?" I feel like all the time I spent hesitating wasted, and since it's not a built-in model, it's affordable. Plus, you can take it with you if you move. They say dishwashers save water, and I feel like I've reduced my water usage significantly. You just toss in a packet of detergent, and it dries perfectly, making it an even more convenient product for lazy people like me. I just take out items one by one, use them, and run the cycle repeatedly. There aren't any inconveniences, but the power outlet is far away in my house, so I connect the dishwasher's cord separately. Other than that, the noise is just a tiny bit... I am satisfied with everything except for the fact that it is... well, you get the idea. Everyone says it’s like a new kitchen helper has arrived, and I totally understand why. It puts your hands and mind at ease; just press a button and try using it. I genuinely, truly recommend it. If you are hesitating, put your worries aside and just relax. I recommend it a lot. It will make for a truly comfortable day.

Comments (English): [ A must-have for the kitchen! ] || ---------------- || This review was written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event. I lived without a dishwasher for over ten years after getting married. Although it feels a bit late, I am leaving this review to let you know just how good it is now that I have finally gotten to use it. I will write a detailed, picky, and comprehensive review based on my experience over the past two weeks. Simple Installation. First of all, since it is not a built-in type, installation is very simple. You just need to drill a hole where the water purifier plugs in, connect it immediately, and plug in the cord—that’s it. I wondered if it would clean well, but the dishes came out incredibly clean, without a single stain, and sparkling. It was a level of cleanliness that I couldn't achieve no matter how thoroughly I washed and rinsed them by hand. Not only is it clean, but it also sterilizes everything, so I feel safe washing my children's dishes along with it. Washing Time. The time is set by default. I use it by pressing only the play button, without using the shortcut button. It is set to 65 degrees Celsius by default and for 65 minutes. During that time, it completes washing, sterilization, and drying. The time might feel a bit long, but since you just need to gather the dishes after a meal, pre-wash them, and run the dishwasher immediately, it finishes by the time you do other things, rest, or go out, and it opens on its own. Spacious interior. I was worried that the washing space inside might be small since it is a 6-place setting, but the dishwasher has a two-tiered structure. You place cups on the top tier and wide, tall dishes on the bottom. The bottom basket moves in and out when pressed, so you can adjust it to suit your dish usage. It seems like a very good size for our family of four to use after meals. Noise. I tend to be a bit sensitive to noise. It only makes a loud sound occasionally when emptying items; at other times, the noise is drowned out by the TV, so I don't really notice it running. Now that I've used a dishwasher, I wonder why no one told me how convenient this is. It was always exhausting having to clean the kitchen after taking care of the kids at work, but using the dishwasher has made me feel like I've gained freedom, and my quality of life has definitely improved a bit. If your kitchen is small, it might feel a bit bulky. It felt a little stifling having a new appliance take up a corner of the kitchen, but as I used it, I got used to it and found it so comfortable that the size doesn't matter at all anymore. I highly recommend this to anyone who is skeptical and wondering, "Can this really clean?" I feel like all the time I spent hesitating wasted, and since it's not a built-in model, it's affordable. You just toss in a packet of detergent, and it dries perfectly, making it an even more convenient product for lazy people like me. I just take out items one by one, use them, and run the cycle repeatedly. There aren't any inconveniences, but the power outlet is far away in my house, so I connect the dishwasher's cord separately. Other than that, the noise is just a tiny bit... I am satisfied with everything except for the fact that it is... well, you get the idea. Everyone says it’s like a new kitchen helper has arrived, and I totally understand why. It puts your hands and mind at ease; just press a button and try using it. I genuinely, truly recommend it. If you are hesitating, put your worries aside and just relax. I recommend it a lot. It will make for a truly comfortable day.

Comments (English): [ A must-have for the kitchen! ] || ---------------- || This review was written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event. I lived without a dishwasher for over ten years after getting married. Although it feels a bit late, I am leaving this review to let you know just how good it is now that I have finally gotten to use it. I will write a detailed, picky, and comprehensive review based on my experience over the past two weeks. Simple Installation. First of all, since it is not a built-in type, installation is very simple. You just need to drill a hole where the water purifier plugs in, connect it immediately, and plug in the cord—that’s it. The hole isn't very big, and since we had our existing water purifier plugged in there, we just plugged it right in. As long as you have enough space to place it, installation wasn't difficult at all. Since you need to put the dishes in immediately after washing them, having it close by is the most convenient location. Cleaning Power. Since this is my first time using a home dishwasher, I was skeptical about how well it would clean. I tried using it after cooking a bowl of ramen and rinsing it with only water. I wondered if it would clean well, but the dishes came out incredibly clean, without a single stain, and sparkling. It was a level of cleanliness that I couldn't achieve no matter how thoroughly I washed and rinsed them by hand. Not only is it clean, but it also sterilizes everything, so I feel safe washing my children's dishes along with it. Washing Time. The time is set by default. I use it by pressing only the play button, without using the shortcut button. It is set to 65 degrees Celsius by default and for 65 minutes. During that time, it completes washing, sterilization, and drying. The time might feel a bit long, but since you just need to gather the dishes after a meal, pre-wash them, and run the dishwasher immediately, it finishes by the time you do other things, rest, or go out, and it opens on its own. Spacious interior. I was worried that the washing space inside might be small since it is a 6-place setting, but the dishwasher has a two-tiered structure. You place cups on the top tier and wide, tall dishes on the bottom. The bottom basket moves in and out when pressed, so you can adjust it to suit your dish usage. It seems like a very good size for our family of four to use after meals. Noise. I tend to be a bit sensitive to noise. However, unless it is the middle of the night, I didn't really notice it while using it. It only makes a loud sound occasionally when emptying items; at other times, the noise is drowned out by the TV, so I don't really notice it running. Now that I've used a dishwasher, I wonder why no one told me how convenient this is. It was always exhausting having to clean the kitchen after taking care of the kids at work, but using the dishwasher has made me feel like I've gained freedom, and my quality of life has definitely improved a bit. If your kitchen is small, it might feel a bit bulky. It felt a little stifling having a new appliance take up a corner of the kitchen, but as I used it, I got used to it and found it so comfortable that the size doesn't matter at all anymore. I highly recommend this to anyone who is skeptical and wondering, "Can this really clean?" I feel like all the time I spent hesitating wasted, and since it's not a built-in model, it's affordable. Plus, you can take it with you if you move. They say dishwashers save water, and I feel like I've reduced my water usage significantly. You just toss in a packet of detergent, and it dries perfectly, making it an even more convenient product for lazy people like me. I just take out items one by one, use them, and run the cycle repeatedly. There aren't any inconveniences, but the power outlet is far away in my house, so I connect the dishwasher's cord separately. Other than that, the noise is just a tiny bit... I am satisfied with everything except for the fact that it is... well, you get the idea. Everyone says it’s like a new kitchen helper has arrived, and I totally understand why. It puts your hands and mind at ease; just press a button and try using it. I genuinely, truly recommend it. If you are hesitating, put your worries aside and just relax. I recommend it a lot. It will make for a truly comfortable day.

Comments (English): [ A must-have for the kitchen! ] || ---------------- || This review was written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event. I lived without a dishwasher for over ten years after getting married. Although it feels a bit late, I am leaving this review to let you know just how good it is now that I have finally gotten to use it. I will write a detailed, picky, and comprehensive review based on my experience over the past two weeks. Simple Installation. First of all, since it is not a built-in type, installation is very simple. You just need to drill a hole where the water purifier plugs in, connect it immediately, and plug in the cord—that’s it. The hole isn't very big, and since we had our existing water purifier plugged in there, we just plugged it right in. As long as you have enough space to place it, installation wasn't difficult at all. Since you need to put the dishes in immediately after washing them, having it close by is the most convenient location. Cleaning Power. Since this is my first time using a home dishwasher, I was skeptical about how well it would clean. I tried using it after cooking a bowl of ramen and rinsing it with only water. I wondered if it would clean well, but the dishes came out incredibly clean, without a single stain, and sparkling. It was a level of cleanliness that I couldn't achieve no matter how thoroughly I washed and rinsed them by hand. Not only is it clean, but it also sterilizes everything, so I feel safe washing my children's dishes along with it. Washing Time. The time is set by default. I use it by pressing only the play button, without using the shortcut button. It is set to 65 degrees Celsius by default and for 65 minutes. During that time, it completes washing, sterilization, and drying. The time might feel a bit long, but since you just need to gather the dishes after a meal, pre-wash them, and run the dishwasher immediately, it finishes by the time you do other things, rest, or go out, and it opens on its own. Spacious interior. I was worried that the washing space inside might be small since it is a 6-place setting, but the dishwasher has a two-tiered structure. You place cups on the top tier and wide, tall dishes on the bottom. The bottom basket moves in and out when pressed, so you can adjust it to suit your dish usage. It seems like a very good size for our family of four to use after meals. Noise. I tend to be a bit sensitive to noise. However, unless it is the middle of the night, I didn't really notice it while using it. It only makes a loud sound occasionally when emptying items; at other times, the noise is drowned out by the TV, so I don't really notice it running. Now that I've used a dishwasher, I wonder why no one told me how convenient this is. It was always exhausting having to clean the kitchen after taking care of the kids at work, but using the dishwasher has made me feel like I've gained freedom, and my quality of life has definitely improved a bit. If your kitchen is small, it might feel a bit bulky. It felt a little stifling having a new appliance take up a corner of the kitchen, but as I used it, I got used to it and found it so comfortable that the size doesn't matter at all anymore. I highly recommend this to anyone who is skeptical and wondering, "Can this really clean?" I feel like all the time I spent hesitating wasted, and since it's not a built-in model, it's affordable. Plus, you can take it with you if you move. They say dishwashers save water, and I feel like I've reduced my water usage significantly. You just toss in a packet of detergent, and it dries perfectly, making it an even more convenient product for lazy people like me. I just take out items one by one, use them, and run the cycle repeatedly. There aren't any inconveniences, but the power outlet is far away in my house, so I connect the dishwasher's cord separately. Other than that, the noise is just a tiny bit... I am satisfied with everything except for the fact that it is... well, you get the idea. Everyone says it’s like a new kitchen helper has arrived, and I totally understand why. It puts your hands and mind at ease; just press a button and try using it. I genuinely, truly recommend it. If you are hesitating, put your worries aside and just relax. I recommend it a lot. It will make for a truly comfortable day.

Comments (English): [ A must-have for the kitchen! ] || ---------------- || This review was written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event. I lived without a dishwasher for over ten years after getting married. Although it feels a bit late, I am leaving this review to let you know just how good it is now that I have finally gotten to use it. I will write a detailed, picky, and comprehensive review based on my experience over the past two weeks. Simple Installation. First of all, since it is not a built-in type, installation is very simple. You just need to drill a hole where the water purifier plugs in, connect it immediately, and plug in the cord—that’s it. I wondered if it would clean well, but the dishes came out incredibly clean, without a single stain, and sparkling. It was a level of cleanliness that I couldn't achieve no matter how thoroughly I washed and rinsed them by hand. Not only is it clean, but it also sterilizes everything, so I feel safe washing my children's dishes along with it. Washing Time. The time is set by default. I use it by pressing only the play button, without using the shortcut button. It is set to 65 degrees Celsius by default and for 65 minutes. During that time, it completes washing, sterilization, and drying. The time might feel a bit long, but since you just need to gather the dishes after a meal, pre-wash them, and run the dishwasher immediately, it finishes by the time you do other things, rest, or go out, and it opens on its own. Spacious interior. I was worried that the washing space inside might be small since it is a 6-place setting, but the dishwasher has a two-tiered structure. You place cups on the top tier and wide, tall dishes on the bottom. The bottom basket moves in and out when pressed, so you can adjust it to suit your dish usage. It seems like a very good size for our family of four to use after meals. Noise. I tend to be a bit sensitive to noise. It only makes a loud sound occasionally when emptying items; at other times, the noise is drowned out by the TV, so I don't really notice it running. Now that I've used a dishwasher, I wonder why no one told me how convenient this is. It was always exhausting having to clean the kitchen after taking care of the kids at work, but using the dishwasher has made me feel like I've gained freedom, and my quality of life has definitely improved a bit. If your kitchen is small, it might feel a bit bulky. It felt a little stifling having a new appliance take up a corner of the kitchen, but as I used it, I got used to it and found it so comfortable that the size doesn't matter at all anymore. I highly recommend this to anyone who is skeptical and wondering, "Can this really clean?" I feel like all the time I spent hesitating wasted, and since it's not a built-in model, it's affordable. You just toss in a packet of detergent, and it dries perfectly, making it an even more convenient product for lazy people like me. I just take out items one by one, use them, and run the cycle repeatedly. There aren't any inconveniences, but the power outlet is far away in my house, so I connect the dishwasher's cord separately. Other than that, the noise is just a tiny bit... I am satisfied with everything except for the fact that it is... well, you get the idea. Everyone says it’s like a new kitchen helper has arrived, and I totally understand why. It puts your hands and mind at ease; just press a button and try using it. I genuinely, truly recommend it. If you are hesitating, put your worries aside and just relax. I recommend it a lot. It will make for a truly comfortable day.

Sentence (English): Since this is my first time using a home dishwasher, I was skeptical about how well it would clean.
Comments (English): [ A must-have for the kitchen! ] || ---------------- || This review was written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event. I lived without a dishwasher for over ten years after getting married. Although it feels a bit late, I am leaving this review to let you know just how good it is now that I have finally gotten to use it. I will write a detailed, picky, and comprehensive review based on my experience over the past two weeks. Simple Installation. First of all, since it is not a built-in type, installation is very simple. You just need to drill a hole where the water purifier plugs in, connect it immediately, and plug in the cord—that’s it. The hole isn't very big, and since we had our existing water purifier plugged in there, we just plugged it right in. As long as you have enough space to place it, installation wasn't difficult at all. Since you need to put the dishes in immediately after washing them, having it close by is the most convenient location. Cleaning Power. Since this is my first time using a home dishwasher, I was skeptical about how well it would clean. I tried using it after cooking a bowl of ramen and rinsing it with only water. I wondered if it would clean well, but the dishes came out incredibly clean, without a single stain, and sparkling. It was a level of cleanliness that I couldn't achieve no matter how thoroughly I washed and rinsed them by hand. Not only is it clean, but it also sterilizes everything, so I feel safe washing my children's dishes along with it. Washing Time. The time is set by default. I use it by pressing only the play button, without using the shortcut button. It is set to 65 degrees Celsius by default and for 65 minutes. During that time, it completes washing, sterilization, and drying. The time might feel a bit long, but since you just need to gather the dishes after a meal, pre-wash them, and run the dishwasher immediately, it finishes by the time you do other things, rest, or go out, and it opens on its own. Spacious interior. I was worried that the washing space inside might be small since it is a 6-place setting, but the dishwasher has a two-tiered structure. You place cups on the top tier and wide, tall dishes on the bottom. The bottom basket moves in and out when pressed, so you can adjust it to suit your dish usage. It seems like a very good size for our family of four to use after meals. Noise. I tend to be a bit sensitive to noise. However, unless it is the middle of the night, I didn't really notice it while using it. It only makes a loud sound occasionally when emptying items; at other times, the noise is drowned out by the TV, so I don't really notice it running. Now that I've used a dishwasher, I wonder why no one told me how convenient this is. It was always exhausting having to clean the kitchen after taking care of the kids at work, but using the dishwasher has made me feel like I've gained freedom, and my quality of life has definitely improved a bit. If your kitchen is small, it might feel a bit bulky. It felt a little stifling having a new appliance take up a corner of the kitchen, but as I used it, I got used to it and found it so comfortable that the size doesn't matter at all anymore. I highly recommend this to anyone who is skeptical and wondering, "Can this really clean?" I feel like all the time I spent hesitating wasted, and since it's not a built-in model, it's affordable. Plus, you can take it with you if you move. They say dishwashers save water, and I feel like I've reduced my water usage significantly. You just toss in a packet of detergent, and it dries perfectly, making it an even more convenient product for lazy people like me. I just take out items one by one, use them, and run the cycle repeatedly. There aren't any inconveniences, but the power outlet is far away in my house, so I connect the dishwasher's cord separately. Other than that, the noise is just a tiny bit... I am satisfied with everything except for the fact that it is... well, you get the idea. Everyone says it’s like a new kitchen helper has arrived, and I totally understand why. It puts your hands and mind at ease; just press a button and try using it. I genuinely, truly recommend it. If you are hesitating, put your worries aside and just relax. I recommend it a lot. It will make for a truly comfortable day.

I use it by pressing only the play button, without using the shortcut button. It is set to 65 degrees Celsius by default and for 65 minutes. It seems like a very good size for our family of four to use after meals. Noise. I tend to be a bit sensitive to noise. It only makes a loud sound occasionally when emptying items; at other times, the noise is drowned out by the TV, so I don't really notice it running. Now that I've used a dishwasher, I wonder why no one told me how convenient this is. It was always exhausting having to clean the kitchen after taking care of the kids at work, but using the dishwasher has made me feel like I've gained freedom, and my quality of life has definitely improved a bit. Everyone says it’s like a new kitchen helper has arrived, and I totally understand why. It puts your hands and mind at ease; just press a button and try using it. I genuinely, truly recommend it. If you are hesitating, put your worries aside and just relax. I recommend it a lot. It will make for a truly comfortable day.

Sentence (English): Not only is it clean, but it also sterilizes everything, so I feel safe washing my children's dishes along with it.
Comments (English): [ A must-have for the kitchen! ] || ---------------- || This review was written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event. I lived without a dishwasher for over ten years after getting married. Although it feels a bit late, I am leaving this review to let you know just how good it is now that I have finally gotten to use it. I will write a detailed, picky, and comprehensive review based on my experience over the past two weeks. Simple Installation. First of all, since it is not a built-in type, installation is very simple. You just need to drill a hole where the water purifier plugs in, connect it immediately, and plug in the cord—that’s it. The hole isn't very big, and since we had our existing water purifier plugged in there, we just plugged it right in. As long as you have enough space to place it, installation wasn't difficult at all. Since you need to put the dishes in immediately after washing them, having it close by is the most convenient location. Cleaning Power. Since this is my first time using a home dishwasher, I was skeptical about how well it would clean. I tried using it after cooking a bowl of ramen and rinsing it with only water. I wondered if it would clean well, but the dishes came out incredibly clean, without a single stain, and sparkling. It was a level of cleanliness that I couldn't achieve no matter how thoroughly I washed and rinsed them by hand. Not only is it clean, but it also sterilizes everything, so I feel safe washing my children's dishes along with it. Washing Time. The time is set by default. I use it by pressing only the play button, without using the shortcut button. It is set to 65 degrees Celsius by default and for 65 minutes. During that time, it completes washing, sterilization, and drying. The time might feel a bit long, but since you just need to gather the dishes after a meal, pre-wash them, and run the dishwasher immediately, it finishes by the time you do other things, rest, or go out, and it opens on its own. Spacious interior. I was worried that the washing space inside might be small since it is a 6-place setting, but the dishwasher has a two-tiered structure. You place cups on the top tier and wide, tall dishes on the bottom. The bottom basket moves in and out when pressed, so you can adjust it to suit your dish usage. It seems like a very good size for our family of four to use after meals. Noise. I tend to be a bit sensitive to noise. However, unless it is the middle of the night, I didn't really notice it while using it. It only makes a loud sound occasionally when emptying items; at other times, the noise is drowned out by the TV, so I don't really notice it running. Now that I've used a dishwasher, I wonder why no one told me how convenient this is. It was always exhausting having to clean the kitchen after taking care of the kids at work, but using the dishwasher has made me feel like I've gained freedom, and my quality of life has definitely improved a bit. If your kitchen is small, it might feel a bit bulky. It felt a little stifling having a new appliance take up a corner of the kitchen, but as I used it, I got used to it and found it so comfortable that the size doesn't matter at all anymore. I highly recommend this to anyone who is skeptical and wondering, "Can this really clean?" I feel like all the time I spent hesitating wasted, and since it's not a built-in model, it's affordable. Plus, you can take it with you if you move. They say dishwashers save water, and I feel like I've reduced my water usage significantly. You just toss in a packet of detergent, and it dries perfectly, making it an even more convenient product for lazy people like me. I just take out items one by one, use them, and run the cycle repeatedly. There aren't any inconveniences, but the power outlet is far away in my house, so I connect the dishwasher's cord separately. Other than that, the noise is just a tiny bit... I am satisfied with everything except for the fact that it is... well, you get the idea. Everyone says it’s like a new kitchen helper has arrived, and I totally understand why. It puts your hands and mind at ease; just press a button and try using it. I genuinely, truly recommend it. If you are hesitating, put your worries aside and just relax. I recommend it a lot. It will make for a truly comfortable day.

Comments (English): [ A must-have for the kitchen! ] || ---------------- || This review was written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event. I lived without a dishwasher for over ten years after getting married. Although it feels a bit late, I am leaving this review to let you know just how good it is now that I have finally gotten to use it. I will write a detailed, picky, and comprehensive review based on my experience over the past two weeks. Simple Installation. First of all, since it is not a built-in type, installation is very simple. You just need to drill a hole where the water purifier plugs in, connect it immediately, and plug in the cord—that’s it. It was a level of cleanliness that I couldn't achieve no matter how thoroughly I washed and rinsed them by hand. Not only is it clean, but it also sterilizes everything, so I feel safe washing my children's dishes along with it. Washing Time. The time is set by default. I use it by pressing only the play button, without using the shortcut button. It is set to 65 degrees Celsius by default and for 65 minutes. During that time, it completes washing, sterilization, and drying. The time might feel a bit long, but since you just need to gather the dishes after a meal, pre-wash them, and run the dishwasher immediately, it finishes by the time you do other things, rest, or go out, and it opens on its own. Spacious interior. I was worried that the washing space inside might be small since it is a 6-place setting, but the dishwasher has a two-tiered structure. You place cups on the top tier and wide, tall dishes on the bottom. The bottom basket moves in and out when pressed, so you can adjust it to suit your dish usage. It seems like a very good size for our family of four to use after meals. Noise. I tend to be a bit sensitive to noise. It only makes a loud sound occasionally when emptying items; at other times, the noise is drowned out by the TV, so I don't really notice it running. Now that I've used a dishwasher, I wonder why no one told me how convenient this is. It was always exhausting having to clean the kitchen after taking care of the kids at work, but using the dishwasher has made me feel like I've gained freedom, and my quality of life has definitely improved a bit. If your kitchen is small, it might feel a bit bulky. It felt a little stifling having a new appliance take up a corner of the kitchen, but as I used it, I got used to it and found it so comfortable that the size doesn't matter at all anymore. I highly recommend this to anyone who is skeptical and wondering, "Can this really clean?" I feel like all the time I spent hesitating wasted, and since it's not a built-in model, it's affordable. Plus, you can take it with you if you move. They say dishwashers save water, and I feel like I've reduced my water usage significantly. You just toss in a packet of detergent, and it dries perfectly, making it an even more convenient product for lazy people like me. Other than that, the noise is just a tiny bit... I am satisfied with everything except for the fact that it is... well, you get the idea. Everyone says it’s like a new kitchen helper has arrived, and I totally understand why. It puts your hands and mind at ease; just press a button and try using it. I genuinely, truly recommend it. If you are hesitating, put your worries aside and just relax. I recommend it a lot. It will make for a truly comfortable day.

If you are hesitating, put your worries aside and just relax. I recommend it a lot. It will make for a truly comfortable day.

Comments (English): [ A must-have for the kitchen! ] || ---------------- || This review was written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event. I lived without a dishwasher for over ten years after getting married. Although it feels a bit late, I am leaving this review to let you know just how good it is now that I have finally gotten to use it. I will write a detailed, picky, and comprehensive review based on my experience over the past two weeks. Simple Installation. First of all, since it is not a built-in type, installation is very simple. You just need to drill a hole where the water purifier plugs in, connect it immediately, and plug in the cord—that’s it. The hole isn't very big, and since we had our existing water purifier plugged in there, we just plugged it right in. Since this is my first time using a home dishwasher, I was skeptical about how well it would clean. I tried using it after cooking a bowl of ramen and rinsing it with only water. I wondered if it would clean well, but the dishes came out incredibly clean, without a single stain, and sparkling. It was a level of cleanliness that I couldn't achieve no matter how thoroughly I washed and rinsed them by hand. Not only is it clean, but it also sterilizes everything, so I feel safe washing my children's dishes along with it. Washing Time. The time is set by default. I use it by pressing only the play button, without using the shortcut button. It is set to 65 degrees Celsius by default and for 65 minutes. During that time, it completes washing, sterilization, and drying. The time might feel a bit long, but since you just need to gather the dishes after a meal, pre-wash them, and run the dishwasher immediately, it finishes by the time you do other things, rest, or go out, and it opens on its own. Spacious interior. I was worried that the washing space inside might be small since it is a 6-place setting, but the dishwasher has a two-tiered structure. You place cups on the top tier and wide, tall dishes on the bottom. The bottom basket moves in and out when pressed, so you can adjust it to suit your dish usage. It seems like a very good size for our family of four to use after meals. Noise. I tend to be a bit sensitive to noise. However, unless it is the middle of the night, I didn't really notice it while using it. It only makes a loud sound occasionally when emptying items; at other times, the noise is drowned out by the TV, so I don't really notice it running. Now that I've used a dishwasher, I wonder why no one told me how convenient this is. It was always exhausting having to clean the kitchen after taking care of the kids at work, but using the dishwasher has made me feel like I've gained freedom, and my quality of life has definitely improved a bit. If your kitchen is small, it might feel a bit bulky. It felt a little stifling having a new appliance take up a corner of the kitchen, but as I used it, I got used to it and found it so comfortable that the size doesn't matter at all anymore. I highly recommend this to anyone who is skeptical and wondering, "Can this really clean?" I feel like all the time I spent hesitating wasted, and since it's not a built-in model, it's affordable. Plus, you can take it with you if you move. They say dishwashers save water, and I feel like I've reduced my water usage significantly. You just toss in a packet of detergent, and it dries perfectly, making it an even more convenient product for lazy people like me. I just take out items one by one, use them, and run the cycle repeatedly. There aren't any inconveniences, but the power outlet is far away in my house, so I connect the dishwasher's cord separately. Other than that, the noise is just a tiny bit... I am satisfied with everything except for the fact that it is... well, you get the idea. Everyone says it’s like a new kitchen helper has arrived, and I totally understand why. It puts your hands and mind at ease; just press a button and try using it. I genuinely, truly recommend it. If you are hesitating, put your worries aside and just relax. I recommend it a lot. It will make for a truly comfortable day.

Sentence (English): Now that I've used a dishwasher, I wonder why no one told me how convenient this is.
Comments (English): [ A must-have for the kitchen! ] || ---------------- || This review was written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event. I lived without a dishwasher for over ten years after getting married. Although it feels a bit late, I am leaving this review to let you know just how good it is now that I have finally gotten to use it. I will write a detailed, picky, and comprehensive review based on my experience over the past two weeks. Simple Installation. First of all, since it is not a built-in type, installation is very simple. You just need to drill a hole where the water purifier plugs in, connect it immediately, and plug in the cord—that’s it. The hole isn't very big, and since we had our existing water purifier plugged in there, we just plugged it right in. As long as you have enough space to place it, installation wasn't difficult at all. Since you need to put the dishes in immediately after washing them, having it close by is the most convenient location. Cleaning Power. Since this is my first time using a home dishwasher, I was skeptical about how well it would clean. I tried using it after cooking a bowl of ramen and rinsing it with only water. I wondered if it would clean well, but the dishes came out incredibly clean, without a single stain, and sparkling. It was a level of cleanliness that I couldn't achieve no matter how thoroughly I washed and rinsed them by hand. Not only is it clean, but it also sterilizes everything, so I feel safe washing my children's dishes along with it. Washing Time. The time is set by default. I use it by pressing only the play button, without using the shortcut button. It is set to 65 degrees Celsius by default and for 65 minutes. During that time, it completes washing, sterilization, and drying. The time might feel a bit long, but since you just need to gather the dishes after a meal, pre-wash them, and run the dishwasher immediately, it finishes by the time you do other things, rest, or go out, and it opens on its own. Spacious interior. I was worried that the washing space inside might be small since it is a 6-place setting, but the dishwasher has a two-tiered structure. You place cups on the top tier and wide, tall dishes on the bottom. The bottom basket moves in and out when pressed, so you can adjust it to suit your dish usage. It seems like a very good size for our family of four to use after meals. Noise. I tend to be a bit sensitive to noise. However, unless it is the middle of the night, I didn't really notice it while using it. It only makes a loud sound occasionally when emptying items; at other times, the noise is drowned out by the TV, so I don't really notice it running. Now that I've used a dishwasher, I wonder why no one told me how convenient this is. It was always exhausting having to clean the kitchen after taking care of the kids at work, but using the dishwasher has made me feel like I've gained freedom, and my quality of life has definitely improved a bit. If your kitchen is small, it might feel a bit bulky. It felt a little stifling having a new appliance take up a corner of the kitchen, but as I used it, I got used to it and found it so comfortable that the size doesn't matter at all anymore. I highly recommend this to anyone who is skeptical and wondering, "Can this really clean?" I feel like all the time I spent hesitating wasted, and since it's not a built-in model, it's affordable. Plus, you can take it with you if you move. They say dishwashers save water, and I feel like I've reduced my water usage significantly. You just toss in a packet of detergent, and it dries perfectly, making it an even more convenient product for lazy people like me. I just take out items one by one, use them, and run the cycle repeatedly. There aren't any inconveniences, but the power outlet is far away in my house, so I connect the dishwasher's cord separately. Other than that, the noise is just a tiny bit... I am satisfied with everything except for the fact that it is... well, you get the idea. Everyone says it’s like a new kitchen helper has arrived, and I totally understand why. It puts your hands and mind at ease; just press a button and try using it. I genuinely, truly recommend it. If you are hesitating, put your worries aside and just relax. I recommend it a lot. It will make for a truly comfortable day.

It was a level of cleanliness that I couldn't achieve no matter how thoroughly I washed and rinsed them by hand. Not only is it clean, but it also sterilizes everything, so I feel safe washing my children's dishes along with it. Washing Time. The time is set by default. I use it by pressing only the play button, without using the shortcut button. It is set to 65 degrees Celsius by default and for 65 minutes. The time might feel a bit long, but since you just need to gather the dishes after a meal, pre-wash them, and run the dishwasher immediately, it finishes by the time you do other things, rest, or go out, and it opens on its own. You place cups on the top tier and wide, tall dishes on the bottom. The bottom basket moves in and out when pressed, so you can adjust it to suit your dish usage. It seems like a very good size for our family of four to use after meals. Noise. I tend to be a bit sensitive to noise. It only makes a loud sound occasionally when emptying items; at other times, the noise is drowned out by the TV, so I don't really notice it running. Now that I've used a dishwasher, I wonder why no one told me how convenient this is. It was always exhausting having to clean the kitchen after taking care of the kids at work, but using the dishwasher has made me feel like I've gained freedom, and my quality of life has definitely improved a bit. Everyone says it’s like a new kitchen helper has arrived, and I totally understand why. It puts your hands and mind at ease; just press a button and try using it. I genuinely, truly recommend it. If you are hesitating, put your worries aside and just relax. I recommend it a lot. It will make for a truly comfortable day.

Comments (English): [ A must-have for the kitchen! ] || ---------------- || This review was written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event. I lived without a dishwasher for over ten years after getting married. Although it feels a bit late, I am leaving this review to let you know just how good it is now that I have finally gotten to use it. I will write a detailed, picky, and comprehensive review based on my experience over the past two weeks. Simple Installation. First of all, since it is not a built-in type, installation is very simple. You just need to drill a hole where the water purifier plugs in, connect it immediately, and plug in the cord—that’s it. The hole isn't very big, and since we had our existing water purifier plugged in there, we just plugged it right in. As long as you have enough space to place it, installation wasn't difficult at all. Since you need to put the dishes in immediately after washing them, having it close by is the most convenient location. Cleaning Power. Since this is my first time using a home dishwasher, I was skeptical about how well it would clean. I tried using it after cooking a bowl of ramen and rinsing it with only water. I wondered if it would clean well, but the dishes came out incredibly clean, without a single stain, and sparkling. It was a level of cleanliness that I couldn't achieve no matter how thoroughly I washed and rinsed them by hand. Not only is it clean, but it also sterilizes everything, so I feel safe washing my children's dishes along with it. Washing Time. The time is set by default. I use it by pressing only the play button, without using the shortcut button. It is set to 65 degrees Celsius by default and for 65 minutes. During that time, it completes washing, sterilization, and drying. The time might feel a bit long, but since you just need to gather the dishes after a meal, pre-wash them, and run the dishwasher immediately, it finishes by the time you do other things, rest, or go out, and it opens on its own. Spacious interior. I was worried that the washing space inside might be small since it is a 6-place setting, but the dishwasher has a two-tiered structure. You place cups on the top tier and wide, tall dishes on the bottom. The bottom basket moves in and out when pressed, so you can adjust it to suit your dish usage. It seems like a very good size for our family of four to use after meals. Noise. I tend to be a bit sensitive to noise. However, unless it is the middle of the night, I didn't really notice it while using it. It only makes a loud sound occasionally when emptying items; at other times, the noise is drowned out by the TV, so I don't really notice it running. Now that I've used a dishwasher, I wonder why no one told me how convenient this is. It was always exhausting having to clean the kitchen after taking care of the kids at work, but using the dishwasher has made me feel like I've gained freedom, and my quality of life has definitely improved a bit. If your kitchen is small, it might feel a bit bulky. It felt a little stifling having a new appliance take up a corner of the kitchen, but as I used it, I got used to it and found it so comfortable that the size doesn't matter at all anymore. I highly recommend this to anyone who is skeptical and wondering, "Can this really clean?" I feel like all the time I spent hesitating wasted, and since it's not a built-in model, it's affordable. Plus, you can take it with you if you move. They say dishwashers save water, and I feel like I've reduced my water usage significantly. You just toss in a packet of detergent, and it dries perfectly, making it an even more convenient product for lazy people like me. I just take out items one by one, use them, and run the cycle repeatedly. There aren't any inconveniences, but the power outlet is far away in my house, so I connect the dishwasher's cord separately. Other than that, the noise is just a tiny bit... I am satisfied with everything except for the fact that it is... well, you get the idea. Everyone says it’s like a new kitchen helper has arrived, and I totally understand why. It puts your hands and mind at ease; just press a button and try using it. I genuinely, truly recommend it. If you are hesitating, put your worries aside and just relax. I recommend it a lot. It will make for a truly comfortable day.

Now that I've used a dishwasher, I wonder why no one told me how convenient this is. If you are hesitating, put your worries aside and just relax. I recommend it a lot. It will make for a truly comfortable day.

If you are hesitating, put your worries aside and just relax. I recommend it a lot. It will make for a truly comfortable day.

Sentence (English): We have a 2-place setting dishwasher at home, but my sister, who is preparing to move, visited and tried it out.
Comments (English): [ Review of the dishwasher I bought with my own money~! ] || ---------------- || We have a 2-place setting dishwasher at home, but my sister, who is preparing to move, visited and tried it out. She asked me to buy her one as a housewarming gift, so I purchased it. After using dishwashers, refrigerators, and dryers myself, I found that the bigger the better. Even though I live alone, I wish my dishwasher were bigger; I figured my sister would feel the same way later, so I ordered a 6-place setting model for her in advance. My boyfriend's mom uses this Samsung Bespoke model herself and recommended it, saying it is sturdy and works perfectly without any issues for about two years. She mentioned that the interior is more spacious than identical 6-place setting dishwashers from other brands, allowing you to detach and wash small frying pans or even gas range hoods. The interior is also made of stainless steel, so the noise from the high-pressure water hitting the walls during operation is quieter than with our current model. The filter screen is also easily detachable for cleaning, and since it uses high-temperature water, even greasy dishes are cleaned thoroughly. My sister has a baby, so she dries the dishes without using a rinse aid, but my boyfriend's mom says that adding the rinse aid makes the dishes shine and dries them faster. After about a month of use, a musty smell might develop inside the dishwasher; in that case, you can use the dishwasher's internal cleaning cloth, or wash the dishes with citric acid powder mixed with vinegar to completely eliminate the odor. My dishwasher doesn't have an automatic door opening feature, but I'm so envious of the Samsung Bespoke model. Thanks to this feature, you just press a button after breakfast and leave, and the dishes will dry automatically by the time you get home. I really want to buy a house soon so I can switch to a Samsung product too.
Comments (Original): [ 내돈 내산 식기세척기 후기~!! ] || ---------------- || 저희집에는 2인용 식기세척기가 있는데, 이사 준비중인 언니가 저희 집에 놀러왔다가 한번써보고는 집들이 선물로 식기세척기를 사달라고 하길래 구매했어요식기세척기, 냉장고, 건조기는 직접 써보니 크면 클수록 좋더라구요저는 1인 가구 인데도 식기세척기가 더 컸으면 좋겠는데, 저희 언니도 나중에 그런 생각을 할것같아서 미리미리 6인용으로 시켜줬습니다 ㅎ이 삼성 비스포크 제품은 남자친구네 엄마가 직접 쓰고 계시는데, 2년정도 썼는데 아직 문제없이 튼튼하다며 추천해주신 제품이에요다른 브랜드의 똑같은 6인용 식기세척기 보다 내부가 넓게 나와서 작은 후라이팬이나 가스 후드기도 분리 후 세척이 가능하다고 말씀해 주셨어요^^식기세척기 내부도 스텐으로 되어있어서 세척기 작동시 고압수가 벽면에 부딪힐때 나는 소음도 저희 집 제품보다 적네요필터 거름망도 다 손쉽게 분리해서 세척할 수 있고, 고온수로 세척이 되니 기름범벅인 접시도 깔끔히 세척되네요ㅎㅎ언니네는 애기가 있어서 린스기를 사용 안하고 건조시키지만, 남자친구 엄마네는 린스기 넣고 건조시키면 접시에 광택이나며 더 빨리 건조된다고 하네요~ 한달정도 쓰다보면 식기세척기 내부에서 쿰쿰한 냄새가 날 수 있는데, 그럴때는 식기세척기 내부 청소포를 이용하셔도 되고, 구연산가루를 식초와 함께 물에  타서 세척해주면 냄새가 싹 사라져요저희 집 식기세척기는 자동문열림 기능이 없는데, 삼성 비스포크 제품은 자동 문열림 기능덕분에 아침 밥 먹고 버튼하나만 눌러놓고 나가면 퇴근할때 까지 알아서 건조된다고 하니 너무 부럽네요저도 빨리 집 장만해서 삼성 제품으로 갈아타고 싶네요

Comments (English): [ Easy to install, not impressed with the drying. ] || ---------------- || This replaces a 17 year old Bosch diswasher, which was trouble free it entire life, except for the last four months, as the pump would only operate if you banged on the door. I suspect it was just a failed relay on the controller board. The new unit is much easier to install, the water line (which you have to purchase) connects to a hose pipe fitting at the rear, the electrical line (provided) plugs into the rear, and the waste line also exits the rear. For installation, you pull the diswasher out past the cabinets, connect the electrical, water, and waste lines that emerge from the lower corner of the cabinet that supports the sink, then just push it in while pulling on the lines from under the sink. In operation it is very quiet, does a great job cleaning, but I was disappointed in the drying, dishes are still damp. The door cannot be cracked open, it returns to the shut position. The control button operation seems odd, you swipe to select settings, then close the door, whereupon all lights and indicators are turned off.

Sentence (English): I started with ordering a 500 Bosch dishwasher that was on sale, but after the 3rd one arrived with the same interior cabinet defect I opted for moving up to the 800 series.
Comments (English): [ Lowes customer service stellar, Bosch's not so ] || ---------------- || I started with ordering a 500 Bosch dishwasher that was on sale, but after the 3rd one arrived with the same interior cabinet defect I opted for moving up to the 800 series. Lowes customer service was stellar and I could not imagine what it would have been like dealing with another retailer. They made things right all along the way and took care of the cost difference to move up to the 800. I had a 100 series Bosch for nearly 15 years and it worked very well and that's the only reason I did not switch brands after getting 3 grossly defective 500 series dishwashers. (They all had major bulges in the interior liner near the bottom right door that made the liner protrude past the door seal). I generally like the 800 but really I can not tell much difference in cleaning between it and my 100 series. It is quieter and the floor light is handy. The crystal dry feature does dry things better but not sure if the cost and complexity is worth it. The top rack is also handy and I'm surprised that it does not seem to affect the cleaning of the mid rack. Other than suspect quality control, my main grievance with this dishwasher is it makes you use the app to set a delay function. Almost a deal breaker for me because the app is overly complex and glitchy. One of the problems is adding it to another users phone to control the same dishwasher. You are supposedly able to send an invite, but I have not gotten it to work. If you don't use the delay you'll be fine w/o the app. If I had to do this all over again and I wold probably buy a different brand from Lowes. Given my experience with Bosch customer service and its quality control I dread having a problem with this product. Hopefully it holds up as well as my 100 series did.

My model has a light that shines on the floor to let you know when the washing and drying cycles are through. The results were and continue to be extrarordinary: even the big pot my wife used to make an after-Thanksgiving gumbo came out spotless. I'm just beginning to learn to use all of the wonderful features of this great dishwasher. Thank you, Bosch, for making an applicance truly worth the money. All of the hype about this fine product I heard and read turned out to be true.

Sentence (English): I just replaced my 15 year old Bosch with this one and it has all of the features I loved and more.
Comments (English): [ Great update to the 800 series by Bosch ] || ---------------- || I just replaced my 15 year old Bosch with this one and it has all of the features I loved and more. There is an added feature to the upper utensil rack that allows you to drop it deeper on the edge to place cups and other items in one either side. The scrubbing arm on the bottom gives added strength for deep cleaning. The crystal dry feature is excellent. Lots of cycle choices and I can save a favorite setting. It's even got sound indicators for when it completes a load and the sound level is adjustable (including off). I thought I didn't care about it having an app but now that I'm using it I really appreciate it. There are features like the volume control, time remaining for load completion and energy usage/water consumption to track and make adjustments for future usage. The installation was a breeze thanks to the Costco delivery and installation service and the technician walked me through how to use the control features and was knowledgeable about the machine.

Usually, if you leave it on without realizing that it's done, the heat and moisture will remain and the dishes will be damp and not dry at all. The automatic door opening is the best of the best. It sterilizes at high temperatures and sprays water from the top, bottom, and sides, so it's much cleaner than when I do it by hand. I'm super satisfied. Conclusion I was so, so satisfied with my recent experience using the Media Dishwasher. Sentence (English): The commercial dishwasher I used was long and wide, so it took up a lot of space, but the media dishwasher is small and cute because it looks just like a microwave or oven. (
Comments (English): [ There are people who have never used it, but there is no one who has only used it once. ] || ---------------- || After using commercial dishwashers for over 10 years, I had a great opportunity to try out a home dishwasher, so I used it for about 2 weeks. I will write a review as honestly and candidly as possible. *^^*- It doesn't take up much space. The commercial dishwasher I used was long and wide, so it took up a lot of space, but the media dishwasher is small and cute because it looks just like a microwave or oven. (It's 55cm long.) Fortunately, it doesn't take up as much space as I was worried, so I was able to make room for it in my small kitchen. Installation is very easy. (It seems easy to move) The Rocket installer makes a reservation in advance and visits to install it, but I thought I should know how to do it myself in case something happens, so I asked various questions and watched the installation process carefully. Contrary to my worries, I was glad that I didn't have to drill holes in the sink or kitchen shelves. I was worried that I had to drill holes after seeing the advertisement photos, but it was possible to install it without drilling any holes. (Of course, it doesn't look as neat as it looks ^^) It's also lighter than I thought, and I think I'll be able to move it easily if I want to change the location. I think I'll install it by myself when I move. (You'll need a monkey wrench.) It's much quieter than I thought, whether it's on standby or in use. Since it washes with hot water, I thought there would be a little noise even while it's on standby to maintain the water temperature, but it's just quiet. While commercial dishwashers make a lot of noise while washing dishes, the Media dishwasher doesn't make any annoying or stressful noise, which I really liked. I was surprised at first when I heard the washing time was 65 minutes. Commercial dishwashers usually take 1 minute or 1 minute 30 seconds, so I looked into why there was such a big difference, and it turned out that commercial dishwashers have high-pressure motors or higher water temperatures and send out water pressure and steam. They are made with only one thing in mind for washing, so they make a lot of noise and use a lot of electricity, whereas home dishwashers take size, power consumption, washing power, and noise into consideration, and they also add sterilization and drying functions, so I guess that's why the washing time is longer. The Media dishwasher has 4 washing courses, so you can adjust the time accordingly. The auto-opening feature is the best. Commercial dishwashers and my sister's dishwasher don't automatically open the door when the wash is complete, so the heat and moisture remain inside. But with the Media dishwasher, an alarm sounds when the wash is complete and the door automatically opens with a click. This is a really great feature. Since the door opens automatically, all the heat and moisture is released, which helps dry the dishes more cleanly and fluffily. Usually, if you leave it on without realizing that it's done, the heat and moisture will remain and the dishes will be damp and not dry at all. But with this Media dishwasher, even if you forget to turn it on and don't hear the alarm, there's no problem. It's a convenience and satisfaction that I couldn't live without. Like most modern people, when you're struggling to get by all day, you tend to neglect housework. I always try to be mindful of housework, but after work and dinner, I often think, "I have to do the dishes right away. I have to do the dishes right away," and just let them soak for a day or two. I'm just so exhausted. But since the Media dishwasher came into existence, my life has become so neat and tidy. The world couldn't be better. Whether I have a lot of dishes to wash or not, I just use the cups once and then a new one. After eating leisurely, I gently rinse them and put them in the dishwasher. It does everything for me. The automatic door opening is the best of the best. It sterilizes at high temperatures and sprays water from the top, bottom, and sides, so it's much cleaner than when I do it by hand. I'm super satisfied. Conclusion I was so, so satisfied with my recent experience using the Media Dishwasher. If you don't have a dishwasher at home yet, I highly recommend purchasing and using this Media Dishwasher. I've also highly recommended it to my friends who live alone like me. I should send one to my parents' house, too. I'm serious, but I don't think there's anyone who's never used one, but there's no one who's used one only once. Thank you for reading this long and poorly written post. * When purchasing a Media Dishwasher, also purchase the dishwasher detergent sold by Coupang. Do not use regular dishwashing detergent. This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free as part of a Coupang Experience Group event.

Comments (English): [ There are people who have never used it, but there is no one who has only used it once. ] || ---------------- || After using commercial dishwashers for over 10 years, I had a great opportunity to try out a home dishwasher, so I used it for about 2 weeks. I will write a review as honestly and candidly as possible. *^^*- It doesn't take up much space. The commercial dishwasher I used was long and wide, so it took up a lot of space, but the media dishwasher is small and cute because it looks just like a microwave or oven. (It's 55cm long.) Fortunately, it doesn't take up as much space as I was worried, so I was able to make room for it in my small kitchen. Installation is very easy. (It seems easy to move) The Rocket installer makes a reservation in advance and visits to install it, but I thought I should know how to do it myself in case something happens, so I asked various questions and watched the installation process carefully. Contrary to my worries, I was glad that I didn't have to drill holes in the sink or kitchen shelves. I was worried that I had to drill holes after seeing the advertisement photos, but it was possible to install it without drilling any holes. (Of course, it doesn't look as neat as it looks ^^) It's also lighter than I thought, and I think I'll be able to move it easily if I want to change the location. I think I'll install it by myself when I move. (You'll need a monkey wrench.) It's much quieter than I thought, whether it's on standby or in use. Since it washes with hot water, I thought there would be a little noise even while it's on standby to maintain the water temperature, but it's just quiet. While commercial dishwashers make a lot of noise while washing dishes, the Media dishwasher doesn't make any annoying or stressful noise, which I really liked. I was surprised at first when I heard the washing time was 65 minutes. Commercial dishwashers usually take 1 minute or 1 minute 30 seconds, so I looked into why there was such a big difference, and it turned out that commercial dishwashers have high-pressure motors or higher water temperatures and send out water pressure and steam. They are made with only one thing in mind for washing, so they make a lot of noise and use a lot of electricity, whereas home dishwashers take size, power consumption, washing power, and noise into consideration, and they also add sterilization and drying functions, so I guess that's why the washing time is longer. The Media dishwasher has 4 washing courses, so you can adjust the time accordingly. The auto-opening feature is the best. Commercial dishwashers and my sister's dishwasher don't automatically open the door when the wash is complete, so the heat and moisture remain inside. But with the Media dishwasher, an alarm sounds when the wash is complete and the door automatically opens with a click. This is a really great feature. Since the door opens automatically, all the heat and moisture is released, which helps dry the dishes more cleanly and fluffily. Usually, if you leave it on without realizing that it's done, the heat and moisture will remain and the dishes will be damp and not dry at all. But with this Media dishwasher, even if you forget to turn it on and don't hear the alarm, there's no problem. It's a convenience and satisfaction that I couldn't live without. Like most modern people, when you're struggling to get by all day, you tend to neglect housework. I always try to be mindful of housework, but after work and dinner, I often think, "I have to do the dishes right away. I have to do the dishes right away," and just let them soak for a day or two. I'm just so exhausted. But since the Media dishwasher came into existence, my life has become so neat and tidy. The world couldn't be better. Whether I have a lot of dishes to wash or not, I just use the cups once and then a new one. After eating leisurely, I gently rinse them and put them in the dishwasher. It does everything for me. The automatic door opening is the best of the best. It sterilizes at high temperatures and sprays water from the top, bottom, and sides, so it's much cleaner than when I do it by hand. I'm super satisfied. Conclusion I was so, so satisfied with my recent experience using the Media Dishwasher. If you don't have a dishwasher at home yet, I highly recommend purchasing and using this Media Dishwasher. I've also highly recommended it to my friends who live alone like me. I should send one to my parents' house, too. I'm serious, but I don't think there's anyone who's never used one, but there's no one who's used one only once. Thank you for reading this long and poorly written post. * When purchasing a Media Dishwasher, also purchase the dishwasher detergent sold by Coupang. Do not use regular dishwashing detergent. This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free as part of a Coupang Experience Group event.

The Media dishwasher has 4 washing courses, so you can adjust the time accordingly. The auto-opening feature is the best. Commercial dishwashers and my sister's dishwasher don't automatically open the door when the wash is complete, so the heat and moisture remain inside. But with the Media dishwasher, an alarm sounds when the wash is complete and the door automatically opens with a click. This is a really great feature. Since the door opens automatically, all the heat and moisture is released, which helps dry the dishes more cleanly and fluffily. Usually, if you leave it on without realizing that it's done, the heat and moisture will remain and the dishes will be damp and not dry at all. But with this Media dishwasher, even if you forget to turn it on and don't hear the alarm, there's no problem. It's a convenience and satisfaction that I couldn't live without. Like most modern people, when you're struggling to get by all day, you tend to neglect housework. I always try to be mindful of housework, but after work and dinner, I often think, "I have to do the dishes right away. I have to do the dishes right away," and just let them soak for a day or two. I'm just so exhausted. But since the Media dishwasher came into existence, my life has become so neat and tidy. The world couldn't be better. Whether I have a lot of dishes to wash or not, I just use the cups once and then a new one. After eating leisurely, I gently rinse them and put them in the dishwasher. It does everything for me. The automatic door opening is the best of the best. It sterilizes at high temperatures and sprays water from the top, bottom, and sides, so it's much cleaner than when I do it by hand. I'm super satisfied. Conclusion I was so, so satisfied with my recent experience using the Media Dishwasher. If you don't have a dishwasher at home yet, I highly recommend purchasing and using this Media Dishwasher. I've also highly recommended it to my friends who live alone like me. I should send one to my parents' house, too. I'm serious, but I don't think there's anyone who's never used one, but there's no one who's used one only once. Thank you for reading this long and poorly written post. * When purchasing a Media Dishwasher, also purchase the dishwasher detergent sold by Coupang. Do not use regular dishwashing detergent. This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free as part of a Coupang Experience Group event.
