Comments (English): [ There are people who have never used it, but there is no one who has only used it once. ] || ---------------- || After using commercial dishwashers for over 10 years, I had a great opportunity to try out a home dishwasher, so I used it for about 2 weeks. I will write a review as honestly and candidly as possible. *^^*- It doesn't take up much space. The commercial dishwasher I used was long and wide, so it took up a lot of space, but the media dishwasher is small and cute because it looks just like a microwave or oven. (It's 55cm long.) Fortunately, it doesn't take up as much space as I was worried, so I was able to make room for it in my small kitchen. Installation is very easy. (It seems easy to move) The Rocket installer makes a reservation in advance and visits to install it, but I thought I should know how to do it myself in case something happens, so I asked various questions and watched the installation process carefully. Contrary to my worries, I was glad that I didn't have to drill holes in the sink or kitchen shelves. I was worried that I had to drill holes after seeing the advertisement photos, but it was possible to install it without drilling any holes. (Of course, it doesn't look as neat as it looks ^^) It's also lighter than I thought, and I think I'll be able to move it easily if I want to change the location. I think I'll install it by myself when I move. (You'll need a monkey wrench.) It's much quieter than I thought, whether it's on standby or in use. Since it washes with hot water, I thought there would be a little noise even while it's on standby to maintain the water temperature, but it's just quiet. While commercial dishwashers make a lot of noise while washing dishes, the Media dishwasher doesn't make any annoying or stressful noise, which I really liked. I was surprised at first when I heard the washing time was 65 minutes. Commercial dishwashers usually take 1 minute or 1 minute 30 seconds, so I looked into why there was such a big difference, and it turned out that commercial dishwashers have high-pressure motors or higher water temperatures and send out water pressure and steam. They are made with only one thing in mind for washing, so they make a lot of noise and use a lot of electricity, whereas home dishwashers take size, power consumption, washing power, and noise into consideration, and they also add sterilization and drying functions, so I guess that's why the washing time is longer. The Media dishwasher has 4 washing courses, so you can adjust the time accordingly. The auto-opening feature is the best. Commercial dishwashers and my sister's dishwasher don't automatically open the door when the wash is complete, so the heat and moisture remain inside. But with the Media dishwasher, an alarm sounds when the wash is complete and the door automatically opens with a click. This is a really great feature. Since the door opens automatically, all the heat and moisture is released, which helps dry the dishes more cleanly and fluffily. Usually, if you leave it on without realizing that it's done, the heat and moisture will remain and the dishes will be damp and not dry at all. But with this Media dishwasher, even if you forget to turn it on and don't hear the alarm, there's no problem. It's a convenience and satisfaction that I couldn't live without. Like most modern people, when you're struggling to get by all day, you tend to neglect housework. I always try to be mindful of housework, but after work and dinner, I often think, "I have to do the dishes right away. I have to do the dishes right away," and just let them soak for a day or two. I'm just so exhausted. But since the Media dishwasher came into existence, my life has become so neat and tidy. The world couldn't be better. Whether I have a lot of dishes to wash or not, I just use the cups once and then a new one. After eating leisurely, I gently rinse them and put them in the dishwasher. It does everything for me. The automatic door opening is the best of the best. It sterilizes at high temperatures and sprays water from the top, bottom, and sides, so it's much cleaner than when I do it by hand. I'm super satisfied. Conclusion I was so, so satisfied with my recent experience using the Media Dishwasher. If you don't have a dishwasher at home yet, I highly recommend purchasing and using this Media Dishwasher. I've also highly recommended it to my friends who live alone like me. I should send one to my parents' house, too. I'm serious, but I don't think there's anyone who's never used one, but there's no one who's used one only once. Thank you for reading this long and poorly written post. * When purchasing a Media Dishwasher, also purchase the dishwasher detergent sold by Coupang. Do not use regular dishwashing detergent. This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free as part of a Coupang Experience Group event.

Comments (English): [ There are people who have never used it, but there is no one who has only used it once. ] || ---------------- || After using commercial dishwashers for over 10 years, I had a great opportunity to try out a home dishwasher, so I used it for about 2 weeks. I will write a review as honestly and candidly as possible. *^^*- It doesn't take up much space. The commercial dishwasher I used was long and wide, so it took up a lot of space, but the media dishwasher is small and cute because it looks just like a microwave or oven. (It's 55cm long.) Fortunately, it doesn't take up as much space as I was worried, so I was able to make room for it in my small kitchen. Installation is very easy. (It seems easy to move) The Rocket installer makes a reservation in advance and visits to install it, but I thought I should know how to do it myself in case something happens, so I asked various questions and watched the installation process carefully. Contrary to my worries, I was glad that I didn't have to drill holes in the sink or kitchen shelves. I was worried that I had to drill holes after seeing the advertisement photos, but it was possible to install it without drilling any holes. (Of course, it doesn't look as neat as it looks ^^) It's also lighter than I thought, and I think I'll be able to move it easily if I want to change the location. I think I'll install it by myself when I move. (You'll need a monkey wrench.) It's much quieter than I thought, whether it's on standby or in use. Since it washes with hot water, I thought there would be a little noise even while it's on standby to maintain the water temperature, but it's just quiet. While commercial dishwashers make a lot of noise while washing dishes, the Media dishwasher doesn't make any annoying or stressful noise, which I really liked. I was surprised at first when I heard the washing time was 65 minutes. Commercial dishwashers usually take 1 minute or 1 minute 30 seconds, so I looked into why there was such a big difference, and it turned out that commercial dishwashers have high-pressure motors or higher water temperatures and send out water pressure and steam. They are made with only one thing in mind for washing, so they make a lot of noise and use a lot of electricity, whereas home dishwashers take size, power consumption, washing power, and noise into consideration, and they also add sterilization and drying functions, so I guess that's why the washing time is longer. The Media dishwasher has 4 washing courses, so you can adjust the time accordingly. The auto-opening feature is the best. Commercial dishwashers and my sister's dishwasher don't automatically open the door when the wash is complete, so the heat and moisture remain inside. But with the Media dishwasher, an alarm sounds when the wash is complete and the door automatically opens with a click. This is a really great feature. Since the door opens automatically, all the heat and moisture is released, which helps dry the dishes more cleanly and fluffily. Usually, if you leave it on without realizing that it's done, the heat and moisture will remain and the dishes will be damp and not dry at all. But with this Media dishwasher, even if you forget to turn it on and don't hear the alarm, there's no problem. It's a convenience and satisfaction that I couldn't live without. Like most modern people, when you're struggling to get by all day, you tend to neglect housework. I always try to be mindful of housework, but after work and dinner, I often think, "I have to do the dishes right away. I have to do the dishes right away," and just let them soak for a day or two. I'm just so exhausted. But since the Media dishwasher came into existence, my life has become so neat and tidy. The world couldn't be better. Whether I have a lot of dishes to wash or not, I just use the cups once and then a new one. After eating leisurely, I gently rinse them and put them in the dishwasher. It does everything for me. The automatic door opening is the best of the best. It sterilizes at high temperatures and sprays water from the top, bottom, and sides, so it's much cleaner than when I do it by hand. I'm super satisfied. Conclusion I was so, so satisfied with my recent experience using the Media Dishwasher. If you don't have a dishwasher at home yet, I highly recommend purchasing and using this Media Dishwasher. I've also highly recommended it to my friends who live alone like me. I should send one to my parents' house, too. I'm serious, but I don't think there's anyone who's never used one, but there's no one who's used one only once. Thank you for reading this long and poorly written post. * When purchasing a Media Dishwasher, also purchase the dishwasher detergent sold by Coupang. Do not use regular dishwashing detergent. This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free as part of a Coupang Experience Group event.

Comments (English): [ There are people who have never used it, but there is no one who has only used it once. ] || ---------------- || After using commercial dishwashers for over 10 years, I had a great opportunity to try out a home dishwasher, so I used it for about 2 weeks. I will write a review as honestly and candidly as possible. *^^*- It doesn't take up much space. The commercial dishwasher I used was long and wide, so it took up a lot of space, but the media dishwasher is small and cute because it looks just like a microwave or oven. (It's 55cm long.) Fortunately, it doesn't take up as much space as I was worried, so I was able to make room for it in my small kitchen. Installation is very easy. (It seems easy to move) The Rocket installer makes a reservation in advance and visits to install it, but I thought I should know how to do it myself in case something happens, so I asked various questions and watched the installation process carefully. Contrary to my worries, I was glad that I didn't have to drill holes in the sink or kitchen shelves. I was worried that I had to drill holes after seeing the advertisement photos, but it was possible to install it without drilling any holes. (Of course, it doesn't look as neat as it looks ^^) It's also lighter than I thought, and I think I'll be able to move it easily if I want to change the location. I think I'll install it by myself when I move. (You'll need a monkey wrench.) It's much quieter than I thought, whether it's on standby or in use. Since it washes with hot water, I thought there would be a little noise even while it's on standby to maintain the water temperature, but it's just quiet. While commercial dishwashers make a lot of noise while washing dishes, the Media dishwasher doesn't make any annoying or stressful noise, which I really liked. I was surprised at first when I heard the washing time was 65 minutes. Commercial dishwashers usually take 1 minute or 1 minute 30 seconds, so I looked into why there was such a big difference, and it turned out that commercial dishwashers have high-pressure motors or higher water temperatures and send out water pressure and steam. They are made with only one thing in mind for washing, so they make a lot of noise and use a lot of electricity, whereas home dishwashers take size, power consumption, washing power, and noise into consideration, and they also add sterilization and drying functions, so I guess that's why the washing time is longer. The Media dishwasher has 4 washing courses, so you can adjust the time accordingly. The auto-opening feature is the best. Commercial dishwashers and my sister's dishwasher don't automatically open the door when the wash is complete, so the heat and moisture remain inside. But with the Media dishwasher, an alarm sounds when the wash is complete and the door automatically opens with a click. This is a really great feature. Since the door opens automatically, all the heat and moisture is released, which helps dry the dishes more cleanly and fluffily. Usually, if you leave it on without realizing that it's done, the heat and moisture will remain and the dishes will be damp and not dry at all. But with this Media dishwasher, even if you forget to turn it on and don't hear the alarm, there's no problem. It's a convenience and satisfaction that I couldn't live without. Like most modern people, when you're struggling to get by all day, you tend to neglect housework. I always try to be mindful of housework, but after work and dinner, I often think, "I have to do the dishes right away. I have to do the dishes right away," and just let them soak for a day or two. I'm just so exhausted. But since the Media dishwasher came into existence, my life has become so neat and tidy. The world couldn't be better. Whether I have a lot of dishes to wash or not, I just use the cups once and then a new one. After eating leisurely, I gently rinse them and put them in the dishwasher. It does everything for me. The automatic door opening is the best of the best. It sterilizes at high temperatures and sprays water from the top, bottom, and sides, so it's much cleaner than when I do it by hand. I'm super satisfied. Conclusion I was so, so satisfied with my recent experience using the Media Dishwasher. If you don't have a dishwasher at home yet, I highly recommend purchasing and using this Media Dishwasher. I've also highly recommended it to my friends who live alone like me. I should send one to my parents' house, too. I'm serious, but I don't think there's anyone who's never used one, but there's no one who's used one only once. Thank you for reading this long and poorly written post. * When purchasing a Media Dishwasher, also purchase the dishwasher detergent sold by Coupang. Do not use regular dishwashing detergent. This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free as part of a Coupang Experience Group event.

Sentence (English): The Media dishwasher has 4 washing courses, so you can adjust the time accordingly.
Comments (English): [ There are people who have never used it, but there is no one who has only used it once. ] || ---------------- || After using commercial dishwashers for over 10 years, I had a great opportunity to try out a home dishwasher, so I used it for about 2 weeks. I will write a review as honestly and candidly as possible. *^^*- It doesn't take up much space. The commercial dishwasher I used was long and wide, so it took up a lot of space, but the media dishwasher is small and cute because it looks just like a microwave or oven. (It's 55cm long.) Fortunately, it doesn't take up as much space as I was worried, so I was able to make room for it in my small kitchen. Installation is very easy. (It seems easy to move) The Rocket installer makes a reservation in advance and visits to install it, but I thought I should know how to do it myself in case something happens, so I asked various questions and watched the installation process carefully. Contrary to my worries, I was glad that I didn't have to drill holes in the sink or kitchen shelves. I was worried that I had to drill holes after seeing the advertisement photos, but it was possible to install it without drilling any holes. (Of course, it doesn't look as neat as it looks ^^) It's also lighter than I thought, and I think I'll be able to move it easily if I want to change the location. I think I'll install it by myself when I move. (You'll need a monkey wrench.) It's much quieter than I thought, whether it's on standby or in use. Since it washes with hot water, I thought there would be a little noise even while it's on standby to maintain the water temperature, but it's just quiet. While commercial dishwashers make a lot of noise while washing dishes, the Media dishwasher doesn't make any annoying or stressful noise, which I really liked. I was surprised at first when I heard the washing time was 65 minutes. Commercial dishwashers usually take 1 minute or 1 minute 30 seconds, so I looked into why there was such a big difference, and it turned out that commercial dishwashers have high-pressure motors or higher water temperatures and send out water pressure and steam. They are made with only one thing in mind for washing, so they make a lot of noise and use a lot of electricity, whereas home dishwashers take size, power consumption, washing power, and noise into consideration, and they also add sterilization and drying functions, so I guess that's why the washing time is longer. The Media dishwasher has 4 washing courses, so you can adjust the time accordingly. The auto-opening feature is the best. Commercial dishwashers and my sister's dishwasher don't automatically open the door when the wash is complete, so the heat and moisture remain inside. But with the Media dishwasher, an alarm sounds when the wash is complete and the door automatically opens with a click. This is a really great feature. Since the door opens automatically, all the heat and moisture is released, which helps dry the dishes more cleanly and fluffily. Usually, if you leave it on without realizing that it's done, the heat and moisture will remain and the dishes will be damp and not dry at all. But with this Media dishwasher, even if you forget to turn it on and don't hear the alarm, there's no problem. It's a convenience and satisfaction that I couldn't live without. Like most modern people, when you're struggling to get by all day, you tend to neglect housework. I always try to be mindful of housework, but after work and dinner, I often think, "I have to do the dishes right away. I have to do the dishes right away," and just let them soak for a day or two. I'm just so exhausted. But since the Media dishwasher came into existence, my life has become so neat and tidy. The world couldn't be better. Whether I have a lot of dishes to wash or not, I just use the cups once and then a new one. After eating leisurely, I gently rinse them and put them in the dishwasher. It does everything for me. The automatic door opening is the best of the best. It sterilizes at high temperatures and sprays water from the top, bottom, and sides, so it's much cleaner than when I do it by hand. I'm super satisfied. Conclusion I was so, so satisfied with my recent experience using the Media Dishwasher. If you don't have a dishwasher at home yet, I highly recommend purchasing and using this Media Dishwasher. I've also highly recommended it to my friends who live alone like me. I should send one to my parents' house, too. I'm serious, but I don't think there's anyone who's never used one, but there's no one who's used one only once. Thank you for reading this long and poorly written post. * When purchasing a Media Dishwasher, also purchase the dishwasher detergent sold by Coupang. Do not use regular dishwashing detergent. This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free as part of a Coupang Experience Group event.

I will write a review as honestly and candidly as possible. *^^*- It doesn't take up much space. The commercial dishwasher I used was long and wide, so it took up a lot of space, but the media dishwasher is small and cute because it looks just like a microwave or oven. (It's 55cm long.) Fortunately, it doesn't take up as much space as I was worried, so I was able to make room for it in my small kitchen. Installation is very easy. (It seems easy to move) The Rocket installer makes a reservation in advance and visits to install it, but I thought I should know how to do it myself in case something happens, so I asked various questions and watched the installation process carefully. Contrary to my worries, I was glad that I didn't have to drill holes in the sink or kitchen shelves. I was worried that I had to drill holes after seeing the advertisement photos, but it was possible to install it without drilling any holes. (Of course, it doesn't look as neat as it looks ^^) It's also lighter than I thought, and I think I'll be able to move it easily if I want to change the location. I think I'll install it by myself when I move. (You'll need a monkey wrench.) It's much quieter than I thought, whether it's on standby or in use. Since it washes with hot water, I thought there would be a little noise even while it's on standby to maintain the water temperature, but it's just quiet. While commercial dishwashers make a lot of noise while washing dishes, the Media dishwasher doesn't make any annoying or stressful noise, which I really liked. I was surprised at first when I heard the washing time was 65 minutes. Commercial dishwashers usually take 1 minute or 1 minute 30 seconds, so I looked into why there was such a big difference, and it turned out that commercial dishwashers have high-pressure motors or higher water temperatures and send out water pressure and steam. They are made with only one thing in mind for washing, so they make a lot of noise and use a lot of electricity, whereas home dishwashers take size, power consumption, washing power, and noise into consideration, and they also add sterilization and drying functions, so I guess that's why the washing time is longer. The Media dishwasher has 4 washing courses, so you can adjust the time accordingly. The auto-opening feature is the best. Commercial dishwashers and my sister's dishwasher don't automatically open the door when the wash is complete, so the heat and moisture remain inside. But with the Media dishwasher, an alarm sounds when the wash is complete and the door automatically opens with a click. This is a really great feature. Since the door opens automatically, all the heat and moisture is released, which helps dry the dishes more cleanly and fluffily. Usually, if you leave it on without realizing that it's done, the heat and moisture will remain and the dishes will be damp and not dry at all. But with this Media dishwasher, even if you forget to turn it on and don't hear the alarm, there's no problem. It's a convenience and satisfaction that I couldn't live without. Like most modern people, when you're struggling to get by all day, you tend to neglect housework. I always try to be mindful of housework, but after work and dinner, I often think, "I have to do the dishes right away. I have to do the dishes right away," and just let them soak for a day or two. I'm just so exhausted. But since the Media dishwasher came into existence, my life has become so neat and tidy. The world couldn't be better. Whether I have a lot of dishes to wash or not, I just use the cups once and then a new one. After eating leisurely, I gently rinse them and put them in the dishwasher. It does everything for me. The automatic door opening is the best of the best. It sterilizes at high temperatures and sprays water from the top, bottom, and sides, so it's much cleaner than when I do it by hand. I'm super satisfied. Conclusion I was so, so satisfied with my recent experience using the Media Dishwasher. If you don't have a dishwasher at home yet, I highly recommend purchasing and using this Media Dishwasher. I've also highly recommended it to my friends who live alone like me. I should send one to my parents' house, too. I'm serious, but I don't think there's anyone who's never used one, but there's no one who's used one only once. Thank you for reading this long and poorly written post. * When purchasing a Media Dishwasher, also purchase the dishwasher detergent sold by Coupang. Do not use regular dishwashing detergent. This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free as part of a Coupang Experience Group event.

Sentence (English): But with this Media dishwasher, even if you forget to turn it on and don't hear the alarm, there's no problem.
Comments (English): [ There are people who have never used it, but there is no one who has only used it once. ] || ---------------- || After using commercial dishwashers for over 10 years, I had a great opportunity to try out a home dishwasher, so I used it for about 2 weeks. I will write a review as honestly and candidly as possible. *^^*- It doesn't take up much space. The commercial dishwasher I used was long and wide, so it took up a lot of space, but the media dishwasher is small and cute because it looks just like a microwave or oven. (It's 55cm long.) Fortunately, it doesn't take up as much space as I was worried, so I was able to make room for it in my small kitchen. Installation is very easy. (It seems easy to move) The Rocket installer makes a reservation in advance and visits to install it, but I thought I should know how to do it myself in case something happens, so I asked various questions and watched the installation process carefully. Contrary to my worries, I was glad that I didn't have to drill holes in the sink or kitchen shelves. I was worried that I had to drill holes after seeing the advertisement photos, but it was possible to install it without drilling any holes. (Of course, it doesn't look as neat as it looks ^^) It's also lighter than I thought, and I think I'll be able to move it easily if I want to change the location. I think I'll install it by myself when I move. (You'll need a monkey wrench.) It's much quieter than I thought, whether it's on standby or in use. Since it washes with hot water, I thought there would be a little noise even while it's on standby to maintain the water temperature, but it's just quiet. While commercial dishwashers make a lot of noise while washing dishes, the Media dishwasher doesn't make any annoying or stressful noise, which I really liked. I was surprised at first when I heard the washing time was 65 minutes. Commercial dishwashers usually take 1 minute or 1 minute 30 seconds, so I looked into why there was such a big difference, and it turned out that commercial dishwashers have high-pressure motors or higher water temperatures and send out water pressure and steam. They are made with only one thing in mind for washing, so they make a lot of noise and use a lot of electricity, whereas home dishwashers take size, power consumption, washing power, and noise into consideration, and they also add sterilization and drying functions, so I guess that's why the washing time is longer. The Media dishwasher has 4 washing courses, so you can adjust the time accordingly. The auto-opening feature is the best. Commercial dishwashers and my sister's dishwasher don't automatically open the door when the wash is complete, so the heat and moisture remain inside. But with the Media dishwasher, an alarm sounds when the wash is complete and the door automatically opens with a click. This is a really great feature. Since the door opens automatically, all the heat and moisture is released, which helps dry the dishes more cleanly and fluffily. Usually, if you leave it on without realizing that it's done, the heat and moisture will remain and the dishes will be damp and not dry at all. But with this Media dishwasher, even if you forget to turn it on and don't hear the alarm, there's no problem. It's a convenience and satisfaction that I couldn't live without. Like most modern people, when you're struggling to get by all day, you tend to neglect housework. I always try to be mindful of housework, but after work and dinner, I often think, "I have to do the dishes right away. I have to do the dishes right away," and just let them soak for a day or two. I'm just so exhausted. But since the Media dishwasher came into existence, my life has become so neat and tidy. The world couldn't be better. Whether I have a lot of dishes to wash or not, I just use the cups once and then a new one. After eating leisurely, I gently rinse them and put them in the dishwasher. It does everything for me. The automatic door opening is the best of the best. It sterilizes at high temperatures and sprays water from the top, bottom, and sides, so it's much cleaner than when I do it by hand. I'm super satisfied. Conclusion I was so, so satisfied with my recent experience using the Media Dishwasher. If you don't have a dishwasher at home yet, I highly recommend purchasing and using this Media Dishwasher. I've also highly recommended it to my friends who live alone like me. I should send one to my parents' house, too. I'm serious, but I don't think there's anyone who's never used one, but there's no one who's used one only once. Thank you for reading this long and poorly written post. * When purchasing a Media Dishwasher, also purchase the dishwasher detergent sold by Coupang. Do not use regular dishwashing detergent. This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free as part of a Coupang Experience Group event.

Comments (English): [ There are people who have never used it, but there is no one who has only used it once. ] || ---------------- || After using commercial dishwashers for over 10 years, I had a great opportunity to try out a home dishwasher, so I used it for about 2 weeks. I will write a review as honestly and candidly as possible. *^^*- It doesn't take up much space. The commercial dishwasher I used was long and wide, so it took up a lot of space, but the media dishwasher is small and cute because it looks just like a microwave or oven. (It's 55cm long.) Fortunately, it doesn't take up as much space as I was worried, so I was able to make room for it in my small kitchen. Installation is very easy. (It seems easy to move) The Rocket installer makes a reservation in advance and visits to install it, but I thought I should know how to do it myself in case something happens, so I asked various questions and watched the installation process carefully. Contrary to my worries, I was glad that I didn't have to drill holes in the sink or kitchen shelves. I was worried that I had to drill holes after seeing the advertisement photos, but it was possible to install it without drilling any holes. (Of course, it doesn't look as neat as it looks ^^) It's also lighter than I thought, and I think I'll be able to move it easily if I want to change the location. I think I'll install it by myself when I move. (You'll need a monkey wrench.) It's much quieter than I thought, whether it's on standby or in use. Since it washes with hot water, I thought there would be a little noise even while it's on standby to maintain the water temperature, but it's just quiet. While commercial dishwashers make a lot of noise while washing dishes, the Media dishwasher doesn't make any annoying or stressful noise, which I really liked. I was surprised at first when I heard the washing time was 65 minutes. Commercial dishwashers usually take 1 minute or 1 minute 30 seconds, so I looked into why there was such a big difference, and it turned out that commercial dishwashers have high-pressure motors or higher water temperatures and send out water pressure and steam. They are made with only one thing in mind for washing, so they make a lot of noise and use a lot of electricity, whereas home dishwashers take size, power consumption, washing power, and noise into consideration, and they also add sterilization and drying functions, so I guess that's why the washing time is longer. The Media dishwasher has 4 washing courses, so you can adjust the time accordingly. The auto-opening feature is the best. Commercial dishwashers and my sister's dishwasher don't automatically open the door when the wash is complete, so the heat and moisture remain inside. But with the Media dishwasher, an alarm sounds when the wash is complete and the door automatically opens with a click. This is a really great feature. Since the door opens automatically, all the heat and moisture is released, which helps dry the dishes more cleanly and fluffily. Usually, if you leave it on without realizing that it's done, the heat and moisture will remain and the dishes will be damp and not dry at all. But with this Media dishwasher, even if you forget to turn it on and don't hear the alarm, there's no problem. It's a convenience and satisfaction that I couldn't live without. Like most modern people, when you're struggling to get by all day, you tend to neglect housework. I always try to be mindful of housework, but after work and dinner, I often think, "I have to do the dishes right away. I have to do the dishes right away," and just let them soak for a day or two. I'm just so exhausted. But since the Media dishwasher came into existence, my life has become so neat and tidy. The world couldn't be better. Whether I have a lot of dishes to wash or not, I just use the cups once and then a new one. After eating leisurely, I gently rinse them and put them in the dishwasher. It does everything for me. The automatic door opening is the best of the best. It sterilizes at high temperatures and sprays water from the top, bottom, and sides, so it's much cleaner than when I do it by hand. I'm super satisfied. Conclusion I was so, so satisfied with my recent experience using the Media Dishwasher. If you don't have a dishwasher at home yet, I highly recommend purchasing and using this Media Dishwasher. I've also highly recommended it to my friends who live alone like me. I should send one to my parents' house, too. I'm serious, but I don't think there's anyone who's never used one, but there's no one who's used one only once. Thank you for reading this long and poorly written post. * When purchasing a Media Dishwasher, also purchase the dishwasher detergent sold by Coupang. Do not use regular dishwashing detergent. This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free as part of a Coupang Experience Group event.

Sentence (English): But since the Media dishwasher came into existence, my life has become so neat and tidy.
Comments (English): [ There are people who have never used it, but there is no one who has only used it once. ] || ---------------- || After using commercial dishwashers for over 10 years, I had a great opportunity to try out a home dishwasher, so I used it for about 2 weeks. I will write a review as honestly and candidly as possible. *^^*- It doesn't take up much space. The commercial dishwasher I used was long and wide, so it took up a lot of space, but the media dishwasher is small and cute because it looks just like a microwave or oven. (It's 55cm long.) Fortunately, it doesn't take up as much space as I was worried, so I was able to make room for it in my small kitchen. Installation is very easy. (It seems easy to move) The Rocket installer makes a reservation in advance and visits to install it, but I thought I should know how to do it myself in case something happens, so I asked various questions and watched the installation process carefully. Contrary to my worries, I was glad that I didn't have to drill holes in the sink or kitchen shelves. I was worried that I had to drill holes after seeing the advertisement photos, but it was possible to install it without drilling any holes. (Of course, it doesn't look as neat as it looks ^^) It's also lighter than I thought, and I think I'll be able to move it easily if I want to change the location. I think I'll install it by myself when I move. (You'll need a monkey wrench.) It's much quieter than I thought, whether it's on standby or in use. Since it washes with hot water, I thought there would be a little noise even while it's on standby to maintain the water temperature, but it's just quiet. While commercial dishwashers make a lot of noise while washing dishes, the Media dishwasher doesn't make any annoying or stressful noise, which I really liked. I was surprised at first when I heard the washing time was 65 minutes. Commercial dishwashers usually take 1 minute or 1 minute 30 seconds, so I looked into why there was such a big difference, and it turned out that commercial dishwashers have high-pressure motors or higher water temperatures and send out water pressure and steam. They are made with only one thing in mind for washing, so they make a lot of noise and use a lot of electricity, whereas home dishwashers take size, power consumption, washing power, and noise into consideration, and they also add sterilization and drying functions, so I guess that's why the washing time is longer. The Media dishwasher has 4 washing courses, so you can adjust the time accordingly. The auto-opening feature is the best. Commercial dishwashers and my sister's dishwasher don't automatically open the door when the wash is complete, so the heat and moisture remain inside. But with the Media dishwasher, an alarm sounds when the wash is complete and the door automatically opens with a click. This is a really great feature. Since the door opens automatically, all the heat and moisture is released, which helps dry the dishes more cleanly and fluffily. Usually, if you leave it on without realizing that it's done, the heat and moisture will remain and the dishes will be damp and not dry at all. But with this Media dishwasher, even if you forget to turn it on and don't hear the alarm, there's no problem. It's a convenience and satisfaction that I couldn't live without. Like most modern people, when you're struggling to get by all day, you tend to neglect housework. I always try to be mindful of housework, but after work and dinner, I often think, "I have to do the dishes right away. I have to do the dishes right away," and just let them soak for a day or two. I'm just so exhausted. But since the Media dishwasher came into existence, my life has become so neat and tidy. The world couldn't be better. Whether I have a lot of dishes to wash or not, I just use the cups once and then a new one. After eating leisurely, I gently rinse them and put them in the dishwasher. It does everything for me. The automatic door opening is the best of the best. It sterilizes at high temperatures and sprays water from the top, bottom, and sides, so it's much cleaner than when I do it by hand. I'm super satisfied. Conclusion I was so, so satisfied with my recent experience using the Media Dishwasher. If you don't have a dishwasher at home yet, I highly recommend purchasing and using this Media Dishwasher. I've also highly recommended it to my friends who live alone like me. I should send one to my parents' house, too. I'm serious, but I don't think there's anyone who's never used one, but there's no one who's used one only once. Thank you for reading this long and poorly written post. * When purchasing a Media Dishwasher, also purchase the dishwasher detergent sold by Coupang. Do not use regular dishwashing detergent. This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free as part of a Coupang Experience Group event.

I will write a review as honestly and candidly as possible. *^^*- It doesn't take up much space. The commercial dishwasher I used was long and wide, so it took up a lot of space, but the media dishwasher is small and cute because it looks just like a microwave or oven. (It's 55cm long.) Fortunately, it doesn't take up as much space as I was worried, so I was able to make room for it in my small kitchen. Installation is very easy. (It seems easy to move) The Rocket installer makes a reservation in advance and visits to install it, but I thought I should know how to do it myself in case something happens, so I asked various questions and watched the installation process carefully. Contrary to my worries, I was glad that I didn't have to drill holes in the sink or kitchen shelves. I was worried that I had to drill holes after seeing the advertisement photos, but it was possible to install it without drilling any holes. (Of course, it doesn't look as neat as it looks ^^) It's also lighter than I thought, and I think I'll be able to move it easily if I want to change the location. I think I'll install it by myself when I move. (You'll need a monkey wrench.) It's much quieter than I thought, whether it's on standby or in use. Since it washes with hot water, I thought there would be a little noise even while it's on standby to maintain the water temperature, but it's just quiet. While commercial dishwashers make a lot of noise while washing dishes, the Media dishwasher doesn't make any annoying or stressful noise, which I really liked. I was surprised at first when I heard the washing time was 65 minutes. Commercial dishwashers usually take 1 minute or 1 minute 30 seconds, so I looked into why there was such a big difference, and it turned out that commercial dishwashers have high-pressure motors or higher water temperatures and send out water pressure and steam. They are made with only one thing in mind for washing, so they make a lot of noise and use a lot of electricity, whereas home dishwashers take size, power consumption, washing power, and noise into consideration, and they also add sterilization and drying functions, so I guess that's why the washing time is longer. The Media dishwasher has 4 washing courses, so you can adjust the time accordingly. The auto-opening feature is the best. Commercial dishwashers and my sister's dishwasher don't automatically open the door when the wash is complete, so the heat and moisture remain inside. But with the Media dishwasher, an alarm sounds when the wash is complete and the door automatically opens with a click. This is a really great feature. Since the door opens automatically, all the heat and moisture is released, which helps dry the dishes more cleanly and fluffily. Usually, if you leave it on without realizing that it's done, the heat and moisture will remain and the dishes will be damp and not dry at all. But with this Media dishwasher, even if you forget to turn it on and don't hear the alarm, there's no problem. It's a convenience and satisfaction that I couldn't live without. Like most modern people, when you're struggling to get by all day, you tend to neglect housework. I always try to be mindful of housework, but after work and dinner, I often think, "I have to do the dishes right away. I have to do the dishes right away," and just let them soak for a day or two. I'm just so exhausted. But since the Media dishwasher came into existence, my life has become so neat and tidy. The world couldn't be better. Whether I have a lot of dishes to wash or not, I just use the cups once and then a new one. After eating leisurely, I gently rinse them and put them in the dishwasher. It does everything for me. The automatic door opening is the best of the best. It sterilizes at high temperatures and sprays water from the top, bottom, and sides, so it's much cleaner than when I do it by hand. I'm super satisfied. Conclusion I was so, so satisfied with my recent experience using the Media Dishwasher. If you don't have a dishwasher at home yet, I highly recommend purchasing and using this Media Dishwasher. I've also highly recommended it to my friends who live alone like me. I should send one to my parents' house, too. I'm serious, but I don't think there's anyone who's never used one, but there's no one who's used one only once. Thank you for reading this long and poorly written post. * When purchasing a Media Dishwasher, also purchase the dishwasher detergent sold by Coupang. Do not use regular dishwashing detergent. This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free as part of a Coupang Experience Group event.

Sentence (English): I'm super satisfied.
Comments (English): [ There are people who have never used it, but there is no one who has only used it once. ] || ---------------- || After using commercial dishwashers for over 10 years, I had a great opportunity to try out a home dishwasher, so I used it for about 2 weeks. I will write a review as honestly and candidly as possible. *^^*- It doesn't take up much space. The commercial dishwasher I used was long and wide, so it took up a lot of space, but the media dishwasher is small and cute because it looks just like a microwave or oven. (It's 55cm long.) Fortunately, it doesn't take up as much space as I was worried, so I was able to make room for it in my small kitchen. Installation is very easy. (It seems easy to move) The Rocket installer makes a reservation in advance and visits to install it, but I thought I should know how to do it myself in case something happens, so I asked various questions and watched the installation process carefully. Contrary to my worries, I was glad that I didn't have to drill holes in the sink or kitchen shelves. I was worried that I had to drill holes after seeing the advertisement photos, but it was possible to install it without drilling any holes. (Of course, it doesn't look as neat as it looks ^^) It's also lighter than I thought, and I think I'll be able to move it easily if I want to change the location. I think I'll install it by myself when I move. (You'll need a monkey wrench.) It's much quieter than I thought, whether it's on standby or in use. Since it washes with hot water, I thought there would be a little noise even while it's on standby to maintain the water temperature, but it's just quiet. While commercial dishwashers make a lot of noise while washing dishes, the Media dishwasher doesn't make any annoying or stressful noise, which I really liked. I was surprised at first when I heard the washing time was 65 minutes. Commercial dishwashers usually take 1 minute or 1 minute 30 seconds, so I looked into why there was such a big difference, and it turned out that commercial dishwashers have high-pressure motors or higher water temperatures and send out water pressure and steam. They are made with only one thing in mind for washing, so they make a lot of noise and use a lot of electricity, whereas home dishwashers take size, power consumption, washing power, and noise into consideration, and they also add sterilization and drying functions, so I guess that's why the washing time is longer. The Media dishwasher has 4 washing courses, so you can adjust the time accordingly. The auto-opening feature is the best. Commercial dishwashers and my sister's dishwasher don't automatically open the door when the wash is complete, so the heat and moisture remain inside. But with the Media dishwasher, an alarm sounds when the wash is complete and the door automatically opens with a click. This is a really great feature. Since the door opens automatically, all the heat and moisture is released, which helps dry the dishes more cleanly and fluffily. Usually, if you leave it on without realizing that it's done, the heat and moisture will remain and the dishes will be damp and not dry at all. But with this Media dishwasher, even if you forget to turn it on and don't hear the alarm, there's no problem. It's a convenience and satisfaction that I couldn't live without. Like most modern people, when you're struggling to get by all day, you tend to neglect housework. I always try to be mindful of housework, but after work and dinner, I often think, "I have to do the dishes right away. I have to do the dishes right away," and just let them soak for a day or two. I'm just so exhausted. But since the Media dishwasher came into existence, my life has become so neat and tidy. The world couldn't be better. Whether I have a lot of dishes to wash or not, I just use the cups once and then a new one. After eating leisurely, I gently rinse them and put them in the dishwasher. It does everything for me. The automatic door opening is the best of the best. It sterilizes at high temperatures and sprays water from the top, bottom, and sides, so it's much cleaner than when I do it by hand. I'm super satisfied. Conclusion I was so, so satisfied with my recent experience using the Media Dishwasher. If you don't have a dishwasher at home yet, I highly recommend purchasing and using this Media Dishwasher. I've also highly recommended it to my friends who live alone like me. I should send one to my parents' house, too. I'm serious, but I don't think there's anyone who's never used one, but there's no one who's used one only once. Thank you for reading this long and poorly written post. * When purchasing a Media Dishwasher, also purchase the dishwasher detergent sold by Coupang. Do not use regular dishwashing detergent. This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free as part of a Coupang Experience Group event.

Comments (English): [ There are people who have never used it, but there is no one who has only used it once. ] || ---------------- || After using commercial dishwashers for over 10 years, I had a great opportunity to try out a home dishwasher, so I used it for about 2 weeks. I will write a review as honestly and candidly as possible. *^^*- It doesn't take up much space. The commercial dishwasher I used was long and wide, so it took up a lot of space, but the media dishwasher is small and cute because it looks just like a microwave or oven. (It's 55cm long.) Fortunately, it doesn't take up as much space as I was worried, so I was able to make room for it in my small kitchen. Installation is very easy. (It seems easy to move) The Rocket installer makes a reservation in advance and visits to install it, but I thought I should know how to do it myself in case something happens, so I asked various questions and watched the installation process carefully. Contrary to my worries, I was glad that I didn't have to drill holes in the sink or kitchen shelves. I was worried that I had to drill holes after seeing the advertisement photos, but it was possible to install it without drilling any holes. (Of course, it doesn't look as neat as it looks ^^) It's also lighter than I thought, and I think I'll be able to move it easily if I want to change the location. I think I'll install it by myself when I move. (You'll need a monkey wrench.) It's much quieter than I thought, whether it's on standby or in use. Since it washes with hot water, I thought there would be a little noise even while it's on standby to maintain the water temperature, but it's just quiet. While commercial dishwashers make a lot of noise while washing dishes, the Media dishwasher doesn't make any annoying or stressful noise, which I really liked. I was surprised at first when I heard the washing time was 65 minutes. Commercial dishwashers usually take 1 minute or 1 minute 30 seconds, so I looked into why there was such a big difference, and it turned out that commercial dishwashers have high-pressure motors or higher water temperatures and send out water pressure and steam. They are made with only one thing in mind for washing, so they make a lot of noise and use a lot of electricity, whereas home dishwashers take size, power consumption, washing power, and noise into consideration, and they also add sterilization and drying functions, so I guess that's why the washing time is longer. The Media dishwasher has 4 washing courses, so you can adjust the time accordingly. The auto-opening feature is the best. Commercial dishwashers and my sister's dishwasher don't automatically open the door when the wash is complete, so the heat and moisture remain inside. But with the Media dishwasher, an alarm sounds when the wash is complete and the door automatically opens with a click. This is a really great feature. Since the door opens automatically, all the heat and moisture is released, which helps dry the dishes more cleanly and fluffily. Usually, if you leave it on without realizing that it's done, the heat and moisture will remain and the dishes will be damp and not dry at all. But with this Media dishwasher, even if you forget to turn it on and don't hear the alarm, there's no problem. It's a convenience and satisfaction that I couldn't live without. Like most modern people, when you're struggling to get by all day, you tend to neglect housework. I always try to be mindful of housework, but after work and dinner, I often think, "I have to do the dishes right away. I have to do the dishes right away," and just let them soak for a day or two. I'm just so exhausted. But since the Media dishwasher came into existence, my life has become so neat and tidy. The world couldn't be better. Whether I have a lot of dishes to wash or not, I just use the cups once and then a new one. After eating leisurely, I gently rinse them and put them in the dishwasher. It does everything for me. The automatic door opening is the best of the best. It sterilizes at high temperatures and sprays water from the top, bottom, and sides, so it's much cleaner than when I do it by hand. I'm super satisfied. Conclusion I was so, so satisfied with my recent experience using the Media Dishwasher. If you don't have a dishwasher at home yet, I highly recommend purchasing and using this Media Dishwasher. I've also highly recommended it to my friends who live alone like me. I should send one to my parents' house, too. I'm serious, but I don't think there's anyone who's never used one, but there's no one who's used one only once. Thank you for reading this long and poorly written post. * When purchasing a Media Dishwasher, also purchase the dishwasher detergent sold by Coupang. Do not use regular dishwashing detergent. This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free as part of a Coupang Experience Group event.

Comments (English): [ There are people who have never used it, but there is no one who has only used it once. ] || ---------------- || After using commercial dishwashers for over 10 years, I had a great opportunity to try out a home dishwasher, so I used it for about 2 weeks. I will write a review as honestly and candidly as possible. *^^*- It doesn't take up much space. The commercial dishwasher I used was long and wide, so it took up a lot of space, but the media dishwasher is small and cute because it looks just like a microwave or oven. (It's 55cm long.) Fortunately, it doesn't take up as much space as I was worried, so I was able to make room for it in my small kitchen. Installation is very easy. (It seems easy to move) The Rocket installer makes a reservation in advance and visits to install it, but I thought I should know how to do it myself in case something happens, so I asked various questions and watched the installation process carefully. Contrary to my worries, I was glad that I didn't have to drill holes in the sink or kitchen shelves. I was worried that I had to drill holes after seeing the advertisement photos, but it was possible to install it without drilling any holes. (Of course, it doesn't look as neat as it looks ^^) It's also lighter than I thought, and I think I'll be able to move it easily if I want to change the location. I think I'll install it by myself when I move. (You'll need a monkey wrench.) It's much quieter than I thought, whether it's on standby or in use. Since it washes with hot water, I thought there would be a little noise even while it's on standby to maintain the water temperature, but it's just quiet. While commercial dishwashers make a lot of noise while washing dishes, the Media dishwasher doesn't make any annoying or stressful noise, which I really liked. I was surprised at first when I heard the washing time was 65 minutes. Commercial dishwashers usually take 1 minute or 1 minute 30 seconds, so I looked into why there was such a big difference, and it turned out that commercial dishwashers have high-pressure motors or higher water temperatures and send out water pressure and steam. They are made with only one thing in mind for washing, so they make a lot of noise and use a lot of electricity, whereas home dishwashers take size, power consumption, washing power, and noise into consideration, and they also add sterilization and drying functions, so I guess that's why the washing time is longer. The Media dishwasher has 4 washing courses, so you can adjust the time accordingly. The auto-opening feature is the best. Commercial dishwashers and my sister's dishwasher don't automatically open the door when the wash is complete, so the heat and moisture remain inside. But with the Media dishwasher, an alarm sounds when the wash is complete and the door automatically opens with a click. This is a really great feature. Since the door opens automatically, all the heat and moisture is released, which helps dry the dishes more cleanly and fluffily. Usually, if you leave it on without realizing that it's done, the heat and moisture will remain and the dishes will be damp and not dry at all. But with this Media dishwasher, even if you forget to turn it on and don't hear the alarm, there's no problem. It's a convenience and satisfaction that I couldn't live without. Like most modern people, when you're struggling to get by all day, you tend to neglect housework. I always try to be mindful of housework, but after work and dinner, I often think, "I have to do the dishes right away. I have to do the dishes right away," and just let them soak for a day or two. I'm just so exhausted. But since the Media dishwasher came into existence, my life has become so neat and tidy. The world couldn't be better. Whether I have a lot of dishes to wash or not, I just use the cups once and then a new one. After eating leisurely, I gently rinse them and put them in the dishwasher. It does everything for me. The automatic door opening is the best of the best. It sterilizes at high temperatures and sprays water from the top, bottom, and sides, so it's much cleaner than when I do it by hand. I'm super satisfied. Conclusion I was so, so satisfied with my recent experience using the Media Dishwasher. If you don't have a dishwasher at home yet, I highly recommend purchasing and using this Media Dishwasher. I've also highly recommended it to my friends who live alone like me. I should send one to my parents' house, too. I'm serious, but I don't think there's anyone who's never used one, but there's no one who's used one only once. Thank you for reading this long and poorly written post. * When purchasing a Media Dishwasher, also purchase the dishwasher detergent sold by Coupang. Do not use regular dishwashing detergent. This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free as part of a Coupang Experience Group event.

Comments (English): [ There are people who have never used it, but there is no one who has only used it once. ] || ---------------- || After using commercial dishwashers for over 10 years, I had a great opportunity to try out a home dishwasher, so I used it for about 2 weeks. I will write a review as honestly and candidly as possible. *^^*- It doesn't take up much space. The commercial dishwasher I used was long and wide, so it took up a lot of space, but the media dishwasher is small and cute because it looks just like a microwave or oven. (It's 55cm long.) Fortunately, it doesn't take up as much space as I was worried, so I was able to make room for it in my small kitchen. Installation is very easy. Contrary to my worries, I was glad that I didn't have to drill holes in the sink or kitchen shelves. I was worried that I had to drill holes after seeing the advertisement photos, but it was possible to install it without drilling any holes. (Of course, it doesn't look as neat as it looks ^^) It's also lighter than I thought, and I think I'll be able to move it easily if I want to change the location. I think I'll install it by myself when I move. (You'll need a monkey wrench.) It's much quieter than I thought, whether it's on standby or in use. Since it washes with hot water, I thought there would be a little noise even while it's on standby to maintain the water temperature, but it's just quiet. While commercial dishwashers make a lot of noise while washing dishes, the Media dishwasher doesn't make any annoying or stressful noise, which I really liked. I was surprised at first when I heard the washing time was 65 minutes. Commercial dishwashers usually take 1 minute or 1 minute 30 seconds, so I looked into why there was such a big difference, and it turned out that commercial dishwashers have high-pressure motors or higher water temperatures and send out water pressure and steam. They are made with only one thing in mind for washing, so they make a lot of noise and use a lot of electricity, whereas home dishwashers take size, power consumption, washing power, and noise into consideration, and they also add sterilization and drying functions, so I guess that's why the washing time is longer. The Media dishwasher has 4 washing courses, so you can adjust the time accordingly. The auto-opening feature is the best. Commercial dishwashers and my sister's dishwasher don't automatically open the door when the wash is complete, so the heat and moisture remain inside. But with the Media dishwasher, an alarm sounds when the wash is complete and the door automatically opens with a click. This is a really great feature. Since the door opens automatically, all the heat and moisture is released, which helps dry the dishes more cleanly and fluffily. Usually, if you leave it on without realizing that it's done, the heat and moisture will remain and the dishes will be damp and not dry at all. But with this Media dishwasher, even if you forget to turn it on and don't hear the alarm, there's no problem. It's a convenience and satisfaction that I couldn't live without. Like most modern people, when you're struggling to get by all day, you tend to neglect housework. I always try to be mindful of housework, but after work and dinner, I often think, "I have to do the dishes right away. I have to do the dishes right away," and just let them soak for a day or two. I'm just so exhausted. But since the Media dishwasher came into existence, my life has become so neat and tidy. The world couldn't be better. Whether I have a lot of dishes to wash or not, I just use the cups once and then a new one. After eating leisurely, I gently rinse them and put them in the dishwasher. It does everything for me. The automatic door opening is the best of the best. It sterilizes at high temperatures and sprays water from the top, bottom, and sides, so it's much cleaner than when I do it by hand. I'm super satisfied. Conclusion I was so, so satisfied with my recent experience using the Media Dishwasher. If you don't have a dishwasher at home yet, I highly recommend purchasing and using this Media Dishwasher. I've also highly recommended it to my friends who live alone like me. I should send one to my parents' house, too. I'm serious, but I don't think there's anyone who's never used one, but there's no one who's used one only once. Thank you for reading this long and poorly written post. * When purchasing a Media Dishwasher, also purchase the dishwasher detergent sold by Coupang. Do not use regular dishwashing detergent. Sentence (English): Having used commercial dishwashers for over 10 years, I had a great opportunity to try out a household dishwasher, so I used it for about two weeks.
Comments (English): [ There may be people who have never used it, but there are no people who have used it only once. ] || ---------------- || Having used commercial dishwashers for over 10 years, I had a great opportunity to try out a household dishwasher, so I used it for about two weeks. I will write a review, one by one, as honestly and straightforwardly as possible. - It doesn't take up much space. The commercial dishwashers I used before took up space vertically all the way to the ceiling and were very long horizontally, but the Midea dishwasher looks exactly like a microwave or oven, so it is small and cute (the width is said to be 55cm). Fortunately, it didn't take up as much space as I had feared, so I was able to make room for it in my small and cozy kitchen. Installation is very simple. (It seems easy to move.) Although a Rocket Installation technician schedules a visit in advance, I felt I should know how to do it myself just in case, so I asked various questions and watched the installation process carefully. Contrary to my worries, I was glad that I didn't necessarily have to drill holes in the sink or kitchen shelves. I was concerned after seeing the advertisement photos that I had to make holes, but it turned out that it is perfectly possible to install it without drilling any. (Of course, the appearance isn't quite as neat as it could be ^^). It is also much lighter than I expected. I think I can easily move it around if I ever want to change its location. I plan to install it myself after moving. (You will need a monkey wrench.) It is much quieter than I expected, whether in standby or in use. Since it washes with hot water, I expected some noise even while idle to maintain the water temperature, but it is just quiet. Unlike commercial dishwashers that make a deafening noise during washing, the Midea dishwasher didn't produce any annoying or stressful noise, which I really liked. I was surprised at first when I heard the wash time was 65 minutes. Commercial dishwashers usually run for 1 minute or 1 minute 30 seconds. I wondered why there was such a big difference, so I looked into it. I found that commercial models are designed solely for washing—using high-pressure motors and higher water temperatures to generate water pressure and steam—so they produce tremendous noise and consume a lot of electricity. In contrast, household dishwashers consider size, power consumption, cleaning performance, and noise levels... Since sterilization and drying functions have been added, it seems the time has increased accordingly. The Midea dishwasher has as many as four wash cycles, so I was able to adjust the time skillfully. The automatic door opening feature is the best. Commercial dishwashers and the one at my sister's house don't have this feature, so heat and humidity remain inside. But with the Midea dishwasher, when the wash is finished, an alert sounds and the door automatically snaps open. This is a truly amazing feature. Because the door opens automatically, all the heat and humidity escape, helping the clothes dry more thoroughly and fluffily. Usually, if you leave the dishwasher without realizing it's finished while the heat and humidity remain, the clothes will be damp and un-dried. But with this Midea dishwasher, even if you run it and forget to hear the alert, there is no problem at all. It offers such convenience and satisfaction that I can't live without it again. As is probably the case for most modern people, when you struggle all day just to make ends meet, it is inevitable that you neglect housework. I always try to pay attention to housework, too, but... After getting off work and having dinner, I used to often just think, "I should do the dishes right away. I should do them right away," but then leave them soaking for a day or two. I was just too exhausted. But ever since I got the Midea dishwasher, my life has truly become neat and comfortable. It couldn't be better. Whether there are a lot of dishes or not, I just use a cup once and then buy a new one. I eat leisurely, rinse gently, put it in the dishwasher, and run it. It takes care of everything automatically. The fact that the door opens automatically is truly the best of the best. With high temperature, sterilization, and water spraying from the top, bottom, and sides, it is much cleaner than if I washed them meticulously by hand. I am super, super satisfied. In conclusion, I was truly, truly satisfied using the Midea dishwasher this time. If you don't have a dishwasher at home yet, I highly recommend purchasing and trying this Midea model. I strongly recommended it to my friends who live alone like me. I think I should send one to my parents' house, too. I mean it sincerely: there may be people who have never used one, but I don't think there are any who have used one just once. Thank you for reading this long and somewhat disorganized post. * When purchasing a Midea dishwasher, please also purchase the dishwasher-specific detergent sold on Coupang. I will write a review, one by one, as honestly and straightforwardly as possible. - It doesn't take up much space. The commercial dishwashers I used before took up space vertically all the way to the ceiling and were very long horizontally, but the Midea dishwasher looks exactly like a microwave or oven, so it is small and cute (the width is said to be 55cm). Fortunately, it didn't take up as much space as I had feared, so I was able to make room for it in my small and cozy kitchen. Installation is very simple. (It seems easy to move.) Although a Rocket Installation technician schedules a visit in advance, I felt I should know how to do it myself just in case, so I asked various questions and watched the installation process carefully. Contrary to my worries, I was glad that I didn't necessarily have to drill holes in the sink or kitchen shelves. I was concerned after seeing the advertisement photos that I had to make holes, but it turned out that it is perfectly possible to install it without drilling any. (Of course, the appearance isn't quite as neat as it could be ^^). It is also much lighter than I expected. I think I can easily move it around if I ever want to change its location. I plan to install it myself after moving. (You will need a monkey wrench.) It is much quieter than I expected, whether in standby or in use. Since it washes with hot water, I expected some noise even while idle to maintain the water temperature, but it is just quiet. Unlike commercial dishwashers that make a deafening noise during washing, the Midea dishwasher didn't produce any annoying or stressful noise, which I really liked. I was surprised at first when I heard the wash time was 65 minutes. Commercial dishwashers usually run for 1 minute or 1 minute 30 seconds. I wondered why there was such a big difference, so I looked into it. I found that commercial models are designed solely for washing—using high-pressure motors and higher water temperatures to generate water pressure and steam—so they produce tremendous noise and consume a lot of electricity. In contrast, household dishwashers consider size, power consumption, cleaning performance, and noise levels... Since sterilization and drying functions have been added, it seems the time has increased accordingly. The Midea dishwasher has as many as four wash cycles, so I was able to adjust the time skillfully. The automatic door opening feature is the best. Commercial dishwashers and the one at my sister's house don't have this feature, so heat and humidity remain inside. But with the Midea dishwasher, when the wash is finished, an alert sounds and the door automatically snaps open. This is a truly amazing feature. Because the door opens automatically, all the heat and humidity escape, helping the clothes dry more thoroughly and fluffily. Usually, if you leave the dishwasher without realizing it's finished while the heat and humidity remain, the clothes will be damp and un-dried. But with this Midea dishwasher, even if you run it and forget to hear the alert, there is no problem at all. It offers such convenience and satisfaction that I can't live without it again. As is probably the case for most modern people, when you struggle all day just to make ends meet, it is inevitable that you neglect housework. I always try to pay attention to housework, too, but... After getting off work and having dinner, I used to often just think, "I should do the dishes right away. I should do them right away," but then leave them soaking for a day or two. I was just too exhausted. But ever since I got the Midea dishwasher, my life has truly become neat and comfortable. It couldn't be better. Whether there are a lot of dishes or not, I just use a cup once and then buy a new one. I eat leisurely, rinse gently, put it in the dishwasher, and run it. It takes care of everything automatically. The fact that the door opens automatically is truly the best of the best. With high temperature, sterilization, and water spraying from the top, bottom, and sides, it is much cleaner than if I washed them meticulously by hand. I am super, super satisfied. In conclusion, I was truly, truly satisfied using the Midea dishwasher this time. If you don't have a dishwasher at home yet, I highly recommend purchasing and trying this Midea model. I strongly recommended it to my friends who live alone like me. I think I should send one to my parents' house, too. I mean it sincerely: there may be people who have never used one, but I don't think there are any who have used one just once. Thank you for reading this long and somewhat disorganized post. * When purchasing a Midea dishwasher, please also purchase the dishwasher-specific detergent sold on Coupang. Comments (English): [ There may be people who have never used it, but there are no people who have used it only once. ] || ---------------- || Having used commercial dishwashers for over 10 years, I had a great opportunity to try out a household dishwasher, so I used it for about two weeks. I will write a review, one by one, as honestly and straightforwardly as possible. - It doesn't take up much space. The commercial dishwashers I used before took up space vertically all the way to the ceiling and were very long horizontally, but the Midea dishwasher looks exactly like a microwave or oven, so it is small and cute (the width is said to be 55cm). Fortunately, it didn't take up as much space as I had feared, so I was able to make room for it in my small and cozy kitchen. Installation is very simple. (It seems easy to move.) Although a Rocket Installation technician schedules a visit in advance, I felt I should know how to do it myself just in case, so I asked various questions and watched the installation process carefully. Contrary to my worries, I was glad that I didn't necessarily have to drill holes in the sink or kitchen shelves. I was concerned after seeing the advertisement photos that I had to make holes, but it turned out that it is perfectly possible to install it without drilling any. (Of course, the appearance isn't quite as neat as it could be ^^). It is also much lighter than I expected. I think I can easily move it around if I ever want to change its location. I plan to install it myself after moving. (You will need a monkey wrench.) It is much quieter than I expected, whether in standby or in use. Since it washes with hot water, I expected some noise even while idle to maintain the water temperature, but it is just quiet. Unlike commercial dishwashers that make a deafening noise during washing, the Midea dishwasher didn't produce any annoying or stressful noise, which I really liked. I was surprised at first when I heard the wash time was 65 minutes. Commercial dishwashers usually run for 1 minute or 1 minute 30 seconds. I wondered why there was such a big difference, so I looked into it. I found that commercial models are designed solely for washing—using high-pressure motors and higher water temperatures to generate water pressure and steam—so they produce tremendous noise and consume a lot of electricity. In contrast, household dishwashers consider size, power consumption, cleaning performance, and noise levels... Since sterilization and drying functions have been added, it seems the time has increased accordingly. The Midea dishwasher has as many as four wash cycles, so I was able to adjust the time skillfully. The automatic door opening feature is the best. Commercial dishwashers and the one at my sister's house don't have this feature, so heat and humidity remain inside. But with the Midea dishwasher, when the wash is finished, an alert sounds and the door automatically snaps open. This is a truly amazing feature. Because the door opens automatically, all the heat and humidity escape, helping the clothes dry more thoroughly and fluffily. Usually, if you leave the dishwasher without realizing it's finished while the heat and humidity remain, the clothes will be damp and un-dried. But with this Midea dishwasher, even if you run it and forget to hear the alert, there is no problem at all. It offers such convenience and satisfaction that I can't live without it again. As is probably the case for most modern people, when you struggle all day just to make ends meet, it is inevitable that you neglect housework. I always try to pay attention to housework, too, but... After getting off work and having dinner, I used to often just think, "I should do the dishes right away. I should do them right away," but then leave them soaking for a day or two. I was just too exhausted. But ever since I got the Midea dishwasher, my life has truly become neat and comfortable. It couldn't be better. Whether there are a lot of dishes or not, I just use a cup once and then buy a new one. I eat leisurely, rinse gently, put it in the dishwasher, and run it. It takes care of everything automatically. The fact that the door opens automatically is truly the best of the best. With high temperature, sterilization, and water spraying from the top, bottom, and sides, it is much cleaner than if I washed them meticulously by hand. I am super, super satisfied. In conclusion, I was truly, truly satisfied using the Midea dishwasher this time. If you don't have a dishwasher at home yet, I highly recommend purchasing and trying this Midea model. I strongly recommended it to my friends who live alone like me. I think I should send one to my parents' house, too. I mean it sincerely: there may be people who have never used one, but I don't think there are any who have used one just once. Thank you for reading this long and somewhat disorganized post. * When purchasing a Midea dishwasher, please also purchase the dishwasher-specific detergent sold on Coupang. Do not use regular dishwashing detergent. This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event.
