Sentence (English): Washing, tidying up, and putting away dishes once they dried—and since the dishes didn't always dry quickly, we also had a dish dryer on hand.
Comments (English): I highly recommend this. We are a family of four with children aged 3 and 6. Our old 12-place setting dishwasher was an older model, so it didn't feel like it cleaned things very thoroughly. Also, I realized that there are more children's dishes than I thought shouldn't be put in the dishwasher. So, even though we didn't have much to do, I just kept washing them by hand rather than using the dishwasher. But at some point, I realized I was spending about 40 minutes a day on washing dishes. Washing, tidying up, and putting away dishes once they dried—and since the dishes didn't always dry quickly, we also had a dish dryer on hand. So, after much deliberation, I decided to buy a new dishwasher since we had just moved. Since none of us eat lunch at home, there isn't a huge amount of dishwashing, so I looked into buying a 6-place setting model and did a lot of research. I learned a lot by watching Gwigom's YouTube videos. I was planning to buy one from a famous brand, but it was expensive for a 6-place setting. However, when I found out that this brand was manufactured and imported by [Company Name], I didn't want to pay more than double the price. So, after looking up reviews, I decided to buy it just because it was cheap. I figured if it was good, great, and if not, I could use it for a while and replace it. I was so happy that even though I ordered late in the evening, it was installed the very next day. I ran the dishwasher as soon as I received it. It is a bit difficult to put things like pots in, but one does fit. Still, since washing a pot is easy, I mainly put in dishes, cups, and cutlery. If you put them in without stacking them, they wash really well and thoroughly. They actually look shinier than when I used to wash them myself. Washing the kids' water bottles and straws used to be the hardest part, so I am so happy now. The straws and parts wash better than I expected. Still, since it's for the kids, I feel a bit uneasy about it, so after the dishwasher finishes, I rinse just the straws and parts in water. It really cleans water bottles, cups, and dishes very well. I believe that pre-washing defeats the purpose of buying a dishwasher, so I collect the dishes in a basin filled with water that I normally use. So, you don't need to pre-wash separately; you can just put them directly into the dishwasher, and since there's no need to soak, they wash up really well. Sentence (English): Since none of us eat lunch at home, there isn't a huge amount of dishwashing, so I looked into buying a 6-place setting model and did a lot of research.
Comments (English): I highly recommend this. We are a family of four with children aged 3 and 6. Our old 12-place setting dishwasher was an older model, so it didn't feel like it cleaned things very thoroughly. Also, I realized that there are more children's dishes than I thought shouldn't be put in the dishwasher. So, even though we didn't have much to do, I just kept washing them by hand rather than using the dishwasher. But at some point, I realized I was spending about 40 minutes a day on washing dishes. Washing, tidying up, and putting away dishes once they dried—and since the dishes didn't always dry quickly, we also had a dish dryer on hand. So, after much deliberation, I decided to buy a new dishwasher since we had just moved. Since none of us eat lunch at home, there isn't a huge amount of dishwashing, so I looked into buying a 6-place setting model and did a lot of research. I learned a lot by watching Gwigom's YouTube videos. I was planning to buy one from a famous brand, but it was expensive for a 6-place setting. However, when I found out that this brand was manufactured and imported by [Company Name], I didn't want to pay more than double the price. So, after looking up reviews, I decided to buy it just because it was cheap. I figured if it was good, great, and if not, I could use it for a while and replace it. I was so happy that even though I ordered late in the evening, it was installed the very next day. I ran the dishwasher as soon as I received it. It is a bit difficult to put things like pots in, but one does fit. Still, since washing a pot is easy, I mainly put in dishes, cups, and cutlery. If you put them in without stacking them, they wash really well and thoroughly. They actually look shinier than when I used to wash them myself. Washing the kids' water bottles and straws used to be the hardest part, so I am so happy now. The straws and parts wash better than I expected. Still, since it's for the kids, I feel a bit uneasy about it, so after the dishwasher finishes, I rinse just the straws and parts in water. It really cleans water bottles, cups, and dishes very well. I believe that pre-washing defeats the purpose of buying a dishwasher, so I collect the dishes in a basin filled with water that I normally use. So, you don't need to pre-wash separately; you can just put them directly into the dishwasher, and since there's no need to soak, they wash up really well. However, if the kids get things like cheese on them... that really doesn't come off easily even with hand washing, so you definitely have to check it from time to time. Still, I'm very satisfied and using it well! I highly recommend it, seriously. Also, since it's a two-tier unit, it takes up less space sideways—what is this? On the sink countertop... Anyway, I love that it doesn't take up much space. And for reference, I found the Frog brand detergent to be the best. Since I have kids, I tried buying Nellie's, but that one leaves water stains.

Comments (English): I highly recommend this. We are a family of four with children aged 3 and 6. Also, I realized that there are more children's dishes than I thought shouldn't be put in the dishwasher. Washing, tidying up, and putting away dishes once they dried—and since the dishes didn't always dry quickly, we also had a dish dryer on hand. So, after much deliberation, I decided to buy a new dishwasher since we had just moved. Since none of us eat lunch at home, there isn't a huge amount of dishwashing, so I looked into buying a 6-place setting model and did a lot of research. I learned a lot by watching Gwigom's YouTube videos. I was planning to buy one from a famous brand, but it was expensive for a 6-place setting. However, when I found out that this brand was manufactured and imported by [Company Name], I didn't want to pay more than double the price. So, after looking up reviews, I decided to buy it just because it was cheap. I figured if it was good, great, and if not, I could use it for a while and replace it. I was so happy that even though I ordered late in the evening, it was installed the very next day. I ran the dishwasher as soon as I received it. It is a bit difficult to put things like pots in, but one does fit. Still, since washing a pot is easy, I mainly put in dishes, cups, and cutlery. If you put them in without stacking them, they wash really well and thoroughly. They actually look shinier than when I used to wash them myself. Washing the kids' water bottles and straws used to be the hardest part, so I am so happy now. The straws and parts wash better than I expected. Still, since it's for the kids, I feel a bit uneasy about it, so after the dishwasher finishes, I rinse just the straws and parts in water. It really cleans water bottles, cups, and dishes very well. I believe that pre-washing defeats the purpose of buying a dishwasher, so I collect the dishes in a basin filled with water that I normally use. Sentence (English): I was so happy that even though I ordered late in the evening, it was installed the very next day.
Comments (English): I highly recommend this. We are a family of four with children aged 3 and 6. Our old 12-place setting dishwasher was an older model, so it didn't feel like it cleaned things very thoroughly. Also, I realized that there are more children's dishes than I thought shouldn't be put in the dishwasher. So, even though we didn't have much to do, I just kept washing them by hand rather than using the dishwasher. But at some point, I realized I was spending about 40 minutes a day on washing dishes. Washing, tidying up, and putting away dishes once they dried—and since the dishes didn't always dry quickly, we also had a dish dryer on hand. So, after much deliberation, I decided to buy a new dishwasher since we had just moved. Since none of us eat lunch at home, there isn't a huge amount of dishwashing, so I looked into buying a 6-place setting model and did a lot of research. I learned a lot by watching Gwigom's YouTube videos. I was planning to buy one from a famous brand, but it was expensive for a 6-place setting. However, when I found out that this brand was manufactured and imported by [Company Name], I didn't want to pay more than double the price. So, after looking up reviews, I decided to buy it just because it was cheap. I figured if it was good, great, and if not, I could use it for a while and replace it. I was so happy that even though I ordered late in the evening, it was installed the very next day. I ran the dishwasher as soon as I received it. It is a bit difficult to put things like pots in, but one does fit. Still, since washing a pot is easy, I mainly put in dishes, cups, and cutlery. If you put them in without stacking them, they wash really well and thoroughly. They actually look shinier than when I used to wash them myself. Washing the kids' water bottles and straws used to be the hardest part, so I am so happy now. The straws and parts wash better than I expected. Still, since it's for the kids, I feel a bit uneasy about it, so after the dishwasher finishes, I rinse just the straws and parts in water. It really cleans water bottles, cups, and dishes very well. I believe that pre-washing defeats the purpose of buying a dishwasher, so I collect the dishes in a basin filled with water that I normally use. So, you don't need to pre-wash separately; you can just put them directly into the dishwasher, and since there's no need to soak, they wash up really well. I learned a lot by watching Gwigom's YouTube videos. I was planning to buy one from a famous brand, but it was expensive for a 6-place setting. However, when I found out that this brand was manufactured and imported by [Company Name], I didn't want to pay more than double the price. So, after looking up reviews, I decided to buy it just because it was cheap. I figured if it was good, great, and if not, I could use it for a while and replace it. I was so happy that even though I ordered late in the evening, it was installed the very next day. I ran the dishwasher as soon as I received it. Sentence (English): They actually look shinier than when I used to wash them myself.
Comments (English): I highly recommend this. We are a family of four with children aged 3 and 6. Our old 12-place setting dishwasher was an older model, so it didn't feel like it cleaned things very thoroughly. Also, I realized that there are more children's dishes than I thought shouldn't be put in the dishwasher. So, even though we didn't have much to do, I just kept washing them by hand rather than using the dishwasher. But at some point, I realized I was spending about 40 minutes a day on washing dishes. Washing, tidying up, and putting away dishes once they dried—and since the dishes didn't always dry quickly, we also had a dish dryer on hand. So, after much deliberation, I decided to buy a new dishwasher since we had just moved. Since none of us eat lunch at home, there isn't a huge amount of dishwashing, so I looked into buying a 6-place setting model and did a lot of research. I learned a lot by watching Gwigom's YouTube videos. I was planning to buy one from a famous brand, but it was expensive for a 6-place setting. However, when I found out that this brand was manufactured and imported by [Company Name], I didn't want to pay more than double the price. So, after looking up reviews, I decided to buy it just because it was cheap. I figured if it was good, great, and if not, I could use it for a while and replace it. I was so happy that even though I ordered late in the evening, it was installed the very next day. I ran the dishwasher as soon as I received it. It is a bit difficult to put things like pots in, but one does fit. Still, since washing a pot is easy, I mainly put in dishes, cups, and cutlery. If you put them in without stacking them, they wash really well and thoroughly. They actually look shinier than when I used to wash them myself. Washing the kids' water bottles and straws used to be the hardest part, so I am so happy now. The straws and parts wash better than I expected. Still, since it's for the kids, I feel a bit uneasy about it, so after the dishwasher finishes, I rinse just the straws and parts in water. It really cleans water bottles, cups, and dishes very well. I believe that pre-washing defeats the purpose of buying a dishwasher, so I collect the dishes in a basin filled with water that I normally use. So, you don't need to pre-wash separately; you can just put them directly into the dishwasher, and since there's no need to soak, they wash up really well. However, if the kids get things like cheese on them... that really doesn't come off easily even with hand washing, so you definitely have to check it from time to time. Still, I'm very satisfied and using it well! I highly recommend it, seriously. Also, since it's a two-tier unit, it takes up less space sideways—what is this? On the sink countertop... Anyway, I love that it doesn't take up much space. And for reference, I found the Frog brand detergent to be the best. Since I have kids, I tried buying Nellie's, but that one leaves water stains.

Sentence (English): Washing the kids' water bottles and straws used to be the hardest part, so I am so happy now.
Comments (English): I highly recommend this. We are a family of four with children aged 3 and 6. Our old 12-place setting dishwasher was an older model, so it didn't feel like it cleaned things very thoroughly. Also, I realized that there are more children's dishes than I thought shouldn't be put in the dishwasher. So, even though we didn't have much to do, I just kept washing them by hand rather than using the dishwasher. But at some point, I realized I was spending about 40 minutes a day on washing dishes. Washing, tidying up, and putting away dishes once they dried—and since the dishes didn't always dry quickly, we also had a dish dryer on hand. So, after much deliberation, I decided to buy a new dishwasher since we had just moved. Since none of us eat lunch at home, there isn't a huge amount of dishwashing, so I looked into buying a 6-place setting model and did a lot of research. I learned a lot by watching Gwigom's YouTube videos. I was planning to buy one from a famous brand, but it was expensive for a 6-place setting. However, when I found out that this brand was manufactured and imported by [Company Name], I didn't want to pay more than double the price. So, after looking up reviews, I decided to buy it just because it was cheap. I figured if it was good, great, and if not, I could use it for a while and replace it. I was so happy that even though I ordered late in the evening, it was installed the very next day. I ran the dishwasher as soon as I received it. It is a bit difficult to put things like pots in, but one does fit. Still, since washing a pot is easy, I mainly put in dishes, cups, and cutlery. If you put them in without stacking them, they wash really well and thoroughly. They actually look shinier than when I used to wash them myself. Washing the kids' water bottles and straws used to be the hardest part, so I am so happy now. The straws and parts wash better than I expected. Still, since it's for the kids, I feel a bit uneasy about it, so after the dishwasher finishes, I rinse just the straws and parts in water. It really cleans water bottles, cups, and dishes very well. I believe that pre-washing defeats the purpose of buying a dishwasher, so I collect the dishes in a basin filled with water that I normally use. So, you don't need to pre-wash separately; you can just put them directly into the dishwasher, and since there's no need to soak, they wash up really well. I learned a lot by watching Gwigom's YouTube videos. I was planning to buy one from a famous brand, but it was expensive for a 6-place setting. However, when I found out that this brand was manufactured and imported by [Company Name], I didn't want to pay more than double the price. Washing, tidying up, and putting away dishes once they dried—and since the dishes didn't always dry quickly, we also had a dish dryer on hand. So, after much deliberation, I decided to buy a new dishwasher since we had just moved. Since none of us eat lunch at home, there isn't a huge amount of dishwashing, so I looked into buying a 6-place setting model and did a lot of research. I learned a lot by watching Gwigom's YouTube videos. I was planning to buy one from a famous brand, but it was expensive for a 6-place setting. However, when I found out that this brand was manufactured and imported by [Company Name], I didn't want to pay more than double the price. So, after looking up reviews, I decided to buy it just because it was cheap. I figured if it was good, great, and if not, I could use it for a while and replace it. I was so happy that even though I ordered late in the evening, it was installed the very next day. I ran the dishwasher as soon as I received it. It is a bit difficult to put things like pots in, but one does fit. Still, since washing a pot is easy, I mainly put in dishes, cups, and cutlery. If you put them in without stacking them, they wash really well and thoroughly. They actually look shinier than when I used to wash them myself. Washing the kids' water bottles and straws used to be the hardest part, so I am so happy now. The straws and parts wash better than I expected. Still, since it's for the kids, I feel a bit uneasy about it, so after the dishwasher finishes, I rinse just the straws and parts in water. It really cleans water bottles, cups, and dishes very well. I believe that pre-washing defeats the purpose of buying a dishwasher, so I collect the dishes in a basin filled with water that I normally use. So, you don't need to pre-wash separately; you can just put them directly into the dishwasher, and since there's no need to soak, they wash up really well. However, if the kids get things like cheese on them... that really doesn't come off easily even with hand washing, so you definitely have to check it from time to time. Still, I'm very satisfied and using it well! I highly recommend it, seriously. Also, since it's a two-tier unit, it takes up less space sideways—what is this? On the sink countertop... Anyway, I love that it doesn't take up much space. And for reference, I found the Frog brand detergent to be the best. Since I have kids, I tried buying Nellie's, but that one leaves water stains.

Sentence (English): Today, I’m going to review the 'Midae Automatic Door Opening Dishwasher (6-Place).'
Comments (English): [ Important precautions to know before use and an honest review! ] || ---------------- || Pros. Powerful cleaning. Automatic door opening. Ample storage space. User Review. Hello. Today, I’m going to review the 'Midae Automatic Door Opening Dishwasher (6-Place).' If you are in a hurry, please just look at the summary at the very bottom. Midea Automatic Door Opening Dishwasher, Satisfactory Features. After using the Midea dishwasher, I found it to be performing its function as a dishwasher exceptionally well. First. Powerful cleaning: When I did dishes by hand, I always had doubts about the cleaning power of dishwashers. No matter how much people around me said it was good, I wondered if it could clean as thoroughly as washing every nook and cranny by hand. Contrary to my concerns, it really cleans much more cleanly than hand washing. To check how well it cleans, I put in dishes with red stains from eating Yukgaejang and Tteokbokki. They came out so clean that you couldn't find a single food stain anywhere. (See photo). Second. Ample storage space: It was definitely difficult to gauge the size just by looking at the detailed description or review photos. Since it was described as a slim size and a 6-place setting, I expected it to be more compact, but it was much larger than anticipated. It features a two-tier basket and fits everything from small dishes like condiment bowls to large plates, cups, and cutlery. I was surprised by how big it was at first, but I think it's actually better for loading a large number of dishes at once. If the 6-place setting is this big, I don't think there will be any room to put anything larger. Third, the automatic door opening function: The dishwasher runs for a standard 65 minutes. The door opens automatically when there are about 5 minutes left after the cycle is finished. Thanks to this, humid air is quickly expelled, and the outside air naturally dries the dishes, effectively removing odors and moisture. I think the automatic door opening function is essential for a dishwasher. Overall review: With the 3-stage washing system (Top, Medium, and Bottom), it cleans truly thoroughly, leaving no trace of food stains. It completely removes even red liquids. It really cleans better than washing by hand (see photo). There is ample storage space, and the noise wasn't as loud as I expected, so it wasn't bothersome. I also liked that it allows for minimal or no drilling. Personally, I tend not to use machines if the operation is complicated, so I appreciated how simple it is to use. I was satisfied with everything—design, performance, and ease of use—so there wasn't a single thing I was disappointed about. I am truly satisfied. Finally, for those using a dishwasher for the first time, I will wrap up by listing a few important precautions you must know before use! 1. You must use dishwasher-specific detergent. Using regular dish soap may cause the unit to malfunction. For liquid detergent, place it in the area shown in the photo; for solid detergent, simply place one tablet on the bottom of the dishwasher. 2. Please make sure to rinse dishes stained with grease, chili powder, or red broth with water before placing them in the dishwasher. 3. Please check that the automatic door opening function is enabled before starting the cycle. Occasionally, if it is not set, the door will not open automatically after the wash cycle. This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event.

Sentence (English): Midea Automatic Door Opening Dishwasher, Satisfactory Features.
Comments (English): [ Important precautions to know before use and an honest review! ] || ---------------- || Pros. Powerful cleaning. Automatic door opening. Ample storage space. User Review. Hello. Today, I’m going to review the 'Midae Automatic Door Opening Dishwasher (6-Place).' If you are in a hurry, please just look at the summary at the very bottom. Midea Automatic Door Opening Dishwasher, Satisfactory Features. After using the Midea dishwasher, I found it to be performing its function as a dishwasher exceptionally well. First. Powerful cleaning: When I did dishes by hand, I always had doubts about the cleaning power of dishwashers. No matter how much people around me said it was good, I wondered if it could clean as thoroughly as washing every nook and cranny by hand. Contrary to my concerns, it really cleans much more cleanly than hand washing. To check how well it cleans, I put in dishes with red stains from eating Yukgaejang and Tteokbokki. They came out so clean that you couldn't find a single food stain anywhere. (See photo). Second. Ample storage space: It was definitely difficult to gauge the size just by looking at the detailed description or review photos. Since it was described as a slim size and a 6-place setting, I expected it to be more compact, but it was much larger than anticipated. It features a two-tier basket and fits everything from small dishes like condiment bowls to large plates, cups, and cutlery. I was surprised by how big it was at first, but I think it's actually better for loading a large number of dishes at once. If the 6-place setting is this big, I don't think there will be any room to put anything larger. Third, the automatic door opening function: The dishwasher runs for a standard 65 minutes. The door opens automatically when there are about 5 minutes left after the cycle is finished. Thanks to this, humid air is quickly expelled, and the outside air naturally dries the dishes, effectively removing odors and moisture. I think the automatic door opening function is essential for a dishwasher. Overall review: With the 3-stage washing system (Top, Medium, and Bottom), it cleans truly thoroughly, leaving no trace of food stains. It completely removes even red liquids. It really cleans better than washing by hand (see photo). There is ample storage space, and the noise wasn't as loud as I expected, so it wasn't bothersome. I also liked that it allows for minimal or no drilling. Personally, I tend not to use machines if the operation is complicated, so I appreciated how simple it is to use. I was satisfied with everything—design, performance, and ease of use—so there wasn't a single thing I was disappointed about. I am truly satisfied. Finally, for those using a dishwasher for the first time, I will wrap up by listing a few important precautions you must know before use! 1. You must use dishwasher-specific detergent. Using regular dish soap may cause the unit to malfunction. For liquid detergent, place it in the area shown in the photo; for solid detergent, simply place one tablet on the bottom of the dishwasher. 2. Please make sure to rinse dishes stained with grease, chili powder, or red broth with water before placing them in the dishwasher. 3. Please check that the automatic door opening function is enabled before starting the cycle. Occasionally, if it is not set, the door will not open automatically after the wash cycle. This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event.

Today, I’m going to review the 'Midae Automatic Door Opening Dishwasher (6-Place).' If you are in a hurry, please just look at the summary at the very bottom. Midea Automatic Door Opening Dishwasher, Satisfactory Features. After using the Midea dishwasher, I found it to be performing its function as a dishwasher exceptionally well. First. Powerful cleaning: When I did dishes by hand, I always had doubts about the cleaning power of dishwashers. No matter how much people around me said it was good, I wondered if it could clean as thoroughly as washing every nook and cranny by hand. Contrary to my concerns, it really cleans much more cleanly than hand washing. To check how well it cleans, I put in dishes with red stains from eating Yukgaejang and Tteokbokki. They came out so clean that you couldn't find a single food stain anywhere. (See photo). Second. Ample storage space: It was definitely difficult to gauge the size just by looking at the detailed description or review photos. Since it was described as a slim size and a 6-place setting, I expected it to be more compact, but it was much larger than anticipated. It features a two-tier basket and fits everything from small dishes like condiment bowls to large plates, cups, and cutlery. I was surprised by how big it was at first, but I think it's actually better for loading a large number of dishes at once. If the 6-place setting is this big, I don't think there will be any room to put anything larger. Third, the automatic door opening function: The dishwasher runs for a standard 65 minutes. The door opens automatically when there are about 5 minutes left after the cycle is finished. Thanks to this, humid air is quickly expelled, and the outside air naturally dries the dishes, effectively removing odors and moisture. I think the automatic door opening function is essential for a dishwasher. Overall review: With the 3-stage washing system (Top, Medium, and Bottom), it cleans truly thoroughly, leaving no trace of food stains. It completely removes even red liquids. It really cleans better than washing by hand (see photo). There is ample storage space, and the noise wasn't as loud as I expected, so it wasn't bothersome. I also liked that it allows for minimal or no drilling. Personally, I tend not to use machines if the operation is complicated, so I appreciated how simple it is to use. I was satisfied with everything—design, performance, and ease of use—so there wasn't a single thing I was disappointed about. I am truly satisfied. Finally, for those using a dishwasher for the first time, I will wrap up by listing a few important precautions you must know before use! 1. You must use dishwasher-specific detergent. Using regular dish soap may cause the unit to malfunction. For liquid detergent, place it in the area shown in the photo; for solid detergent, simply place one tablet on the bottom of the dishwasher. 2. Please make sure to rinse dishes stained with grease, chili powder, or red broth with water before placing them in the dishwasher. 3. Please check that the automatic door opening function is enabled before starting the cycle. Occasionally, if it is not set, the door will not open automatically after the wash cycle. This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event.

Comments (English): [ Important precautions to know before use and an honest review! ] || ---------------- || Pros. Powerful cleaning. Automatic door opening. Ample storage space. User Review. Hello. Today, I’m going to review the 'Midae Automatic Door Opening Dishwasher (6-Place).' If you are in a hurry, please just look at the summary at the very bottom. Midea Automatic Door Opening Dishwasher, Satisfactory Features. After using the Midea dishwasher, I found it to be performing its function as a dishwasher exceptionally well. First. Powerful cleaning: When I did dishes by hand, I always had doubts about the cleaning power of dishwashers. No matter how much people around me said it was good, I wondered if it could clean as thoroughly as washing every nook and cranny by hand. Contrary to my concerns, it really cleans much more cleanly than hand washing. To check how well it cleans, I put in dishes with red stains from eating Yukgaejang and Tteokbokki. They came out so clean that you couldn't find a single food stain anywhere. (See photo). Second. Ample storage space: It was definitely difficult to gauge the size just by looking at the detailed description or review photos. Since it was described as a slim size and a 6-place setting, I expected it to be more compact, but it was much larger than anticipated. It features a two-tier basket and fits everything from small dishes like condiment bowls to large plates, cups, and cutlery. I was surprised by how big it was at first, but I think it's actually better for loading a large number of dishes at once. If the 6-place setting is this big, I don't think there will be any room to put anything larger. Third, the automatic door opening function: The dishwasher runs for a standard 65 minutes. The door opens automatically when there are about 5 minutes left after the cycle is finished. Thanks to this, humid air is quickly expelled, and the outside air naturally dries the dishes, effectively removing odors and moisture. I think the automatic door opening function is essential for a dishwasher. Overall review: With the 3-stage washing system (Top, Medium, and Bottom), it cleans truly thoroughly, leaving no trace of food stains. It completely removes even red liquids. It really cleans better than washing by hand (see photo). There is ample storage space, and the noise wasn't as loud as I expected, so it wasn't bothersome. I also liked that it allows for minimal or no drilling. Personally, I tend not to use machines if the operation is complicated, so I appreciated how simple it is to use. I was satisfied with everything—design, performance, and ease of use—so there wasn't a single thing I was disappointed about. I am truly satisfied. Finally, for those using a dishwasher for the first time, I will wrap up by listing a few important precautions you must know before use! 1. You must use dishwasher-specific detergent. Using regular dish soap may cause the unit to malfunction. For liquid detergent, place it in the area shown in the photo; for solid detergent, simply place one tablet on the bottom of the dishwasher. 2. Please make sure to rinse dishes stained with grease, chili powder, or red broth with water before placing them in the dishwasher. 3. Please check that the automatic door opening function is enabled before starting the cycle. Occasionally, if it is not set, the door will not open automatically after the wash cycle. This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event.

Today, I’m going to review the 'Midae Automatic Door Opening Dishwasher (6-Place).' If you are in a hurry, please just look at the summary at the very bottom. Midea Automatic Door Opening Dishwasher, Satisfactory Features. After using the Midea dishwasher, I found it to be performing its function as a dishwasher exceptionally well. First. Powerful cleaning: When I did dishes by hand, I always had doubts about the cleaning power of dishwashers. No matter how much people around me said it was good, I wondered if it could clean as thoroughly as washing every nook and cranny by hand. Contrary to my concerns, it really cleans much more cleanly than hand washing. To check how well it cleans, I put in dishes with red stains from eating Yukgaejang and Tteokbokki. They came out so clean that you couldn't find a single food stain anywhere. (See photo). Second. Ample storage space: It was definitely difficult to gauge the size just by looking at the detailed description or review photos. Since it was described as a slim size and a 6-place setting, I expected it to be more compact, but it was much larger than anticipated. It features a two-tier basket and fits everything from small dishes like condiment bowls to large plates, cups, and cutlery. I was surprised by how big it was at first, but I think it's actually better for loading a large number of dishes at once. If the 6-place setting is this big, I don't think there will be any room to put anything larger. Third, the automatic door opening function: The dishwasher runs for a standard 65 minutes. The door opens automatically when there are about 5 minutes left after the cycle is finished. Thanks to this, humid air is quickly expelled, and the outside air naturally dries the dishes, effectively removing odors and moisture. I think the automatic door opening function is essential for a dishwasher. Overall review: With the 3-stage washing system (Top, Medium, and Bottom), it cleans truly thoroughly, leaving no trace of food stains. It completely removes even red liquids. It really cleans better than washing by hand (see photo). There is ample storage space, and the noise wasn't as loud as I expected, so it wasn't bothersome. I also liked that it allows for minimal or no drilling. Personally, I tend not to use machines if the operation is complicated, so I appreciated how simple it is to use. I was satisfied with everything—design, performance, and ease of use—so there wasn't a single thing I was disappointed about. I am truly satisfied. Finally, for those using a dishwasher for the first time, I will wrap up by listing a few important precautions you must know before use! 1. You must use dishwasher-specific detergent. Using regular dish soap may cause the unit to malfunction. For liquid detergent, place it in the area shown in the photo; for solid detergent, simply place one tablet on the bottom of the dishwasher. 2. Please make sure to rinse dishes stained with grease, chili powder, or red broth with water before placing them in the dishwasher. 3. Please check that the automatic door opening function is enabled before starting the cycle. Occasionally, if it is not set, the door will not open automatically after the wash cycle. This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event.

Today, I’m going to review the 'Midae Automatic Door Opening Dishwasher (6-Place).' If you are in a hurry, please just look at the summary at the very bottom. Midea Automatic Door Opening Dishwasher, Satisfactory Features. After using the Midea dishwasher, I found it to be performing its function as a dishwasher exceptionally well. First. Powerful cleaning: When I did dishes by hand, I always had doubts about the cleaning power of dishwashers. No matter how much people around me said it was good, I wondered if it could clean as thoroughly as washing every nook and cranny by hand. Contrary to my concerns, it really cleans much more cleanly than hand washing. To check how well it cleans, I put in dishes with red stains from eating Yukgaejang and Tteokbokki. They came out so clean that you couldn't find a single food stain anywhere. (See photo). Second. Ample storage space: It was definitely difficult to gauge the size just by looking at the detailed description or review photos. Since it was described as a slim size and a 6-place setting, I expected it to be more compact, but it was much larger than anticipated. It features a two-tier basket and fits everything from small dishes like condiment bowls to large plates, cups, and cutlery. I was surprised by how big it was at first, but I think it's actually better for loading a large number of dishes at once. If the 6-place setting is this big, I don't think there will be any room to put anything larger. Third, the automatic door opening function: The dishwasher runs for a standard 65 minutes. The door opens automatically when there are about 5 minutes left after the cycle is finished. Thanks to this, humid air is quickly expelled, and the outside air naturally dries the dishes, effectively removing odors and moisture. I think the automatic door opening function is essential for a dishwasher. Overall review: With the 3-stage washing system (Top, Medium, and Bottom), it cleans truly thoroughly, leaving no trace of food stains. It completely removes even red liquids. It really cleans better than washing by hand (see photo). There is ample storage space, and the noise wasn't as loud as I expected, so it wasn't bothersome. I also liked that it allows for minimal or no drilling. Personally, I tend not to use machines if the operation is complicated, so I appreciated how simple it is to use. I was satisfied with everything—design, performance, and ease of use—so there wasn't a single thing I was disappointed about. I am truly satisfied. Finally, for those using a dishwasher for the first time, I will wrap up by listing a few important precautions you must know before use! 1. You must use dishwasher-specific detergent. Using regular dish soap may cause the unit to malfunction. For liquid detergent, place it in the area shown in the photo; for solid detergent, simply place one tablet on the bottom of the dishwasher. 2. Please make sure to rinse dishes stained with grease, chili powder, or red broth with water before placing them in the dishwasher. 3. Please check that the automatic door opening function is enabled before starting the cycle. Occasionally, if it is not set, the door will not open automatically after the wash cycle. This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event.

Today, I’m going to review the 'Midae Automatic Door Opening Dishwasher (6-Place).' If you are in a hurry, please just look at the summary at the very bottom. Midea Automatic Door Opening Dishwasher, Satisfactory Features. After using the Midea dishwasher, I found it to be performing its function as a dishwasher exceptionally well. First. Powerful cleaning: When I did dishes by hand, I always had doubts about the cleaning power of dishwashers. No matter how much people around me said it was good, I wondered if it could clean as thoroughly as washing every nook and cranny by hand. Contrary to my concerns, it really cleans much more cleanly than hand washing. To check how well it cleans, I put in dishes with red stains from eating Yukgaejang and Tteokbokki. They came out so clean that you couldn't find a single food stain anywhere. (See photo). Second. Ample storage space: It was definitely difficult to gauge the size just by looking at the detailed description or review photos. Since it was described as a slim size and a 6-place setting, I expected it to be more compact, but it was much larger than anticipated. It features a two-tier basket and fits everything from small dishes like condiment bowls to large plates, cups, and cutlery. I was surprised by how big it was at first, but I think it's actually better for loading a large number of dishes at once. If the 6-place setting is this big, I don't think there will be any room to put anything larger. Third, the automatic door opening function: The dishwasher runs for a standard 65 minutes. The door opens automatically when there are about 5 minutes left after the cycle is finished. Thanks to this, humid air is quickly expelled, and the outside air naturally dries the dishes, effectively removing odors and moisture. I think the automatic door opening function is essential for a dishwasher. Overall review: With the 3-stage washing system (Top, Medium, and Bottom), it cleans truly thoroughly, leaving no trace of food stains. It completely removes even red liquids. It really cleans better than washing by hand (see photo). There is ample storage space, and the noise wasn't as loud as I expected, so it wasn't bothersome. I also liked that it allows for minimal or no drilling. Personally, I tend not to use machines if the operation is complicated, so I appreciated how simple it is to use. I was satisfied with everything—design, performance, and ease of use—so there wasn't a single thing I was disappointed about. I am truly satisfied. Finally, for those using a dishwasher for the first time, I will wrap up by listing a few important precautions you must know before use! 1. You must use dishwasher-specific detergent. Using regular dish soap may cause the unit to malfunction. For liquid detergent, place it in the area shown in the photo; for solid detergent, simply place one tablet on the bottom of the dishwasher. 2. Please make sure to rinse dishes stained with grease, chili powder, or red broth with water before placing them in the dishwasher. 3. Please check that the automatic door opening function is enabled before starting the cycle. Occasionally, if it is not set, the door will not open automatically after the wash cycle. This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event.

Today, I’m going to review the 'Midae Automatic Door Opening Dishwasher (6-Place).' If you are in a hurry, please just look at the summary at the very bottom. Midea Automatic Door Opening Dishwasher, Satisfactory Features. After using the Midea dishwasher, I found it to be performing its function as a dishwasher exceptionally well. First. Powerful cleaning: When I did dishes by hand, I always had doubts about the cleaning power of dishwashers. No matter how much people around me said it was good, I wondered if it could clean as thoroughly as washing every nook and cranny by hand. Contrary to my concerns, it really cleans much more cleanly than hand washing. To check how well it cleans, I put in dishes with red stains from eating Yukgaejang and Tteokbokki. They came out so clean that you couldn't find a single food stain anywhere. (See photo). Second. Ample storage space: It was definitely difficult to gauge the size just by looking at the detailed description or review photos. Since it was described as a slim size and a 6-place setting, I expected it to be more compact, but it was much larger than anticipated. It features a two-tier basket and fits everything from small dishes like condiment bowls to large plates, cups, and cutlery. I was surprised by how big it was at first, but I think it's actually better for loading a large number of dishes at once. If the 6-place setting is this big, I don't think there will be any room to put anything larger. Third, the automatic door opening function: The dishwasher runs for a standard 65 minutes. The door opens automatically when there are about 5 minutes left after the cycle is finished. Thanks to this, humid air is quickly expelled, and the outside air naturally dries the dishes, effectively removing odors and moisture. I think the automatic door opening function is essential for a dishwasher. Overall review: With the 3-stage washing system (Top, Medium, and Bottom), it cleans truly thoroughly, leaving no trace of food stains. It completely removes even red liquids. It really cleans better than washing by hand (see photo). There is ample storage space, and the noise wasn't as loud as I expected, so it wasn't bothersome. I also liked that it allows for minimal or no drilling. Personally, I tend not to use machines if the operation is complicated, so I appreciated how simple it is to use. I was satisfied with everything—design, performance, and ease of use—so there wasn't a single thing I was disappointed about. I am truly satisfied. Finally, for those using a dishwasher for the first time, I will wrap up by listing a few important precautions you must know before use! 1. You must use dishwasher-specific detergent. Using regular dish soap may cause the unit to malfunction. For liquid detergent, place it in the area shown in the photo; for solid detergent, simply place one tablet on the bottom of the dishwasher. 2. Please make sure to rinse dishes stained with grease, chili powder, or red broth with water before placing them in the dishwasher. 3. Please check that the automatic door opening function is enabled before starting the cycle. Occasionally, if it is not set, the door will not open automatically after the wash cycle. This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event.

Today, I’m going to review the 'Midae Automatic Door Opening Dishwasher (6-Place).' If you are in a hurry, please just look at the summary at the very bottom. Midea Automatic Door Opening Dishwasher, Satisfactory Features. After using the Midea dishwasher, I found it to be performing its function as a dishwasher exceptionally well. First. Powerful cleaning: When I did dishes by hand, I always had doubts about the cleaning power of dishwashers. No matter how much people around me said it was good, I wondered if it could clean as thoroughly as washing every nook and cranny by hand. Contrary to my concerns, it really cleans much more cleanly than hand washing. To check how well it cleans, I put in dishes with red stains from eating Yukgaejang and Tteokbokki. They came out so clean that you couldn't find a single food stain anywhere. (See photo). Second. Ample storage space: It was definitely difficult to gauge the size just by looking at the detailed description or review photos. Since it was described as a slim size and a 6-place setting, I expected it to be more compact, but it was much larger than anticipated. It features a two-tier basket and fits everything from small dishes like condiment bowls to large plates, cups, and cutlery. I was surprised by how big it was at first, but I think it's actually better for loading a large number of dishes at once. If the 6-place setting is this big, I don't think there will be any room to put anything larger. Third, the automatic door opening function: The dishwasher runs for a standard 65 minutes. The door opens automatically when there are about 5 minutes left after the cycle is finished. Thanks to this, humid air is quickly expelled, and the outside air naturally dries the dishes, effectively removing odors and moisture. I think the automatic door opening function is essential for a dishwasher. Overall review: With the 3-stage washing system (Top, Medium, and Bottom), it cleans truly thoroughly, leaving no trace of food stains. It completely removes even red liquids. It really cleans better than washing by hand (see photo). There is ample storage space, and the noise wasn't as loud as I expected, so it wasn't bothersome. I also liked that it allows for minimal or no drilling. Personally, I tend not to use machines if the operation is complicated, so I appreciated how simple it is to use. I was satisfied with everything—design, performance, and ease of use—so there wasn't a single thing I was disappointed about. I am truly satisfied. Finally, for those using a dishwasher for the first time, I will wrap up by listing a few important precautions you must know before use! 1. You must use dishwasher-specific detergent. Using regular dish soap may cause the unit to malfunction. For liquid detergent, place it in the area shown in the photo; for solid detergent, simply place one tablet on the bottom of the dishwasher. 2. Please make sure to rinse dishes stained with grease, chili powder, or red broth with water before placing them in the dishwasher. 3. Please check that the automatic door opening function is enabled before starting the cycle. Occasionally, if it is not set, the door will not open automatically after the wash cycle. This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event.

Today, I’m going to review the 'Midae Automatic Door Opening Dishwasher (6-Place).' If you are in a hurry, please just look at the summary at the very bottom. Midea Automatic Door Opening Dishwasher, Satisfactory Features. After using the Midea dishwasher, I found it to be performing its function as a dishwasher exceptionally well. First. Powerful cleaning: When I did dishes by hand, I always had doubts about the cleaning power of dishwashers. No matter how much people around me said it was good, I wondered if it could clean as thoroughly as washing every nook and cranny by hand. Contrary to my concerns, it really cleans much more cleanly than hand washing. To check how well it cleans, I put in dishes with red stains from eating Yukgaejang and Tteokbokki. They came out so clean that you couldn't find a single food stain anywhere. (See photo). Second. Ample storage space: It was definitely difficult to gauge the size just by looking at the detailed description or review photos. Since it was described as a slim size and a 6-place setting, I expected it to be more compact, but it was much larger than anticipated. It features a two-tier basket and fits everything from small dishes like condiment bowls to large plates, cups, and cutlery. I was surprised by how big it was at first, but I think it's actually better for loading a large number of dishes at once. If the 6-place setting is this big, I don't think there will be any room to put anything larger. Third, the automatic door opening function: The dishwasher runs for a standard 65 minutes. The door opens automatically when there are about 5 minutes left after the cycle is finished. Thanks to this, humid air is quickly expelled, and the outside air naturally dries the dishes, effectively removing odors and moisture. I think the automatic door opening function is essential for a dishwasher. Overall review: With the 3-stage washing system (Top, Medium, and Bottom), it cleans truly thoroughly, leaving no trace of food stains. It completely removes even red liquids. It really cleans better than washing by hand (see photo). There is ample storage space, and the noise wasn't as loud as I expected, so it wasn't bothersome. I also liked that it allows for minimal or no drilling. Personally, I tend not to use machines if the operation is complicated, so I appreciated how simple it is to use. I was satisfied with everything—design, performance, and ease of use—so there wasn't a single thing I was disappointed about. I am truly satisfied. Finally, for those using a dishwasher for the first time, I will wrap up by listing a few important precautions you must know before use! 1. You must use dishwasher-specific detergent. Using regular dish soap may cause the unit to malfunction. For liquid detergent, place it in the area shown in the photo; for solid detergent, simply place one tablet on the bottom of the dishwasher. 2. Please make sure to rinse dishes stained with grease, chili powder, or red broth with water before placing them in the dishwasher. 3. Please check that the automatic door opening function is enabled before starting the cycle. Occasionally, if it is not set, the door will not open automatically after the wash cycle. This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event.

Sentence (English): I think the automatic door opening function is essential for a dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Important precautions to know before use and an honest review! ] || ---------------- || Pros. Powerful cleaning. Automatic door opening. Ample storage space. User Review. Hello. Today, I’m going to review the 'Midae Automatic Door Opening Dishwasher (6-Place).' If you are in a hurry, please just look at the summary at the very bottom. Midea Automatic Door Opening Dishwasher, Satisfactory Features. After using the Midea dishwasher, I found it to be performing its function as a dishwasher exceptionally well. First. Powerful cleaning: When I did dishes by hand, I always had doubts about the cleaning power of dishwashers. No matter how much people around me said it was good, I wondered if it could clean as thoroughly as washing every nook and cranny by hand. Contrary to my concerns, it really cleans much more cleanly than hand washing. To check how well it cleans, I put in dishes with red stains from eating Yukgaejang and Tteokbokki. They came out so clean that you couldn't find a single food stain anywhere. (See photo). Second. Ample storage space: It was definitely difficult to gauge the size just by looking at the detailed description or review photos. Since it was described as a slim size and a 6-place setting, I expected it to be more compact, but it was much larger than anticipated. It features a two-tier basket and fits everything from small dishes like condiment bowls to large plates, cups, and cutlery. I was surprised by how big it was at first, but I think it's actually better for loading a large number of dishes at once. If the 6-place setting is this big, I don't think there will be any room to put anything larger. Third, the automatic door opening function: The dishwasher runs for a standard 65 minutes. The door opens automatically when there are about 5 minutes left after the cycle is finished. Thanks to this, humid air is quickly expelled, and the outside air naturally dries the dishes, effectively removing odors and moisture. I think the automatic door opening function is essential for a dishwasher. Overall review: With the 3-stage washing system (Top, Medium, and Bottom), it cleans truly thoroughly, leaving no trace of food stains. It completely removes even red liquids. It really cleans better than washing by hand (see photo). There is ample storage space, and the noise wasn't as loud as I expected, so it wasn't bothersome. I also liked that it allows for minimal or no drilling. Personally, I tend not to use machines if the operation is complicated, so I appreciated how simple it is to use. I was satisfied with everything—design, performance, and ease of use—so there wasn't a single thing I was disappointed about. I am truly satisfied. Finally, for those using a dishwasher for the first time, I will wrap up by listing a few important precautions you must know before use! 1. You must use dishwasher-specific detergent. Using regular dish soap may cause the unit to malfunction. For liquid detergent, place it in the area shown in the photo; for solid detergent, simply place one tablet on the bottom of the dishwasher. 2. Please make sure to rinse dishes stained with grease, chili powder, or red broth with water before placing them in the dishwasher. 3. Please check that the automatic door opening function is enabled before starting the cycle. Occasionally, if it is not set, the door will not open automatically after the wash cycle. This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event.

Today, I’m going to review the 'Midae Automatic Door Opening Dishwasher (6-Place).' If you are in a hurry, please just look at the summary at the very bottom. Midea Automatic Door Opening Dishwasher, Satisfactory Features. After using the Midea dishwasher, I found it to be performing its function as a dishwasher exceptionally well. First. Powerful cleaning: When I did dishes by hand, I always had doubts about the cleaning power of dishwashers. No matter how much people around me said it was good, I wondered if it could clean as thoroughly as washing every nook and cranny by hand. Contrary to my concerns, it really cleans much more cleanly than hand washing. To check how well it cleans, I put in dishes with red stains from eating Yukgaejang and Tteokbokki. They came out so clean that you couldn't find a single food stain anywhere. (See photo). Second. Ample storage space: It was definitely difficult to gauge the size just by looking at the detailed description or review photos. Since it was described as a slim size and a 6-place setting, I expected it to be more compact, but it was much larger than anticipated. It features a two-tier basket and fits everything from small dishes like condiment bowls to large plates, cups, and cutlery. I was surprised by how big it was at first, but I think it's actually better for loading a large number of dishes at once. If the 6-place setting is this big, I don't think there will be any room to put anything larger. Third, the automatic door opening function: The dishwasher runs for a standard 65 minutes. The door opens automatically when there are about 5 minutes left after the cycle is finished. Thanks to this, humid air is quickly expelled, and the outside air naturally dries the dishes, effectively removing odors and moisture. I think the automatic door opening function is essential for a dishwasher. Overall review: With the 3-stage washing system (Top, Medium, and Bottom), it cleans truly thoroughly, leaving no trace of food stains. It completely removes even red liquids. It really cleans better than washing by hand (see photo). There is ample storage space, and the noise wasn't as loud as I expected, so it wasn't bothersome. I also liked that it allows for minimal or no drilling. Personally, I tend not to use machines if the operation is complicated, so I appreciated how simple it is to use. I was satisfied with everything—design, performance, and ease of use—so there wasn't a single thing I was disappointed about. I am truly satisfied. Finally, for those using a dishwasher for the first time, I will wrap up by listing a few important precautions you must know before use! 1. You must use dishwasher-specific detergent. Using regular dish soap may cause the unit to malfunction. For liquid detergent, place it in the area shown in the photo; for solid detergent, simply place one tablet on the bottom of the dishwasher. 2. Please make sure to rinse dishes stained with grease, chili powder, or red broth with water before placing them in the dishwasher. 3. Please check that the automatic door opening function is enabled before starting the cycle. Occasionally, if it is not set, the door will not open automatically after the wash cycle. This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event.

Today, I’m going to review the 'Midae Automatic Door Opening Dishwasher (6-Place).' If you are in a hurry, please just look at the summary at the very bottom. Midea Automatic Door Opening Dishwasher, Satisfactory Features. After using the Midea dishwasher, I found it to be performing its function as a dishwasher exceptionally well. First. Powerful cleaning: When I did dishes by hand, I always had doubts about the cleaning power of dishwashers. No matter how much people around me said it was good, I wondered if it could clean as thoroughly as washing every nook and cranny by hand. Contrary to my concerns, it really cleans much more cleanly than hand washing. To check how well it cleans, I put in dishes with red stains from eating Yukgaejang and Tteokbokki. They came out so clean that you couldn't find a single food stain anywhere. (See photo). Second. Ample storage space: It was definitely difficult to gauge the size just by looking at the detailed description or review photos. Since it was described as a slim size and a 6-place setting, I expected it to be more compact, but it was much larger than anticipated. It features a two-tier basket and fits everything from small dishes like condiment bowls to large plates, cups, and cutlery. I was surprised by how big it was at first, but I think it's actually better for loading a large number of dishes at once. If the 6-place setting is this big, I don't think there will be any room to put anything larger. Third, the automatic door opening function: The dishwasher runs for a standard 65 minutes. The door opens automatically when there are about 5 minutes left after the cycle is finished. Thanks to this, humid air is quickly expelled, and the outside air naturally dries the dishes, effectively removing odors and moisture. I think the automatic door opening function is essential for a dishwasher. Overall review: With the 3-stage washing system (Top, Medium, and Bottom), it cleans truly thoroughly, leaving no trace of food stains. It completely removes even red liquids. It really cleans better than washing by hand (see photo). There is ample storage space, and the noise wasn't as loud as I expected, so it wasn't bothersome. I also liked that it allows for minimal or no drilling. Personally, I tend not to use machines if the operation is complicated, so I appreciated how simple it is to use. I was satisfied with everything—design, performance, and ease of use—so there wasn't a single thing I was disappointed about. I am truly satisfied. Finally, for those using a dishwasher for the first time, I will wrap up by listing a few important precautions you must know before use! 1. You must use dishwasher-specific detergent. Using regular dish soap may cause the unit to malfunction. For liquid detergent, place it in the area shown in the photo; for solid detergent, simply place one tablet on the bottom of the dishwasher. 2. Please make sure to rinse dishes stained with grease, chili powder, or red broth with water before placing them in the dishwasher. 3. Please check that the automatic door opening function is enabled before starting the cycle. Occasionally, if it is not set, the door will not open automatically after the wash cycle. This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event.

Today, I’m going to review the 'Midae Automatic Door Opening Dishwasher (6-Place).' If you are in a hurry, please just look at the summary at the very bottom. Midea Automatic Door Opening Dishwasher, Satisfactory Features. After using the Midea dishwasher, I found it to be performing its function as a dishwasher exceptionally well. First. Powerful cleaning: When I did dishes by hand, I always had doubts about the cleaning power of dishwashers. No matter how much people around me said it was good, I wondered if it could clean as thoroughly as washing every nook and cranny by hand. Contrary to my concerns, it really cleans much more cleanly than hand washing. To check how well it cleans, I put in dishes with red stains from eating Yukgaejang and Tteokbokki. They came out so clean that you couldn't find a single food stain anywhere. (See photo). Second. Ample storage space: It was definitely difficult to gauge the size just by looking at the detailed description or review photos. Since it was described as a slim size and a 6-place setting, I expected it to be more compact, but it was much larger than anticipated. It features a two-tier basket and fits everything from small dishes like condiment bowls to large plates, cups, and cutlery. I was surprised by how big it was at first, but I think it's actually better for loading a large number of dishes at once. If the 6-place setting is this big, I don't think there will be any room to put anything larger. Third, the automatic door opening function: The dishwasher runs for a standard 65 minutes. The door opens automatically when there are about 5 minutes left after the cycle is finished. Thanks to this, humid air is quickly expelled, and the outside air naturally dries the dishes, effectively removing odors and moisture. I think the automatic door opening function is essential for a dishwasher. Overall review: With the 3-stage washing system (Top, Medium, and Bottom), it cleans truly thoroughly, leaving no trace of food stains. It completely removes even red liquids. It really cleans better than washing by hand (see photo). There is ample storage space, and the noise wasn't as loud as I expected, so it wasn't bothersome. I also liked that it allows for minimal or no drilling. Personally, I tend not to use machines if the operation is complicated, so I appreciated how simple it is to use. I was satisfied with everything—design, performance, and ease of use—so there wasn't a single thing I was disappointed about. I am truly satisfied. Finally, for those using a dishwasher for the first time, I will wrap up by listing a few important precautions you must know before use! 1. You must use dishwasher-specific detergent. Using regular dish soap may cause the unit to malfunction. For liquid detergent, place it in the area shown in the photo; for solid detergent, simply place one tablet on the bottom of the dishwasher. 2. Please make sure to rinse dishes stained with grease, chili powder, or red broth with water before placing them in the dishwasher. 3. Please check that the automatic door opening function is enabled before starting the cycle. Occasionally, if it is not set, the door will not open automatically after the wash cycle. This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event.

Today, I’m going to review the 'Midae Automatic Door Opening Dishwasher (6-Place).' If you are in a hurry, please just look at the summary at the very bottom. Midea Automatic Door Opening Dishwasher, Satisfactory Features. After using the Midea dishwasher, I found it to be performing its function as a dishwasher exceptionally well. First. Powerful cleaning: When I did dishes by hand, I always had doubts about the cleaning power of dishwashers. No matter how much people around me said it was good, I wondered if it could clean as thoroughly as washing every nook and cranny by hand. Contrary to my concerns, it really cleans much more cleanly than hand washing. To check how well it cleans, I put in dishes with red stains from eating Yukgaejang and Tteokbokki. They came out so clean that you couldn't find a single food stain anywhere. (See photo). Second. Ample storage space: It was definitely difficult to gauge the size just by looking at the detailed description or review photos. Since it was described as a slim size and a 6-place setting, I expected it to be more compact, but it was much larger than anticipated. It features a two-tier basket and fits everything from small dishes like condiment bowls to large plates, cups, and cutlery. I was surprised by how big it was at first, but I think it's actually better for loading a large number of dishes at once. If the 6-place setting is this big, I don't think there will be any room to put anything larger. Third, the automatic door opening function: The dishwasher runs for a standard 65 minutes. The door opens automatically when there are about 5 minutes left after the cycle is finished. Thanks to this, humid air is quickly expelled, and the outside air naturally dries the dishes, effectively removing odors and moisture. I think the automatic door opening function is essential for a dishwasher. Overall review: With the 3-stage washing system (Top, Medium, and Bottom), it cleans truly thoroughly, leaving no trace of food stains. It completely removes even red liquids. It really cleans better than washing by hand (see photo). There is ample storage space, and the noise wasn't as loud as I expected, so it wasn't bothersome. I also liked that it allows for minimal or no drilling. Personally, I tend not to use machines if the operation is complicated, so I appreciated how simple it is to use. I was satisfied with everything—design, performance, and ease of use—so there wasn't a single thing I was disappointed about. I am truly satisfied. Finally, for those using a dishwasher for the first time, I will wrap up by listing a few important precautions you must know before use! 1. You must use dishwasher-specific detergent. Using regular dish soap may cause the unit to malfunction. For liquid detergent, place it in the area shown in the photo; for solid detergent, simply place one tablet on the bottom of the dishwasher. 2. Please make sure to rinse dishes stained with grease, chili powder, or red broth with water before placing them in the dishwasher. 3. Please check that the automatic door opening function is enabled before starting the cycle. Occasionally, if it is not set, the door will not open automatically after the wash cycle. This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event.

Today, I’m going to review the 'Midae Automatic Door Opening Dishwasher (6-Place).' If you are in a hurry, please just look at the summary at the very bottom. Midea Automatic Door Opening Dishwasher, Satisfactory Features. After using the Midea dishwasher, I found it to be performing its function as a dishwasher exceptionally well. First. Powerful cleaning: When I did dishes by hand, I always had doubts about the cleaning power of dishwashers. No matter how much people around me said it was good, I wondered if it could clean as thoroughly as washing every nook and cranny by hand. Contrary to my concerns, it really cleans much more cleanly than hand washing. To check how well it cleans, I put in dishes with red stains from eating Yukgaejang and Tteokbokki. They came out so clean that you couldn't find a single food stain anywhere. (See photo). Second. Ample storage space: It was definitely difficult to gauge the size just by looking at the detailed description or review photos. Since it was described as a slim size and a 6-place setting, I expected it to be more compact, but it was much larger than anticipated. It features a two-tier basket and fits everything from small dishes like condiment bowls to large plates, cups, and cutlery. I was surprised by how big it was at first, but I think it's actually better for loading a large number of dishes at once. If the 6-place setting is this big, I don't think there will be any room to put anything larger. Third, the automatic door opening function: The dishwasher runs for a standard 65 minutes. The door opens automatically when there are about 5 minutes left after the cycle is finished. Thanks to this, humid air is quickly expelled, and the outside air naturally dries the dishes, effectively removing odors and moisture. I think the automatic door opening function is essential for a dishwasher. Overall review: With the 3-stage washing system (Top, Medium, and Bottom), it cleans truly thoroughly, leaving no trace of food stains. It completely removes even red liquids. It really cleans better than washing by hand (see photo). There is ample storage space, and the noise wasn't as loud as I expected, so it wasn't bothersome. I also liked that it allows for minimal or no drilling. Personally, I tend not to use machines if the operation is complicated, so I appreciated how simple it is to use. I was satisfied with everything—design, performance, and ease of use—so there wasn't a single thing I was disappointed about. I am truly satisfied. Finally, for those using a dishwasher for the first time, I will wrap up by listing a few important precautions you must know before use! 1. You must use dishwasher-specific detergent. Using regular dish soap may cause the unit to malfunction. For liquid detergent, place it in the area shown in the photo; for solid detergent, simply place one tablet on the bottom of the dishwasher. 2. Please make sure to rinse dishes stained with grease, chili powder, or red broth with water before placing them in the dishwasher. 3. Please check that the automatic door opening function is enabled before starting the cycle. Occasionally, if it is not set, the door will not open automatically after the wash cycle. This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event.

Today, I’m going to review the 'Midae Automatic Door Opening Dishwasher (6-Place).' If you are in a hurry, please just look at the summary at the very bottom. Midea Automatic Door Opening Dishwasher, Satisfactory Features. After using the Midea dishwasher, I found it to be performing its function as a dishwasher exceptionally well. First. Powerful cleaning: When I did dishes by hand, I always had doubts about the cleaning power of dishwashers. No matter how much people around me said it was good, I wondered if it could clean as thoroughly as washing every nook and cranny by hand. Contrary to my concerns, it really cleans much more cleanly than hand washing. To check how well it cleans, I put in dishes with red stains from eating Yukgaejang and Tteokbokki. They came out so clean that you couldn't find a single food stain anywhere. (See photo). Second. Ample storage space: It was definitely difficult to gauge the size just by looking at the detailed description or review photos. Since it was described as a slim size and a 6-place setting, I expected it to be more compact, but it was much larger than anticipated. It features a two-tier basket and fits everything from small dishes like condiment bowls to large plates, cups, and cutlery. I was surprised by how big it was at first, but I think it's actually better for loading a large number of dishes at once. If the 6-place setting is this big, I don't think there will be any room to put anything larger. Third, the automatic door opening function: The dishwasher runs for a standard 65 minutes. The door opens automatically when there are about 5 minutes left after the cycle is finished. Thanks to this, humid air is quickly expelled, and the outside air naturally dries the dishes, effectively removing odors and moisture. I think the automatic door opening function is essential for a dishwasher. Overall review: With the 3-stage washing system (Top, Medium, and Bottom), it cleans truly thoroughly, leaving no trace of food stains. It completely removes even red liquids. It really cleans better than washing by hand (see photo). There is ample storage space, and the noise wasn't as loud as I expected, so it wasn't bothersome. I also liked that it allows for minimal or no drilling. Personally, I tend not to use machines if the operation is complicated, so I appreciated how simple it is to use. I was satisfied with everything—design, performance, and ease of use—so there wasn't a single thing I was disappointed about. I am truly satisfied. Finally, for those using a dishwasher for the first time, I will wrap up by listing a few important precautions you must know before use! 1. You must use dishwasher-specific detergent. Using regular dish soap may cause the unit to malfunction. For liquid detergent, place it in the area shown in the photo; for solid detergent, simply place one tablet on the bottom of the dishwasher. 2. Please make sure to rinse dishes stained with grease, chili powder, or red broth with water before placing them in the dishwasher. 3. Please check that the automatic door opening function is enabled before starting the cycle. Occasionally, if it is not set, the door will not open automatically after the wash cycle. This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event.
