Comments (English): [ Important precautions to know before use and an honest review! ] || ---------------- || Pros. Powerful cleaning. Automatic door opening. Ample storage space. User Review. Hello. Today, I’m going to review the 'Midae Automatic Door Opening Dishwasher (6-Place).' If you are in a hurry, please just look at the summary at the very bottom. Midea Automatic Door Opening Dishwasher, Satisfactory Features. After using the Midea dishwasher, I found it to be performing its function as a dishwasher exceptionally well. First. Powerful cleaning: When I did dishes by hand, I always had doubts about the cleaning power of dishwashers. No matter how much people around me said it was good, I wondered if it could clean as thoroughly as washing every nook and cranny by hand. Contrary to my concerns, it really cleans much more cleanly than hand washing. To check how well it cleans, I put in dishes with red stains from eating Yukgaejang and Tteokbokki. They came out so clean that you couldn't find a single food stain anywhere. (See photo). Second. Ample storage space: It was definitely difficult to gauge the size just by looking at the detailed description or review photos. Since it was described as a slim size and a 6-place setting, I expected it to be more compact, but it was much larger than anticipated. It features a two-tier basket and fits everything from small dishes like condiment bowls to large plates, cups, and cutlery. I was surprised by how big it was at first, but I think it's actually better for loading a large number of dishes at once. If the 6-place setting is this big, I don't think there will be any room to put anything larger. Third, the automatic door opening function: The dishwasher runs for a standard 65 minutes. The door opens automatically when there are about 5 minutes left after the cycle is finished. Thanks to this, humid air is quickly expelled, and the outside air naturally dries the dishes, effectively removing odors and moisture. I think the automatic door opening function is essential for a dishwasher. Overall review: With the 3-stage washing system (Top, Medium, and Bottom), it cleans truly thoroughly, leaving no trace of food stains. It completely removes even red liquids. It really cleans better than washing by hand (see photo). There is ample storage space, and the noise wasn't as loud as I expected, so it wasn't bothersome. I also liked that it allows for minimal or no drilling. Personally, I tend not to use machines if the operation is complicated, so I appreciated how simple it is to use. I was satisfied with everything—design, performance, and ease of use—so there wasn't a single thing I was disappointed about. I am truly satisfied. Finally, for those using a dishwasher for the first time, I will wrap up by listing a few important precautions you must know before use! 1. You must use dishwasher-specific detergent. Using regular dish soap may cause the unit to malfunction. For liquid detergent, place it in the area shown in the photo; for solid detergent, simply place one tablet on the bottom of the dishwasher. 2. Please make sure to rinse dishes stained with grease, chili powder, or red broth with water before placing them in the dishwasher. 3. Please check that the automatic door opening function is enabled before starting the cycle. Occasionally, if it is not set, the door will not open automatically after the wash cycle. This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event.

Today, I’m going to review the 'Midae Automatic Door Opening Dishwasher (6-Place).' If you are in a hurry, please just look at the summary at the very bottom. Midea Automatic Door Opening Dishwasher, Satisfactory Features. After using the Midea dishwasher, I found it to be performing its function as a dishwasher exceptionally well. First. Powerful cleaning: When I did dishes by hand, I always had doubts about the cleaning power of dishwashers. No matter how much people around me said it was good, I wondered if it could clean as thoroughly as washing every nook and cranny by hand. Contrary to my concerns, it really cleans much more cleanly than hand washing. To check how well it cleans, I put in dishes with red stains from eating Yukgaejang and Tteokbokki. They came out so clean that you couldn't find a single food stain anywhere. (See photo). Second. Ample storage space: It was definitely difficult to gauge the size just by looking at the detailed description or review photos. Since it was described as a slim size and a 6-place setting, I expected it to be more compact, but it was much larger than anticipated. It features a two-tier basket and fits everything from small dishes like condiment bowls to large plates, cups, and cutlery. I was surprised by how big it was at first, but I think it's actually better for loading a large number of dishes at once. If the 6-place setting is this big, I don't think there will be any room to put anything larger. Third, the automatic door opening function: The dishwasher runs for a standard 65 minutes. The door opens automatically when there are about 5 minutes left after the cycle is finished. Thanks to this, humid air is quickly expelled, and the outside air naturally dries the dishes, effectively removing odors and moisture. I think the automatic door opening function is essential for a dishwasher. Overall review: With the 3-stage washing system (Top, Medium, and Bottom), it cleans truly thoroughly, leaving no trace of food stains. It completely removes even red liquids. It really cleans better than washing by hand (see photo). There is ample storage space, and the noise wasn't as loud as I expected, so it wasn't bothersome. I also liked that it allows for minimal or no drilling. Personally, I tend not to use machines if the operation is complicated, so I appreciated how simple it is to use. I was satisfied with everything—design, performance, and ease of use—so there wasn't a single thing I was disappointed about. I am truly satisfied. Finally, for those using a dishwasher for the first time, I will wrap up by listing a few important precautions you must know before use! 1. You must use dishwasher-specific detergent. Using regular dish soap may cause the unit to malfunction. For liquid detergent, place it in the area shown in the photo; for solid detergent, simply place one tablet on the bottom of the dishwasher. 2. Please make sure to rinse dishes stained with grease, chili powder, or red broth with water before placing them in the dishwasher. 3. Please check that the automatic door opening function is enabled before starting the cycle. Occasionally, if it is not set, the door will not open automatically after the wash cycle. This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event.

Today, I’m going to review the 'Midae Automatic Door Opening Dishwasher (6-Place).' If you are in a hurry, please just look at the summary at the very bottom. Midea Automatic Door Opening Dishwasher, Satisfactory Features. After using the Midea dishwasher, I found it to be performing its function as a dishwasher exceptionally well. First. Powerful cleaning: When I did dishes by hand, I always had doubts about the cleaning power of dishwashers. No matter how much people around me said it was good, I wondered if it could clean as thoroughly as washing every nook and cranny by hand. Contrary to my concerns, it really cleans much more cleanly than hand washing. To check how well it cleans, I put in dishes with red stains from eating Yukgaejang and Tteokbokki. They came out so clean that you couldn't find a single food stain anywhere. (See photo). Second. Ample storage space: It was definitely difficult to gauge the size just by looking at the detailed description or review photos. Since it was described as a slim size and a 6-place setting, I expected it to be more compact, but it was much larger than anticipated. It features a two-tier basket and fits everything from small dishes like condiment bowls to large plates, cups, and cutlery. I was surprised by how big it was at first, but I think it's actually better for loading a large number of dishes at once. If the 6-place setting is this big, I don't think there will be any room to put anything larger. Third, the automatic door opening function: The dishwasher runs for a standard 65 minutes. The door opens automatically when there are about 5 minutes left after the cycle is finished. Thanks to this, humid air is quickly expelled, and the outside air naturally dries the dishes, effectively removing odors and moisture. I think the automatic door opening function is essential for a dishwasher. Overall review: With the 3-stage washing system (Top, Medium, and Bottom), it cleans truly thoroughly, leaving no trace of food stains. It completely removes even red liquids. It really cleans better than washing by hand (see photo). There is ample storage space, and the noise wasn't as loud as I expected, so it wasn't bothersome. I also liked that it allows for minimal or no drilling. Personally, I tend not to use machines if the operation is complicated, so I appreciated how simple it is to use. I was satisfied with everything—design, performance, and ease of use—so there wasn't a single thing I was disappointed about. I am truly satisfied. Finally, for those using a dishwasher for the first time, I will wrap up by listing a few important precautions you must know before use! 1. You must use dishwasher-specific detergent. Using regular dish soap may cause the unit to malfunction. For liquid detergent, place it in the area shown in the photo; for solid detergent, simply place one tablet on the bottom of the dishwasher. 2. Please make sure to rinse dishes stained with grease, chili powder, or red broth with water before placing them in the dishwasher. 3. Please check that the automatic door opening function is enabled before starting the cycle. Occasionally, if it is not set, the door will not open automatically after the wash cycle. This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event.

Today, I’m going to review the 'Midae Automatic Door Opening Dishwasher (6-Place).' If you are in a hurry, please just look at the summary at the very bottom. Midea Automatic Door Opening Dishwasher, Satisfactory Features. After using the Midea dishwasher, I found it to be performing its function as a dishwasher exceptionally well. First. Powerful cleaning: When I did dishes by hand, I always had doubts about the cleaning power of dishwashers. No matter how much people around me said it was good, I wondered if it could clean as thoroughly as washing every nook and cranny by hand. Contrary to my concerns, it really cleans much more cleanly than hand washing. To check how well it cleans, I put in dishes with red stains from eating Yukgaejang and Tteokbokki. They came out so clean that you couldn't find a single food stain anywhere. (See photo). Second. Ample storage space: It was definitely difficult to gauge the size just by looking at the detailed description or review photos. Since it was described as a slim size and a 6-place setting, I expected it to be more compact, but it was much larger than anticipated. It features a two-tier basket and fits everything from small dishes like condiment bowls to large plates, cups, and cutlery. I was surprised by how big it was at first, but I think it's actually better for loading a large number of dishes at once. If the 6-place setting is this big, I don't think there will be any room to put anything larger. Third, the automatic door opening function: The dishwasher runs for a standard 65 minutes. The door opens automatically when there are about 5 minutes left after the cycle is finished. Thanks to this, humid air is quickly expelled, and the outside air naturally dries the dishes, effectively removing odors and moisture. I think the automatic door opening function is essential for a dishwasher. Overall review: With the 3-stage washing system (Top, Medium, and Bottom), it cleans truly thoroughly, leaving no trace of food stains. It completely removes even red liquids. It really cleans better than washing by hand (see photo). There is ample storage space, and the noise wasn't as loud as I expected, so it wasn't bothersome. I also liked that it allows for minimal or no drilling. Personally, I tend not to use machines if the operation is complicated, so I appreciated how simple it is to use. I was satisfied with everything—design, performance, and ease of use—so there wasn't a single thing I was disappointed about. I am truly satisfied. Finally, for those using a dishwasher for the first time, I will wrap up by listing a few important precautions you must know before use! 1. You must use dishwasher-specific detergent. Using regular dish soap may cause the unit to malfunction. For liquid detergent, place it in the area shown in the photo; for solid detergent, simply place one tablet on the bottom of the dishwasher. 2. Please make sure to rinse dishes stained with grease, chili powder, or red broth with water before placing them in the dishwasher. 3. Please check that the automatic door opening function is enabled before starting the cycle. Occasionally, if it is not set, the door will not open automatically after the wash cycle. This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event.

Everyone, have a cup of tea during dishwashing time! Let's see the kids' faces one more time! Going for a walk is also a good idea. I have some memories of crying while doing dishes, so I think this has given me freedom. For the freedom of housewives! All in all, I think I just bought a pricey brand name. This washer itself is no better, and in some ways worse, than the 20-year old Whirlpool it replaced.

Sentence (English): We ended up buying mostly LG appliances when moving to a new house last year.
Comments (English): [ Buy an extended warranty ] || ---------------- || We ended up buying mostly LG appliances when moving to a new house last year. I actually thought this was one of the better ones we had from LG, but maybe now after a year, not so much. My main gripe for usage is the tines in the racks. The top rack for glasses and bowls is ok, I don't like how the bowls lay in it. However, the bottom rack needs more flexibility and tines. It's setup to mostly use plates. We tend to fill up the top rack before the bottom one, and putting glasses or bowls on the bottom, there is just not enough support to keep them upright. So we have times where we are running a load with bottom rack partially empty, which seems like a bit of a waste. Otherwise the wash options are good, it seems to dry okay for us with the dry boost. We do the 1 hour cycle with dry boost for 90 minutes total which seems like a nice balance. You can download different wash cycles, only 1 active at a time. But you can rinse only, dry only, etc. Downloading updates works ok, not great. The dishwasher needs to be on. I usually crack open the door to turn it on, then start a download, but the dishwasher will sometimes timeout and turn itself off before it completes. The rack layout is a minus 1 star. The other star deductions are because the dishwasher has been acting up since it's been out of the 1 year warranty. When it's off, it will randomly beep and all the lights come on. When it's mid cycle, it randomly beeps and stops washing, then turns itself off without finishing the cycle. Not exactly sure why, seems according to information online, it might be a control board or latch issue. But having multiple appliances fail after 1 year of use from the same manufacturer is just a sign of a lack of quality. Unfortunately we went with LG because it was the most cost efficient when prices were high, and now we're paying for it with sub par performance.

Sentence (English): We purchased this just over a year ago, and so far have been very happy with the product.
Comments (English): [ Fingerprint Coat Peels Off and Door Rusts ] || ---------------- || We purchased this just over a year ago, and so far have been very happy with the product. We took great care of it, only cleaning it with KitchenAid recommended products. But in the last couple of weeks, I noticed rust forming along the bottom and around the handle. In looking closer, the fingerprint coating is peeling off and rust is forming around and under the coating. It is spreading quite quickly and the dishwasher looks awful. In reading online reviews, this is a very frequent problem with the product. I have an extended warranty, but was originally told it is considered a cosmetic issue, and they will only resolve those within 30 days of purchase (even though it is clearly a product defect). When I posted a review on the KitchenAid site, they offered to help. I reached out as requested, and was put through numerous transfers and holds (sometimes up to 25 minutes) only to be finally told that their help was that I could pay $150 for a service technician to look at it, and then pay over approximately $275 for a new door (which would have the same coating) plus installation fees (at least $150) to have it replaced. Incredibly disappointed in the product and customer service. Would encourage anyone looking at it to google "KitchenAid dishwasher door rusting" or "Kitchenaid dishwasher fingerprint coat peeling" or something like that, and read all the reviews.

It has a glide rail so it's easy to open, and the composition and height can be freely changed depending on the dishes. Wow~~~ Now, I want to put a dishwasher in my house and I think I can't help but want to put a dishwasher as a gift in my mom's house too.

Comments (English): [ GFCI adaptor satisfying code for GFCI requirement ] || ---------------- || Since 2020, GFCI protection to Dishwasher becomes mandatory even for replacements for old dishwashers. Costco should have informed customers about this requirement as early as possible. I was informed one day before the installation by the installation company. They would have charged me $185 to replace the outlet under the sink with a part costing less than $15. Based on my research, GFCI protection can be done by a GFCI circuit breaker (~$70) which takes a few minutes to replace in your circuit panel or a GFCI adaptor (~$20) which takes a few seconds to add to your existing outlet. It was disputed by the installation technician who insisted of GFCI outlet only. But the law only requires GFCI protection as "a part of the circuit". I am electrical engineering major. So, I was able to explain how GFCI works. A GFCI adaptor is no difference from the GFCI outlet except the wiring is done inside or outside the wall. If there is a dispute, please look up "210.8(D) GFCI Protection" which says "(2) A device or outlet within the supply circuit" as "located in one or more of the following locations." I advice you to purchase a GFCI adaptor which has an input plug and output socket located so that it does not interfere with the socket for the garbage disposer,

I am satisfied! ] || ---------------- || I've always wanted to buy a dishwasher, but the only reason I couldn't was because my kitchen is a bit cramped. Then, I stumbled upon a great-looking dishwasher that was just the right size for six people, and I was thrilled to finally buy it! While researching this product, the first things I liked about it before buying it were: 1. It's compact at 55cm wide, yet tall and has a double-layer design that can hold quite a bit of space. (It's very practical.) 2. The clean, simple design in white means it'll fit in anywhere. 3. Its simple functions are powerful, with a 65-minute cycle. (The functions are intuitive and easy to use. I personally believe that simple machines are best.) 4. It's made by an OEM company that makes high-quality products for major companies. (I learned about this from other reviews, but I haven't personally verified it myself, so I'm not entirely sure, but I've heard rumors that they manufacture OEM products for major companies, so I had a lot of confidence in them before purchasing.) 5. The price is reasonable, and Coupang (I think it's an electronics company) installed it for me. And it even comes with a two-year warranty, which is a plus. (I trust electronics sold directly by Coupang because I've purchased them before.)## After the actual installation review: First, after purchasing, a Coupang representative called me to discuss the shape of my house, necessary installation questions, and the installation date. The installer came on the appointed day, and the installation was completed very quickly. (In my case, I use a water purifier, so I connected the hose to it, which made the installation really fast.)** If you're planning to buy it, it's best to think carefully about the installation space, the space under the faucet to pull the water hose out, and the location of the holes to drill. It's difficult to change things once installed! The installation was neat and smooth, and I needed to buy detergent later - I researched carefully and bought two types.## Product Review 1. First of all, all the advantages I considered before purchasing are okay. 1) It's compact, measuring 55cm from side to side, so it fits perfectly in even a small space, and it holds quite a lot of dishes. It feels more than enough for three people. I use it once a day, or sometimes twice a day. 2) I like the color, and it adds a clean, unconventional feel to the interior. 3) The features are simple and intuitive, and it runs smoothly for 65 minutes, just right for the capacity. There's some occasional noise, but overall, it's not constant and is quite good. It's not annoying at all for me! 4) I've been using the product for three days straight now, and it works great. Great! Some people have complained about accumulated moisture, but the best part about this product is the automatic door opening. After 65 minutes, the door opens, releasing all the steam, leaving a warm, sizzling sensation. It's also great that the door automatically opens after washing, allowing the steam to escape and allowing the product to dry naturally.** I recommend purchasing different types of detergents, choosing ones for your daily use or ones that are good for cleaning oily items. Using a good detergent removes all the grease and leaves your clothes sparkling clean.** Hardened items that have been left out for too long after a meal can be difficult to clean, so soaking them in water or running them through the dishwasher right after a meal is a great way to keep them clean and tidy! I'm very satisfied with the price, so please read the product description carefully and consider the size and location of your kitchen before purchasing. This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event.

Sentence (English): This is a review of the Midea 6-Place Dishwasher with Automatic Door Opening!
Comments (English): This is a review of the Midea 6-Place Dishwasher with Automatic Door Opening! With so many home appliances like dishwashers, food waste disposers, and dryers appearing on the market that significantly improve quality of life, I find myself increasingly wanting more appliances. I already had a dryer and a food waste disposer, but adding a dishwasher is the perfect finishing touch! I am very satisfied. Although our family consists of five people, two of our children are out working and one attends a school far away, so it is mostly just my parents who are home, and the whole family tends to gather on weekends. Even though only the two of us use it on weekdays, dishes pile up in an instant if we don't wash them right on time for three meals, so a 6-place setting size fits perfectly. Also, the color is a pastel blue that isn't too bright, so it doesn't look tacky, and the clean, minimalist design is great because it doesn't strain my eyes even when I'm out and about. And I once heard that the automatic door opening feature is truly essential. I understand that it has a great feature for completely drying out internal heat or remaining moisture, and I liked that it is packed with all the necessary functions despite its small size. Since there were existing holes from a previous water purifier installation, I installed it without drilling any new holes. The hose is also very thin, so it doesn't stand out much, which is great because it isn't bothersome. However, after using it once, an error (leakage) appeared, so I immediately requested AS through Coupang. Sentence (English): I am very happy with the dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Very good purchase ] || ---------------- || I am very happy with the dishwasher. It cleans very well, even with encrusted grease residue. It is ultra-quiet, which is greatly appreciated when leaving it running at night, although when the music ends it is a bit annoying. I have tried to turn it off through the app, but there was no way. The cutlery tray is fantastic, it saves space in the lower basket so you can put other dishes in. The adjustable upper basket is very practical to be able to adjust the height depending on whether you are putting tall glasses in and need the basket to be lower or if you are putting tall things in the lower basket and need more space. In both the upper and lower baskets, the legs to put the plates are foldable and you can leave the whole basket flat to put other bulky things in. Installation is very simple, although it would be ideal to do it between two people. It comes with some accessories to reduce noise, very easy to put in, but you need to tip the dishwasher over to put them in place and it is not easy for one person alone. The felt pad could have come from the factory because turning the dishwasher upside down to remove a piece, inserting the felt pad and putting the piece back in seems a bit unnecessary when you can just include it straight away. I really like that you can put it on half load by selecting the basket that is occupied. The app is also very useful for downloading specific programs such as the one for pots and pans. In short: get help to install it because no technician comes to do it, don't worry about having to pile up dishes because if you need clean dishes you can load just one basket and enjoy a silent cleaning.
Comments (Original): [ Muy buena compra ] || ---------------- || Estoy muy contenta con el lavavajillas. Limpia muy bien, incluso restos de grasa incrustada. Es ultra silencioso, lo cual se agradece muchísimo para dejarlo funcionando por la noche, aunque al terminar la musiquita es un poco molesta, he intentado quitarla a través de la app, pero no ha habido manera. La bandeja de cubiertos es fantástica, ahorra espacio en el cesto inferior para poder meter otros cacharros. El cesto superior regulable es muy práctico para poder ajustar la altura en función de si estás metiendo vasos altos y necesitas que el cesto esté más bajo o si estás metiendo cosas altas en el cesto inferior y necesitas más espacio. Tanto en el cesto superior como en el inferior las patitas para poner los platos son abatibles y puedes dejar todo el cesto plano para poner otras cosas más voluminosas. La instalación es muy sencilla, aunque sería ideal hacerla entre dos personas. Viene con unos accesorios para reducir el ruido, muy fáciles de poner, pero necesitas volcar el lavavajillas para ponerlos en su sitio y no es fácil para una persona sola. El fieltro bien podría venir de fábrica porque volcar el lavavajillas para quitar una pieza, meter el fieltro y volver a poner la pieza, me parece un poco innecesario pudiendo incluirlo directamente. Me gusta mucho que puedas ponerlo a media carga seleccionando el cesto que está ocupado. La app también es muy útil para descargar programas específicos como el de sartenes y ollas. Resumiendo: consigue ayuda para instalarlo porque no viene ningún técnico a hacerlo, despreocúpate de tener que acumular vajilla porque si necesitas vajilla limpia puedes cargar sólo un cesto y disfruta de una limpieza silenciosa.

Sentence (English): I purchased the Bosch 800 series dishwasher in black and looks very nice and works amazing.
Comments (English): [ Best dishwasher! ] || ---------------- || I purchased the Bosch 800 series dishwasher in black and looks very nice and works amazing. The unit is extremely quiet. I was very surprised when I opened the dishwasher and found everything to be perfectly clean. We are using the Finish brand detergent and jet dry and seems to work well. I would highly recommend the series 800. I did my research and found Bosch to very well rated and would agree with all the online reviews and ratings. This unit is at the top of the list for performance and quality. I purchased through Home Depot and everything about the dishwasher and the delivery were perfect. I have only had it a week but should have purchased this years ago. The Frigidaire unit we had before worked ok but was loud and melted plastics. There is no way this will happen with the Bosch. I just went to Home Depot and ordered a 500 series refrigerator in black,I am totally sold on the Bosch quality. I do believe paying a little more for a Bosch was a good decision and will be looking forward to the new refrigerator in 2 weeks
